Delivery Options — Complete Source Tour

Snapshot of local source, 10 November 2026. Source files are reproduced in full, including pre-existing comments. This does not verify the deployed version on Hostinger. Credentials and third-party vendor libraries are excluded.

Configure and save

Delivery Times HTML → delivery_times.js collects options[] → fetch POST → request_security.js adds CSRF header → controller/products/delivery.php → CatalogAccess checks supplier, CSRF and ownership → DeliverySettings::save → DeliveryOptions::normalize → PDO UPDATE → JSON response → response.json() → Saved or error message.

Load supplier preview

index.php → preview.php → SupplierPreviewApp → URLSearchParams.get("sku") → getProduct() → makeRequest() → secure fetch → controller/order/product.php → handleProduct() → getSupplierPreview() → supplier session + owned product → DeliveryOptions::catalog(product_id) → two SELECTs → fromRow() → delivery_catalog JSON → makeRequest returns payload → PreviewStore.setProduct().

Select variations and quantity

root_variation_id → loadRoot() → loadNode() → cached leaf/node or variation-children AJAX → selectedByLevel/rootVariation → renderSelectedPath() → deepest selected base-price source → PricesController.render() and select() → selectedPriceId and selectedQuantity → refreshVariationExtras() → local variationExtras() or legacy AJAX fallback → updateSummary().

Calculate and display delivery

updateSummary() → subtotal in pence → commonDelivery(catalog, selected IDs, price ID, quantity, subtotal) → collect selected variation + applicable tier options → ignore unconfigured sources → intersect days → calculate each percentage on the same subtotal and add fixed amounts once → renderDelivery() → radio options and breakdown → user change → store.selectedDelivery → updateSummary().

Load customer preview

CustomerPreviewApp uses get_customer_preview. getCustomerProduct() permits only approved products in statuses 1, 2 or 3. The customer uses the same PreviewStore, PricesController and delivery calculation; no supplier account is required for public reads.

Load Promoflow review

Promoflow preview.php includes the Dot63 supplier template. PreviewLogic extends SupplierPreviewApp with review actions and requests_63_api.php. That API checks the Promoflow session and request origin, forwards allowed fields and the session cookie using cURL to promoflow_webhook.php. The webhook requires a reviewer; Product::handleReview dispatches to the shared preview readers. JSON returns through both servers to the same JavaScript pipeline.

Current limits and behavior

Preview estimates only: delivery selection is not saved to the cart and no delivery charge is added to checkout by this feature. Selecting a delivery radio does not call the server. Without configuration the delivery fieldset is hidden. With configured sources but no common day, the page displays No common delivery option. The selected day is kept if compatible; otherwise the longest common day is selected. A zero surcharge remains a valid option. NULL delivery_options uses the old scalar fields; [] explicitly means no options. New JSON configuration synchronizes scalar fields with its first (shortest) day. Optional daily configurations do not mean automatic discounts, compounding percentages, per-unit fixed fees, business-day calendars or date calculations.

6final class CatalogAccess
7{
8    private const ROUTES = [
9        'product' => [
10            'create_new_product' => [true, []],
11            'get_all_products_supplier' => [false, []],

22        ],

27            'create_new_group' => [true, ['sku' => 'product']],
28        ],
29        'group' => [
30            'get_groups' => [false, ['sku' => 'product']],

33        ],

41        ],

44            'create_update_images' => [true, ['sku_product' => 'product', 'sku_variation' => 'variation']],
45            'delete_image' => [true, ['sku_variation' => 'variation']],
46            'update_image_main_visibility' => [true, ['sku_variation' => 'variation']],
47        ],

50            'save_price' => [true, ['id_price' => 'price']],

55            'delete_price' => [true, ['id_price' => 'price']],
56        ],

59            'create_items' => [true, ['sku_variation' => 'variation']],
60            'delete_item' => [true, ['id_item' => 'item']],
61        ],
62        'parameters' => ['check_parameters' => [false, ['sku' => 'product', 'sku_variation' => 'variation']]],
63    ];
64
65    public static function enforce(string $module, array $data): void
66    {
67        Dot63Security::post();
68        $action = is_string($data['action'] ?? null) ? $data['action'] : '';
69        if ($module === 'product' && in_array($action, ['get_products', 'search_products', 'get_status_three_variations'], true)) {
70            return;
71        }
72        $email = Dot63Security::supplierEmail();
73        $rule = self::ROUTES[$module][$action] ?? null;
74        if ($rule === null) Dot63Security::fail(400, 'Unsupported action.');
75        if ($rule[0]) Dot63Security::csrf($data);
76        try {
77            $pdo = (new Database())->getConnection();
78            if (!$pdo instanceof PDO) throw new RuntimeException('Database unavailable');
79            $required = $rule[1];
80            // Optional references must not point to another supplier or another product.
81            $references = $required + array_intersect_key([
82                'sku' => 'product', 'sku_product' => 'product',
83                'sku_variation' => 'variation', 'sku_parent_variation' => 'variation',
84            ], $data);
85            $productId = null;
86            foreach ($references as $key => $type) {
87                $value = $data[$key] ?? null;
88                if (!array_key_exists($key, $required) && ($value === null || $value === '')) continue;
89                if ((!is_string($value) && !is_int($value)) || trim((string)$value) === '') {
90                    Dot63Security::fail(422, 'A valid product reference is required.');
91                }
92                $resolved = self::ownedProductId($pdo, $type, (string)$value, $email);
93                if ($resolved === null || ($productId !== null && $productId !== $resolved)) {
94                    Dot63Security::fail(403, 'You cannot access this product or variation.');
95                }
96                $productId = $resolved;
97            }
98        } catch (Throwable $error) {
99            error_log('Catalog authorization failed: ' . $error->getMessage());
100            Dot63Security::fail(503, 'The catalog is temporarily unavailable.');
101        }
102    }
103
104    public static function ownedProductId(PDO $pdo, string $type, string $reference, string $email): ?int
105    {
106        $joins = '';
107        switch ($type) {
108            case 'product': $predicate = 'p.SKU = :reference'; break;
109            case 'variation':
110                $joins = ' JOIN variations v ON v.product_id = p.product_id';
111                $predicate = 'v.SKU = :reference'; break;
112            case 'price':
113                $joins = ' JOIN variations v ON v.product_id = p.product_id JOIN prices r ON r.variation_id = v.variation_id';
114                $predicate = 'r.price_id = :reference'; break;
115            case 'item':
116                $joins = ' JOIN variations v ON v.product_id = p.product_id JOIN items i ON i.variation_id = v.variation_id';
117                $predicate = 'i.item_id = :reference'; break;
118            default: throw new InvalidArgumentException('Unknown reference type.');
119        }
120        if (in_array($type, ['price', 'item'], true) && (!ctype_digit($reference) || (int)$reference <= 0)) return null;
121        $statement = $pdo->prepare('SELECT p.product_id FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id'
122            . $joins . ' WHERE ' . $predicate . ' AND LOWER(s.email) = :owner LIMIT 1');
123        $statement->execute([':reference' => $reference, ':owner' => strtolower(trim($email))]);
124        $id = $statement->fetchColumn();
125        return $id === false ? null : (int)$id;
126    }
127}

1<?php
2require_once __DIR__ . "/delivery_price.php";
3require_once __DIR__ . "/delivery_options.php";
4/** Delivery configuration restricted to the signed-in supplier. */
5final class DeliverySettings
6{
7    public static function variations(PDO $pdo, string $supplierEmail, ?string $productSku = null): array
8    {
9        // v.* also supports rendering before the optional delivery migrations are applied.
10        $sql = 'SELECT v.*, p.name AS product_name, p.SKU AS product_sku
11                FROM variations v
12                JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id
13                JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
14                WHERE LOWER(s.email) = :owner';
15        $params = [':owner' => strtolower(trim($supplierEmail))];
16        if ($productSku !== null && $productSku !== '') {
17            $sql .= ' AND p.SKU = :sku';
18            $params[':sku'] = $productSku;
19        }
20        $sql .= ' ORDER BY p.name, p.product_id, v.name, v.variation_id';
21        $stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
22        $stmt->execute($params);
23        return self::hierarchy($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC));
24    }
25
26    public static function hierarchy(array $rows): array
27    {
28        $products = [];
29        foreach ($rows as $row) $products[$row['product_id']][] = $row;
30        $ordered = [];
31        foreach ($products as $productRows) {
32            // Match the variation menu's lexical ID path order.
33            usort($productRows, static function ($a, $b) { return strcmp((string)$a['variation_id'], (string)$b['variation_id']); });
34            $byId = []; $children = []; $visited = [];
35            foreach ($productRows as $row) $byId[(int)$row['variation_id']] = $row;
36            foreach ($productRows as $row) {
37                $id = (int)$row['variation_id']; $parent = (int)($row['parent_id'] ?? 0);
38                if ($parent && $parent !== $id && isset($byId[$parent])) $children[$parent][] = $id;
39            }
40            $visit = function ($id, $level, $path) use (&$visit, &$visited, &$ordered, $byId, $children) {
41                if (isset($visited[$id])) return;
42                $visited[$id] = true;
43                $row = $byId[$id]; $row['level'] = $level; $row['parent_path'] = $path;
44                $ordered[] = $row;
45                $path = $path === '' ? $row['name'] : $path . ' / ' . $row['name'];
46                foreach ($children[$id] ?? [] as $child) $visit($child, $level + 1, $path);
47            };
48            foreach ($productRows as $row) {
49                $id = (int)$row['variation_id']; $parent = (int)($row['parent_id'] ?? 0);
50                if (!$parent || $parent === $id || !isset($byId[$parent])) $visit($id, 0, '');
51            }
52            // Keep malformed cyclic data visible without recursing indefinitely.
53            foreach ($productRows as $row) if (!isset($visited[(int)$row['variation_id']])) $visit((int)$row['variation_id'], 0, '');
54        }
55        return $ordered;
56    }
57
58    public static function priceRows(PDO $pdo, string $supplierEmail, array $variations): array
59    {
60        $stmt = $pdo->prepare('SELECT r.* FROM prices r JOIN variations v ON v.variation_id = r.variation_id
61            JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
62            WHERE LOWER(s.email) = :owner AND r.price IS NOT NULL
63            ORDER BY r.min_quantity, r.max_quantity, r.price_id');
64        $stmt->execute([':owner' => strtolower(trim($supplierEmail))]);
65        $byVariation = [];
66        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $row) $byVariation[$row['variation_id']][] = $row;
67        $result = [];
68        foreach ($variations as $variation) {
69            foreach ($byVariation[$variation['variation_id']] ?? [] as $price) {
70                $result[] = array_merge($variation, $price, ['delivery_options'=>$price['delivery_options'] ?? null]);
71            }
72        }
73        return $result;
74    }
75
76    public static function save(PDO $pdo, string $owner, string $kind, string $reference, array $data): array
77    {
78        $days = DeliveryPrice::normalizeDays($data['delivery_time_days'] ?? null);
79        [$value, $type] = DeliveryPrice::normalize($data['delivery_price'] ?? null, $data['delivery_price_type'] ?? null);
80        if ($kind === 'variation') {
81            $table = 'variations'; $key = 'variation_id';
82            $sql = 'SELECT v.variation_id FROM variations v JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id
83                    JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE v.SKU = :ref AND LOWER(s.email) = :owner';
84        } elseif ($kind === 'price') {
85            $table = 'prices'; $key = 'price_id';
86            $sql = 'SELECT r.price_id FROM prices r JOIN variations v ON v.variation_id = r.variation_id
87                    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
88                    WHERE r.price_id = :ref AND r.price IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(s.email) = :owner';
89        } else {
90            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Invalid delivery configuration type.');
91        }
92        $stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
93        $stmt->execute([':ref' => $reference, ':owner' => strtolower(trim($owner))]);
94        $id = $stmt->fetchColumn();
95        if ($id === false) throw new InvalidArgumentException('This delivery configuration is unavailable.');
96        if (array_key_exists('options', $data)) {
97            $options = DeliveryOptions::normalize($data['options']);
98            $columns = $pdo->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM `$table`")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
99            if (!in_array('delivery_options', $columns, true)) throw new RuntimeException('Apply the delivery options SQL migration before saving.');
100            $first = $options[0] ?? null;
101            $stmt = $pdo->prepare("UPDATE $table SET delivery_options=:options, delivery_time_days=:days, delivery_price=:value, delivery_price_type=:type WHERE $key=:id");
102            $stmt->execute([':options'=>json_encode($options), ':days'=>$first['days'] ?? null, ':value'=>$first['value'] ?? null, ':type'=>$first['type'] ?? null, ':id'=>$id]);
103            return ['options'=>$options];
104        }
105        // Update only delivery fields, preserving base prices and variation metadata.
106        $stmt = $pdo->prepare("UPDATE $table SET delivery_time_days = :days, delivery_price = :value, delivery_price_type = :type WHERE $key = :id");
107        $stmt->execute([':days' => $days, ':value' => $value, ':type' => $type, ':id' => $id]);
108        return ['delivery_time_days' => $days, 'delivery_price' => $value, 'delivery_price_type' => $type];
109    }
110
111    public static function formatPrice(array $row): string
112    {
113        if (!isset($row['delivery_price'], $row['delivery_price_type'])) return 'Not set';
114        $value = number_format((float)$row['delivery_price'], 2, '.', ',');
115        if ($row['delivery_price_type'] === 'percentage') return $value . '%';
116        if ($row['delivery_price_type'] === 'amount') return '£' . $value . ' GBP';
117        return 'Not set';
118    }
119}

Dot63_v1/model/delivery_options.php

/Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/htdocs/Dot63_v1/model/delivery_options.php · 47 lines · Back to index

1<?php
2require_once __DIR__ . '/delivery_price.php';
3final class DeliveryOptions
4{
5    public static function normalize($options): array
6    {
7        if (!is_array($options) || count($options) > 50) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Provide up to 50 delivery options.');
8        $result = []; $seen = [];
9        foreach ($options as $option) {
10            if (!is_array($option)) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Invalid delivery option.');
11            $days = DeliveryPrice::normalizeDays($option['days'] ?? null);
12            [$value, $type] = DeliveryPrice::normalize($option['value'] ?? null, $option['type'] ?? null);
13            if ($days === null || $value === null) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Each delivery option requires days, a non-negative surcharge and a type. Use 0 for free delivery.');
14            if (isset($seen[$days])) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Use each delivery time only once.');
15            $seen[$days] = true;
16            $result[] = ['days' => $days, 'value' => $value, 'type' => $type];
17        }
18        usort($result, static fn($a,$b) => $a['days'] <=> $b['days']);
19        return $result;
20    }
21    public static function fromRow(array $row): array
22    {
23        if (isset($row['delivery_options'])) return self::normalize(json_decode($row['delivery_options'], true));
24        if (!isset($row['delivery_time_days'])) return [];
25        return self::normalize([['days'=>$row['delivery_time_days'], 'value'=>$row['delivery_price'] ?? '0', 'type'=>$row['delivery_price_type'] ?? 'amount']]);
26    }
27    public static function updateFirst($json, $days, $value, $type): ?string
28    {
29        if ($json === null) return null;
30        $options = self::normalize(json_decode($json, true));
31        $current = $options[0] ?? null;
32        $replacement = $days === null ? null : ['days'=>$days, 'value'=>$value ?? '0', 'type'=>$type ?? 'amount'];
33        if ($current !== null) array_shift($options);
34        if ($replacement !== null) array_unshift($options, $replacement);
35        return json_encode(self::normalize($options));
36    }
37    public static function catalog(PDO $pdo, int $productId): array
38    {
39        $stmt = $pdo->prepare('SELECT * FROM variations WHERE product_id = ?');
40        $stmt->execute([$productId]); $variations = [];
41        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $row) $variations[] = ['id'=>(int)$row['variation_id'], 'name'=>$row['name'], 'mode'=>$row['price_display_mode'] ?? 'prices', 'options'=>self::fromRow($row)];
42        $stmt = $pdo->prepare('SELECT r.* FROM prices r JOIN variations v ON v.variation_id=r.variation_id WHERE v.product_id = ? ORDER BY r.min_quantity DESC, r.price_id DESC');
43        $stmt->execute([$productId]); $prices=[];
44        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $row) $prices[]=['id'=>(int)$row['price_id'], 'variationId'=>(int)$row['variation_id'], 'price'=>(float)$row['price'], 'min'=>(int)$row['min_quantity'], 'max'=>$row['max_quantity'] === null ? null : (int)$row['max_quantity'], 'options'=>self::fromRow($row)];
45        return ['variations'=>$variations,'prices'=>$prices];
46    }
47}

1<?php
2/** Optional surcharge configuration; no customer pricing calculations. */
3final class DeliveryPrice
4{
5    public static function normalize($value, $type): array
6    {
7        if ($value === null || $value === '') return [null, null];
8        if (!is_scalar($value) || is_bool($value) || !preg_match('/^(?:\d+(?:\.\d{0,2})?|\.\d{1,2})$/D', (string)$value) || (float)$value > 9999999999.99) {
9            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Delivery Price must be a non-negative number with at most 2 decimal places (maximum 9999999999.99).');
10        }
11        if (!in_array($type, ['percentage', 'amount'], true)) {
12            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Select a valid Delivery Price type.');
13        }
14        return [(string)$value, $type];
15    }
16
17    public static function normalizeDays($value): ?int
18    {
19        if ($value === null || $value === '') return null;
20        if ((!is_string($value) && !is_int($value)) || !ctype_digit((string)$value) || (float)$value > 65535) {
21            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Delivery Time must be a whole number of days between 0 and 65535.');
22        }
23        return (int)$value;
24    }
25
26    public static function requireColumns(PDO $pdo, string $table): void
27    {
28        if (!in_array($table, ['variations', 'prices'], true)) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Invalid table.');
29        $columns = $pdo->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM `$table`")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
30        if (!in_array('delivery_price', $columns, true) || !in_array('delivery_price_type', $columns, true) || !in_array('delivery_time_days', $columns, true)) {
31            throw new RuntimeException('Delivery settings are not available yet. Apply the Delivery Price and Delivery Time SQL migrations first.');
32        }
33    }
34}

1-- Execute manually in the intended database. This migration is NOT run by the app.
2-- NULL means no surcharge configured. Existing prices remain unchanged.
3ALTER TABLE `variations`
4    ADD COLUMN `delivery_price` DECIMAL(12,2) UNSIGNED NULL DEFAULT NULL,

6

1<?php
2/** Shared HTTP/session settings. Safe to include from CLI model tests. */
3final class Dot63Security
4{
5    public static function configure(): void
6    {
7        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE && !headers_sent()) {
8            ini_set('session.use_strict_mode', '1');
9            ini_set('session.use_only_cookies', '1');
10            session_set_cookie_params([
11                'lifetime' => 0, 'path' => '/',
12                'secure' => !empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off',
13                'httponly' => true, 'samesite' => 'Lax',
14            ]);
15        }
16        if (PHP_SAPI !== 'cli' && !headers_sent()) {
17            header_remove('X-Powered-By');
18            header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
19            header('X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN');
20            header('Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin');
21            header("Content-Security-Policy: base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'");
22            header('Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()');
23        }
24    }
25
26    public static function startSession(): void
27    {
28        if (session_status() !== PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
29            self::configure();
30            session_start();
31        }
32    }
33
34    public static function fail(int $status, string $message): void
35    {
36        http_response_code($status);
37        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
38        header('Cache-Control: no-store');
39        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'response' => false, 'error' => $message], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
40        exit;
41    }
42
43    public static function post(): void
44    {
45        if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST') {
46            header('Allow: POST');
47            self::fail(405, 'Use POST for this request.');
48        }
49    }
50
51    public static function csrfToken(): string
52    {
53        self::startSession();
54        if (empty($_SESSION['dot63_csrf_token'])) {
55            $_SESSION['dot63_csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
56        }
57        return $_SESSION['dot63_csrf_token'];
58    }
59
60    public static function csrf(array $data = []): void
61    {
62        self::post();
63        self::startSession();
64        $token = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_DOT63_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? $data['_csrf'] ?? '';
65        $expected = $_SESSION['dot63_csrf_token'] ?? '';
66        if (!is_string($token) || !is_string($expected) || $expected === '' || !hash_equals($expected, $token)) {
67            self::fail(419, 'Your session expired. Refresh the page and try again.');
68        }
69    }
70
71    public static function supplierEmail(): string
72    {
73        self::startSession();
74        $email = $_SESSION['email'] ?? '';
75        if (empty($_SESSION['login']) || !is_string($email) || !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
76            self::fail(401, 'Please sign in as a supplier.');
77        }
78        return strtolower(trim($email));
79    }
80
81    public static function reviewer(): void
82    {
83        self::startSession();
84        if (($_SESSION['is_logged'] ?? false) !== true || empty($_SESSION['user_email'])) {
85            self::fail(401, 'Please sign in to Promoflow.');
86        }
87    }
88
89    public static function assetUrl(string $path): string
90    {
91        $root = dirname(__DIR__, 2);
92        $script = realpath($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '') ?: '';
93        $name = $_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'] ?? '';
94        $suffix = substr($script, strlen($root));
95        $base = strpos($script, $root . '/') === 0 && $suffix !== '' && substr($name, -strlen($suffix)) === $suffix
96            ? substr($name, 0, -strlen($suffix)) : '';
97        return htmlspecialchars($base . '/' . ltrim($path, '/'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
98    }
99}
100Dot63Security::configure();

1(() => {
2  if (window.dot63SecureFetch) return;
3  const originalFetch = window.fetch.bind(window);
4  const root = new URL('../../../', document.currentScript.src);
5  const tokenURL = new URL('controller/security/csrf.php', root);
6  let tokenPromise;
7  const token = () => tokenPromise ||= originalFetch(tokenURL, { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store' })
8    .then(async response => {
9      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Unable to verify your session. Refresh the page.');
10      const data = await response.json();
11      if (typeof data.token !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(data.token)) throw new Error('Invalid session response.');
12      return data.token;
13    }).catch(error => { tokenPromise = null; throw error; });
14  window.fetch = async (input, options = {}) => {
15    const requestURL = new URL(input instanceof Request ? input.url : input, location.href);
16    const method = String(options.method || (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase();
17    if (requestURL.origin !== root.origin || !requestURL.pathname.startsWith(root.pathname + 'controller/')
18        || ['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'].includes(method)) return originalFetch(input, options);
19    const headers = new Headers(options.headers || (input instanceof Request ? input.headers : undefined));
20    headers.set('X-Dot63-CSRF-Token', await token());
21    const response = await originalFetch(input, { ...options, headers });
22    if (response.status === 419) tokenPromise = null;
23    return response;
24  };
25  window.dot63SecureFetch = true;
26})();

15            return;

20                'mysql:host=%s;port=%d;dbname=%s;charset=utf8mb4',
21                $config['host'],
22                $config['port'],
23                $config['name']
24            );
25            $this->connection = new PDO($dsn, $config['user'], $config['password'], [
26                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
27                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
28                PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => true,
29            ]);
30        } catch (PDOException $error) {
31            error_log('Database connection failed: ' . $error->getMessage());
32        }
33    }
34
35    public function getConnection(): PDO
36    {
37        if (!$this->connection instanceof PDO) {
38            if (PHP_SAPI !== 'cli') {
39                Dot63Security::fail(503, 'The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.');
40            }
41            throw new RuntimeException('The database connection is unavailable.');
42        }
43        return $this->connection;
44    }
45
46    public function closeConnection(): void

/Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/htdocs/Dot63_v1/controller/config/database_config.php · 85 lines · Back to index

1<?php
2
3declare(strict_types=1);
4
5final class DatabaseConfig
6{
7    public static function load(string $directory, bool $allowLocalDefaults = false): array
8    {
9        $config = [];
10        $file = $directory . '/database.local.php';
11        $hasLocalFile = is_file($file);
12        if ($hasLocalFile) {
13            if (!defined('DOT63_DATABASE_CONFIG_ALLOWED')) {
14                define('DOT63_DATABASE_CONFIG_ALLOWED', true);
15            }
16            $config = require $file;
17            if (!is_array($config)) {
18                throw new RuntimeException('Dot63 database.local.php must return a configuration array.');
19            }
20        }
21
22        $hasEnvironment = false;
23        foreach (['host', 'name', 'user', 'password', 'port'] as $key) {
24            $name = 'DOT63_DB_' . strtoupper($key);
25            $value = self::environmentValue($name);
26            if ($value !== false) {
27                $config[$key] = $value;
28                $hasEnvironment = true;
29            }
30        }
31
32        if (!$hasLocalFile && !$hasEnvironment && $allowLocalDefaults) {
33            $config = ['host' => '127.0.0.1', 'name' => 'dot63', 'user' => 'root', 'password' => ''];
34        }
35
36        $missing = [];
37        foreach (['host', 'name', 'user', 'password'] as $key) {
38            if (!isset($config[$key]) || !is_string($config[$key])
39                || ($key !== 'password' && trim($config[$key]) === '')) {
40                $missing[] = 'DOT63_DB_' . strtoupper($key);
41                continue;
42            }
43            if ($key !== 'password') {
44                $config[$key] = trim($config[$key]);
45            }
46        }
47        if ($missing) {
48            // Log variable names only; never include credential values.
49            throw new RuntimeException(
50                'Dot63 database credentials are incomplete. Missing or invalid: ' . implode(', ', $missing)
51                . '. Configure the PHP environment or controller/config/database.local.php.'
52            );
53        }
54
55        // Do not let configuration values inject additional PDO DSN parameters.
56        foreach (['host', 'name'] as $key) {
57            if (preg_match('/[;\x00\r\n]/', $config[$key])) {
58                throw new RuntimeException('Dot63 database host or name contains invalid characters.');
59            }
60        }
61        $config['port'] = filter_var($config['port'] ?? 3306, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, [
62            'options' => ['min_range' => 1, 'max_range' => 65535],
63        ]);
64        if ($config['port'] === false) {
65            throw new RuntimeException('Dot63 database port must be between 1 and 65535.');
66        }
67
68        return $config;
69    }
70
71    private static function environmentValue(string $name)
72    {
73        // Apache may prefix variables after internal redirects. Never read HTTP_ headers.
74        foreach ([$name, 'REDIRECT_' . $name, 'REDIRECT_REDIRECT_' . $name] as $candidate) {
75            $value = getenv($candidate);
76            if ($value === false) {
77                $value = $_ENV[$candidate] ?? $_SERVER[$candidate] ?? false;
78            }
79            if ($value !== false) {
80                return $value;
81            }
82        }
83        return false;
84    }
85}

1/*
2 * MAPA DEL PREVIEW DEL PROVEEDOR
3 * 3. Este archivo coordina todos los módulos.
4 * 4. Se pide el producto al servidor.
5 * 5. Se guarda y se pinta la información general.
6 * 6. Se recorre el árbol de variaciones.
7 * 7. Se pintan los recursos de la ruta seleccionada.
8 * 8. Se calcula el precio.
9 * 9. La pantalla queda lista para interacciones.
10 * 10. El proveedor vuelve a editar o envía el producto para aprobación.
11 */
12
13// [Supplier 3.1] preview.php añadió una versión a esta URL. La reutilizamos en cada import
14// para que todos los archivos pertenezcan a la misma versión y no se mezclen módulos de caché.
15const moduleVersion = new URL(import.meta.url).searchParams.get("v") || "1";
16const versionedModule = path => {
17  const url = new URL(path, import.meta.url);
18  url.searchParams.set("v", moduleVersion);
19  return url.href;
20};
21
22// [Supplier 3.2] Los ocho módulos son independientes al descargarse, por eso se cargan en paralelo.
23// Promise.all espera a que estén todos listos antes de crear la aplicación.
24const [{
25  PreviewApi
26}, {
27  PreviewStore
28}, {
29  PreviewGallery
30}, {
31  ImagesRenderer
32}, {
33  ItemsRenderer
34}, {
35  ArtworkRenderer
36}, {
37  PricesController
38}, {
39  VariationsController
40}] = await Promise.all([import(versionedModule("./preview_api.js")), import(versionedModule("./preview_store.js")), import(versionedModule("./preview.js")), import(versionedModule("../images/images.js")), import(versionedModule("../items/items.js")), import(versionedModule("../artwork/artwork.js")), import(versionedModule("../prices/prices.js")), import(versionedModule("../variations/variations.js"))]);
41
42// [Supplier 3.3] Esta clase es el coordinador: no hace todo por sí sola, sino que conecta API,
43// estado, galería, renderizadores, precios y variaciones en un único flujo legible.
44export class SupplierPreviewApp {
45  constructor(options = {}) {
46    this.previewAction = options.previewAction || "get_supplier_preview";
47    // [Supplier 3.3.1] El SKU de la URL identifica el producto que se debe consultar.
48    this.params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
49    this.sku = String(this.params.get("sku") || "").trim();
50
51    // [Supplier 3.3.2] API se comunica con PHP y Store conserva el estado compartido en memoria.
52    this.api = new PreviewApi(options);
53    this.store = new PreviewStore();
54    this.loadController = null;
55    this.submitController = null;
56
57    // [Supplier 3.3.3] Cada módulo recibe solo las dependencias que necesita.
58    this.gallery = new PreviewGallery();
59    this.images = new ImagesRenderer();
60    this.items = new ItemsRenderer();
61    this.artwork = new ArtworkRenderer();
62    this.prices = new PricesController({
63      api: this.api,
64      store: this.store,
65      getSku: () => this.sku,
66      variationPricesAction: options.variationPricesAction
67    });
68    this.variations = new VariationsController({
69      api: this.api,
70      store: this.store,
71      prices: this.prices,
72      variationChildrenAction: options.variationChildrenAction,
73      renderPath: () => this.renderSelectedPath(),
74      onError: message => this.showMessage(message, "error")
75    });
76
77    // [Supplier 3.3.4] Guardamos una sola referencia a cada elemento importante del DOM.
78    // Esto evita repetir búsquedas y permite que los métodos posteriores sean más fáciles de leer.
79    this.elements = {
80      loading: document.getElementById("preview_loading"),
81      content: document.getElementById("preview_content"),
82      fatal: document.getElementById("preview_fatal"),
83      fatalMessage: document.getElementById("preview_fatal_message"),
84      notice: document.getElementById("preview_notice"),
85      publish: document.getElementById("btn_publish"),
86      back: document.getElementById("btn_back_edit"),
87      status: document.getElementById("product_status"),
88      readiness: document.getElementById("readiness_list"),
89      readinessSummary: document.getElementById("readiness_summary"),
90      itemsSection: document.getElementById("items_section"),
91      artworkSection: document.getElementById("artwork_section")
92    };
93    {
94      // [Supplier 3.4] Los eventos se conectan una sola vez al construir la aplicación.
95      this.elements.back?.addEventListener("click", () => this.goBack());
96      this.elements.publish?.addEventListener("click", () => this.submitForApproval());
97    }
98    if (options.autoLoad !== false) this.getProduct();
99  }
100
101  async getProduct() {
102    // [Supplier 3.5] La inicialización es el primer proceso que se ejecuta al final de este archivo.
103    // Sin SKU no existe una consulta segura que hacer, así que mostramos un error y terminamos.
104    if (!this.sku) {
105      this.showFatal("The product SKU is missing from this preview link.");
106      return;
107    }
108    this.setLoading(true);
109    if (this.elements.fatal) this.elements.fatal.hidden = true;
110    this.loadController?.abort();
111    this.loadController = new AbortController();
112    try {
113      // [Supplier 4] El método consulta el producto con su makeRequest local.
114      const payload = await this.makeRequest(this.api.previewUrl, {
115        action: this.previewAction,
116        sku: this.sku
117      }, {
118        requireSuccess: true,
119        signal: this.loadController.signal
120      });
121
122      // [Supplier 5] Con una respuesta válida guardamos el producto y pintamos sus datos generales.
123      this.store.setProduct(payload);
124      this.renderProduct(payload);
125
126      // [Supplier 6] Después recorremos las variaciones desde la raíz. Este proceso también elige
127      // opciones predeterminadas y dispara los pasos 7 y 8 en cada cambio de ruta.
128      await this.variations.loadRoot(payload.root_variation_id);
129
130      // [Supplier 9] Solo mostramos la pantalla completa cuando producto, opciones y precio inicial
131      // ya están coordinados. Así el proveedor no ve una interfaz incompleta durante la carga.
132      this.setLoading(false);
133    } catch (error) {
134      // [Supplier 4.1] AbortError significa que una solicitud anterior fue reemplazada; no es un fallo visible.
135      if (error.name === "AbortError") return;
136      this.showFatal(error.message || "The product preview could not be loaded.", error.status === 401);
137    }
138  }
139
140  renderProduct(payload) {
141    // [Supplier 5.1] Normalizamos valores opcionales para que la interfaz nunca muestre undefined.
142    const product = payload.product || {};
143    const category = product.category?.name || "Uncategorised";
144    const group = product.group?.name || "No group";
145    this.setText("sp_category", category);
146    this.setText("sp-title", product.name || "Untitled product");
147    this.setText("sp-brand", product.supplier_name || "Supplier");
148    this.setText("sp_subtitle", product.tagline || "No product tagline has been added yet.");
149    this.setText("sp_desc", product.description || "No product description has been added yet.");
150    this.setText("product_sku", product.sku || this.sku);
151
152    // [Supplier 5.2] Las migas se construyen con textContent, por lo que los datos del servidor
153    // se muestran como texto y no se interpretan como HTML.
154    const breadcrumbs = document.getElementById("sp_breadcrumbs");
155    if (breadcrumbs) {
156      breadcrumbs.innerHTML = "";
157      [category, group, product.name || "Preview"].forEach((label, index, values) => {
158        const item = document.createElement("li");
159        const text = document.createElement("span");
160        text.textContent = label;
161        if (index === values.length - 1) text.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
162        item.appendChild(text);
163        breadcrumbs.appendChild(item);
164      });
165    }
166
167    // [Supplier 5.3] El estado y checklist determinan si el botón de aprobación puede habilitarse.
168    this.renderStatus(product);
169    this.renderReadiness(payload.readiness || {});
170    const canSubmit = Boolean(payload.permissions?.can_submit);
171    const approvalAvailable = payload.permissions?.approval_available !== false;
172    if (this.elements.publish) {
173      this.elements.publish.hidden = product.pending_status != null || Number(product.status) !== 0;
174      this.elements.publish.disabled = !canSubmit;
175      this.elements.publish.title = !approvalAvailable ? "Approval requests are temporarily unavailable" : canSubmit ? "Submit this product for approval" : "Complete every readiness check before submitting";
176    }
177    if (!approvalAvailable && Number(product.status) === 0) {
178      this.showMessage("Approval requests are temporarily unavailable. You can still preview and edit this product.", "info");
179    }
180  }
181
182  renderStatus(product) {
183    // [Supplier 5.3.1] Traducimos los valores del servidor a una etiqueta y tono entendibles.
184    if (!this.elements.status) return;
185    let label = product.status_label || "Draft";
186    let tone = Number(product.status) === 0 ? "draft" : "approved";
187    if (product.pending_status != null) {
188      label = `Awaiting approval: ${product.pending_status_label}`;
189      tone = "pending";
190    }
191    this.elements.status.textContent = label;
192    this.elements.status.dataset.tone = tone;
193  }
194
195  renderReadiness(readiness) {
196    // [Supplier 5.3.2] Cada requisito se pinta como completo o pendiente.
197    if (!this.elements.readiness) return;
198    this.elements.readiness.innerHTML = "";
199    const checks = Array.isArray(readiness.checks) ? readiness.checks : [];
200    for (const check of checks) {
201      const item = document.createElement("li");
202      item.className = check.complete ? "is-complete" : "is-incomplete";
203      const icon = document.createElement("span");
204      icon.className = "readiness-icon";
205      icon.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
206      icon.textContent = check.complete ? "✓" : "!";
207      const label = document.createElement("span");
208      label.textContent = check.label;
209      item.append(icon, label);
210      this.elements.readiness.appendChild(item);
211    }
212    if (this.elements.readinessSummary) {
213      this.elements.readinessSummary.textContent = readiness.complete ? "Ready to submit for approval" : `${readiness.issues?.length || 0} item${readiness.issues?.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} need attention`;
214      this.elements.readinessSummary.classList.toggle("is-ready", Boolean(readiness.complete));
215    }
216  }
217
218  renderSelectedPath() {
219    // [Supplier 7] VariationsController llama este método cada vez que cambia una selección.
220    // Primero se elimina la representación anterior para reconstruir una vista coherente.
221    this.images.clear();
222    this.items.clear();
223    this.artwork.clear();
224    this.gallery.clear();
225    const imageKeys = new Set();
226    const itemKeys = new Set();
227    let renderedItems = 0;
228    let renderedArtwork = 0;
229
230    // [Supplier 7.1] Store devuelve la raíz y todas las variaciones elegidas en orden.
231    const selectedRows = this.store.getSelectedRows();
232    for (const row of selectedRows) {
233      const variation = row?.variation || {};
234      const variationName = String(variation.name || "").trim();
235
236      // [Supplier 7.2] Una imagen o item puede venir repetido desde varios niveles.
237      // Los Set permiten pintar cada recurso una sola vez.
238      const uniqueImages = (Array.isArray(row?.images) ? row.images : []).filter(image => {
239        const key = String(image?.image_id ?? image?.link ?? "");
240        if (!key || imageKeys.has(key)) return false;
241        imageKeys.add(key);
242        return true;
243      });
244
245      // [Supplier 7.3.1] ImagesRenderer crea las imágenes de este nivel.
246      this.images.render(uniqueImages, {
247        productName: this.store.product?.name,
248        variationName
249      });
250      const uniqueItems = (Array.isArray(row?.items) ? row.items : []).filter(item => {
251        const key = String(item?.item_id ?? `${item?.name}:${item?.description}`);
252        if (!key || itemKeys.has(key)) return false;
253        itemKeys.add(key);
254        return true;
255      });
256      // [Supplier 7.3.2] ItemsRenderer agrega datos complementarios del producto.
257      renderedItems += this.items.render(uniqueItems);
258      if (row?.artwork) {
259        // [Supplier 7.3.3] ArtworkRenderer agrega el PDF asociado, si existe.
260        renderedArtwork += this.artwork.render(row.artwork, {
261          variationName
262        }) ? 1 : 0;
263      }
264    }
265
266    // [Supplier 7.4] Si no hubo imágenes se pinta el estado vacío; luego la galería
267    // vuelve a leer sus elementos y comienza desde la primera imagen.
268    this.images.renderEmpty();
269    this.gallery.refresh({
270      keepIndex: false
271    });
272    if (this.elements.itemsSection) this.elements.itemsSection.hidden = renderedItems === 0;
273    if (this.elements.artworkSection) this.elements.artworkSection.hidden = renderedArtwork === 0;
274
275    // [Supplier 7.5] El precio base viene del nivel seleccionado más específico que use
276    // price_display_mode="prices". Las opciones con modo "variation" son extras.
277    const priceSource = [...selectedRows].reverse().find(row => {
278      return String(row?.variation?.price_display_mode ?? "prices") === "prices" && Array.isArray(row?.prices) && row.prices.length > 0;
279    });
280    if (priceSource) {
281      // [Supplier 8] PricesController pinta los rangos, selecciona uno y calcula el resumen.
282      const rows = priceSource.prices.map(price => ({
283        ...price,
284        price_display_mode: priceSource.variation?.price_display_mode || "prices"
285      }));
286      this.prices.render(rows);
287    } else {
288      this.prices.clear();
289    }
290  }
291
292  async submitForApproval() {
293    // [Supplier 10.1] El envío solo continúa si el backend ya confirmó que todos los requisitos se cumplen.
294    if (!this.store.permissions?.can_submit || !this.elements.publish) return;
295    this.submitController?.abort();
296    this.submitController = new AbortController();
297    this.elements.publish.disabled = true;
298    this.elements.publish.classList.add("is-loading");
299    this.showMessage("Submitting your product for approval…", "info");
300    try {
301      // [Supplier 10.2] PreviewApi envía el SKU a controller/products/product.php.
302      const result = await this.makeRequest(this.api.productUrl, {
303        action: "publish_product",
304        sku: this.sku,
305        status_request_version: this.store.product.status_request_version
306      }, {
307        requireSuccess: true,
308        signal: this.submitController.signal
309      });
310
311      // [Supplier 10.4] Cuando PHP confirma el envío, actualizamos el estado local sin recargar la página.
312      Object.assign(this.store.product, result.data);
313      this.store.permissions.can_submit = false;
314      this.renderStatus(this.store.product);
315      this.elements.publish.hidden = true;
316      this.showMessage(result.message || "Product submitted for approval.", "success");
317    } catch (error) {
318      // [Supplier 10.5] Si falla, mantenemos el producto editable y explicamos qué falta.
319      if (error.name !== "AbortError") {
320        const missing = Array.isArray(error.details?.missing) ? ` Missing: ${error.details.missing.join(", ")}.` : "";
321        this.showMessage(`${error.message}${missing}`, "error");
322        this.elements.publish.disabled = false;
323      }
324    } finally {
325      this.elements.publish.classList.remove("is-loading");
326    }
327  }
328
329  goBack() {
330    // [Supplier 10.6] Volvemos al editor conservando el SKU del producto y, si existe,
331    // el SKU de la variación más profunda que estaba seleccionada.
332    const destination = new URL("../../view/product_details/index.php", window.location.href);
333    destination.searchParams.set("sku", this.sku);
334    const selected = [...this.store.getSelectedRows()].reverse().find(row => row?.variation?.SKU);
335    const initialVariation = String(this.params.get("sku_variation") || "").trim();
336    const variationSku = String(selected?.variation?.SKU || initialVariation).trim();
337    if (variationSku) destination.searchParams.set("sku_variation", variationSku);
338    window.location.assign(destination);
339  }
340
341  // [Supplier 11] Estos métodos pequeños concentran cambios repetidos de interfaz.
342
343  setLoading(loading) {
344    if (this.elements.loading) this.elements.loading.hidden = !loading;
345    if (this.elements.content) this.elements.content.hidden = loading;
346  }
347
348  showFatal(message, showLogin = false) {
349    this.setLoading(false);
350    if (this.elements.content) this.elements.content.hidden = true;
351    if (this.elements.fatal) this.elements.fatal.hidden = false;
352    if (this.elements.fatalMessage) this.elements.fatalMessage.textContent = message;
353    const loginLink = document.getElementById("preview_login_link");
354    if (loginLink) loginLink.hidden = !showLogin;
355  }
356
357  showMessage(message, tone = "info") {
358    if (!this.elements.notice) return;
359    this.elements.notice.textContent = message;
360    this.elements.notice.dataset.tone = tone;
361    this.elements.notice.hidden = false;
362  }
363
364  setText(id, value) {
365    const element = document.getElementById(id);
366    if (element) element.textContent = String(value ?? "");
367  }
368
369  async makeRequest(url, data, options = {}) {
370    const {
371      requireSuccess = false,
372      responseType = "json",
373      ...requestOptions
374    } = options;
375    const isFormData = data instanceof FormData;
376    const headers = new Headers(requestOptions.headers || {});
377    if (!isFormData && !headers.has("Content-Type")) headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
378    const response = await fetch(url, {
379      method: "POST",
380      credentials: "same-origin",
381      ...requestOptions,
382      headers,
383      body: isFormData ? data : JSON.stringify(data)
384    });
385    const text = await response.text();
386    let result;
387    try {
388      result = responseType === "text" ? text : JSON.parse(text);
389    } catch {
390      const error = new Error("The server returned an invalid response.");
391      error.status = response.status;
392      throw error;
393    }
394    if (!response.ok || requireSuccess && !result?.success) {
395      const error = new Error(result?.error || result?.message || "The request could not be completed.");
396      error.status = response.status;
397      error.code = result?.code || null;
398      error.details = result;
399      throw error;
400    }
401    return result;
402  }
403}

5 * [Supplier/Customer 4.2, 6.2 y 8.3]

9class Product {
10  public function handleProduct(){
11    // [Servidor 4.2.1] PHP lee el JSON enviado por fetch y obtiene el nombre de la acción.
12    $input = file_get_contents('php://input');
13    $data  = json_decode($input, true);
14
15    switch ($data["action"] ?? null) {
16
17      case 'get_review_preview':
18      case 'get_review_variation_children':
19      case 'get_review_variation_prices':
20        $this->handleReview($data);
21        break;
22
23      case 'get_supplier_preview':
24        // [Supplier 4.2.2] Continúa en getSupplierPreview().
25        $this->getSupplierPreview($data);
26        break;
27
28      case 'get_supplier_variation_children':
29        // [Supplier 6.2.2.1] Continúa en getSupplierVariationChildren().
30        $this->getSupplierVariationChildren($data);
31        break;
32
33      case 'get_supplier_variation_prices':
34        // [Supplier 8.3.2.1] Continúa en getSupplierVariationPrices().
35        $this->getSupplierVariationPrices($data);
36        break;
37
38      case 'get_customer_preview':
39        // [Customer 4.2.2] Continúa en getCustomerPreview().
40        $this->getCustomerPreview($data);
41        break;
42
43      case 'get_customer_variation_children':
44        // [Customer 6.2.3.1] Continúa en getCustomerVariationChildren().
45        $this->getCustomerVariationChildren($data);
46        break;
47
48      case 'get_customer_variation_prices':
49        // [Customer 8.3.2.1] Continúa en getCustomerVariationPrices().
50        $this->getCustomerVariationPrices($data);
51        break;
52
53      case 'get_preview_product_details':
54        $this->getPreviewProductDetails($data);
55        break;
56      case 'get_variation_children_by_id':
57        $this->getVariationChildrenById($data);
58        break;
59
60        case 'get_variation_prices':
61          $this->getVariationPrices($data);
62          break;
63
64      default:
65        http_response_code(400);
66        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
67        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Unsupported action']);
68        break;
69    }

72  // Review access is checked here even when called directly instead of through Promoflow.
73  public function handleReview(array $data): void
74  {
75      if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST'
76          || stripos($_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '', 'application/json') !== 0) {
77          $this->jsonError('A JSON POST request is required.', 415);
78          return;
79      }
80      if (session_status() !== PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) Dot63Security::startSession();
81      $authorized = ($_SESSION['is_logged'] ?? false) === true && !empty($_SESSION['user_email']);
82      session_write_close();
83      if (!$authorized) {
84          $this->jsonError('Sign in to Promoflow to review this product.', 401);
85          return;
86      }
87      switch ($data['action'] ?? '') {
88          case 'get_review_preview': $this->getSupplierPreview($data, true); break;
89          case 'get_review_variation_children': $this->getSupplierVariationChildren($data, true); break;
90          case 'get_review_variation_prices': $this->getSupplierVariationPrices($data, true); break;
91          default: $this->jsonError('Unsupported review action.');
92      }
93  }

95  private function getSupplierSessionEmail(): ?string
96  {
97      // [Supplier servidor 4.2.3] Una sesión válida necesita la bandera de login y un email no vacío.
98      if (session_status() !== PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
99          Dot63Security::startSession();
100      }
101
102      $isLoggedIn = !empty($_SESSION['login']);
103      $email = strtolower(trim((string)($_SESSION['email'] ?? '')));
104      // Preview requests only read identity; release the session lock before database work.
105      session_write_close();
106
107      return ($isLoggedIn && $email !== '') ? $email : null;
108  }

110  private function jsonError(string $message, int $status = 400, array $extra = []): void
111  {
112      // [Servidor 4.2.4] Todos los fallos del preview usan la misma estructura JSON y status HTTP.
113      http_response_code($status);
114      header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
115      echo json_encode(array_merge([
116          'success' => false,
117          'error' => $message,
118      ], $extra), JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
119  }

121  private function getOwnedProduct(PDO $pdo, string $sku, ?string $email): ?array
122  {
123      // The supplier scope is omitted only after handleReview authenticates a Promoflow reviewer.
124      // También cuenta requisitos y resuelve la variación raíz en una sola ida a la base de datos.
125      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
126          SELECT
127              p.*,
128              p.SKU AS sku,
129              s.supplier_id,
130              s.company_name,
131              s.contact_name,
132              s.email AS supplier_email,
133              g.name AS group_name,
134              c.category_id,
135              c.name AS category_name,
136              (
137                  SELECT v.variation_id
138                  FROM variations v
139                  WHERE v.product_id = p.product_id
140                    AND (
141                      LOWER(TRIM(v.name)) = 'default'
142                      OR v.parent_id IS NULL
143                    )
144                  ORDER BY
145                    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(v.name)) = 'default' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
146                    v.variation_id ASC
147                  LIMIT 1
148              ) AS root_variation_id,
149              (
150                  SELECT COUNT(*)
151                  FROM variations v
152                  WHERE v.product_id = p.product_id
153                    AND v.type_id IS NOT NULL
154                    AND TRIM(COALESCE(v.name, '')) <> ''
155                    AND LOWER(TRIM(v.name)) <> 'default'
156              ) AS variations_count,
157              (
158                  SELECT COUNT(*)
159                  FROM images i
160                  INNER JOIN variations v ON v.variation_id = i.variation_id
161                  WHERE v.product_id = p.product_id
162                    AND TRIM(COALESCE(i.link, '')) <> ''
163              ) AS images_count,
164              (
165                  SELECT COUNT(*)
166                  FROM prices pr
167                  INNER JOIN variations v ON v.variation_id = pr.variation_id
168                  WHERE v.product_id = p.product_id
169                    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(v.price_display_mode), ''), 'prices') = 'prices'
170              ) AS prices_count
171          FROM products p
172          INNER JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
173          LEFT JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = p.group_id
174          LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = g.category_id
175          WHERE LOWER(TRIM(p.SKU)) = LOWER(:sku)
176            " . ($email === null ? '' : 'AND LOWER(TRIM(s.email)) = LOWER(:email)') . "
177          LIMIT 1
178      ");
179
180      $params = [':sku' => $sku];
181      if ($email !== null) $params[':email'] = $email;
182      $stmt->execute($params);
183
184      $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
185      return $row ?: null;
186  }
187
188  private function buildReadiness(array $product): array
189  {
190      // [Supplier servidor 4.2.6] Cada check resume un requisito real de publicación.
191      $checks = [
192          [
193              'key' => 'details',
194              'label' => 'Product details',
195              'complete' => trim((string)($product['name'] ?? '')) !== ''
196                  && trim((string)($product['description'] ?? '')) !== '',
197          ],
198          [
199              'key' => 'classification',
200              'label' => 'Category and group',
201              'complete' => !empty($product['category_id'])
202                  && !empty($product['group_id'])
203                  && ($product['category_name'] ?? '') !== 'Unassigned Category'
204                  && ($product['group_name'] ?? '') !== 'Unassigned Group',
205          ],
206          [
207              'key' => 'variations',
208              'label' => 'Product variations',
209              'complete' => (int)($product['variations_count'] ?? 0) > 0,
210          ],
211          [
212              'key' => 'images',
213              'label' => 'Product imagery',
214              'complete' => (int)($product['images_count'] ?? 0) > 0,
215          ],
216          [
217              'key' => 'pricing',
218              'label' => 'Pricing',
219              'complete' => (int)($product['prices_count'] ?? 0) > 0,
220          ],
221      ];
222
223      $issues = [];
224      // [Supplier servidor 4.2.7] issues contiene solo las etiquetas pendientes que verá la interfaz.
225      foreach ($checks as $check) {
226          if (!$check['complete']) {
227              $issues[] = $check['label'];
228          }
229      }
230
231      return [
232          'complete' => empty($issues),
233          'checks' => $checks,
234          'issues' => $issues,
235      ];
236  }

238  private function getSupplierPreview(array $data, bool $review = false): void
239  {
240      // [Supplier 4.2.2] Este método arma la primera respuesta del preview privado.
241      header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
242
243      // [Supplier 4.2.2.1] Primero se valida sesión; después el SKU recibido.
244      $email = $review ? null : $this->getSupplierSessionEmail();
245      if (!$review && $email === null) {
246          $this->jsonError('Your supplier session has expired. Please sign in again.', 401);
247          return;
248      }
249
250      $sku = trim((string)($data['sku'] ?? ''));
251      if ($sku === '') {
252          $this->jsonError('Product SKU is required.');
253          return;
254      }
255
256      $database = new Database();
257      $pdo = $database->getConnection();
258
259      // [Supplier 4.2.2.2] La consulta devuelve null si el producto no existe o pertenece a otra cuenta.
260      $product = $this->getOwnedProduct($pdo, $sku, $email);
261
262      if (!$product) {
263          $this->jsonError('This product was not found or does not belong to your account.', 403);
264          return;
265      }
266
267      // [Supplier 4.2.2.3] Se calculan estado, checklist y permiso de envío antes de responder.
268      $readiness = $this->buildReadiness($product);
269      $isApproved = (int)$product['is_approved'] === 1;
270      // Previewing remains available on databases that predate status requests.
271      // Never offer a write operation until its required fields exist.
272      $approvalAvailable = array_key_exists('pending_status', $product)
273          && array_key_exists('status_request_version', $product)
274          && array_key_exists('status_requested_at', $product);
275      $product = array_merge($product, ProductStatus::describe($product));
276      $isPending = $product['pending_status'] !== null;
277
278      // [Supplier 4.3] preview_api.js recibe producto, root_variation_id, readiness y permissions.
279      echo json_encode([
280          'success' => true,
281          'product' => [
282              'id' => (int)$product['product_id'],
283              'sku' => (string)$product['sku'],
284              'name' => (string)($product['name'] ?? ''),
285              'description' => (string)($product['description'] ?? ''),
286              'tagline' => (string)($product['descriptive_tagline'] ?? ''),
287              'status' => $product['status'],
288              'status_label' => $product['status_label'],
289              'pending_status' => $product['pending_status'],
290              'pending_status_label' => $product['pending_status_label'],
291              'status_request_version' => $product['status_request_version'],
292              'is_approved' => $isApproved,
293              'supplier_name' => (string)($product['company_name'] ?: $product['contact_name']),
294              'category' => [
295                  'id' => (int)($product['category_id'] ?? 0),
296                  'name' => (string)($product['category_name'] ?? ''),
297              ],
298              'group' => [
299                  'id' => (int)($product['group_id'] ?? 0),
300                  'name' => (string)($product['group_name'] ?? ''),
301              ],
302          ],
303          'delivery_catalog' => DeliveryOptions::catalog($pdo, (int)$product['product_id']),
304          'root_variation_id' => (int)($product['root_variation_id'] ?? 0),
305          'readiness' => $readiness,
306          'permissions' => [
307              'can_edit' => !$review,
308              'can_approve' => $review && $approvalAvailable && $isPending
309                  && ($product['pending_status'] === 0 || $readiness['complete']),
310              'approval_available' => $approvalAvailable,
311              'can_submit' => !$review && $approvalAvailable && $product['status'] === 0 && !$isPending && $readiness['complete'],
312          ],
313      ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
314  }

316  private function getOwnedVariationProduct(PDO $pdo, int $variationId, ?string $email): ?array
317  {
318      // [Supplier servidor 6.2.2.2] Cada nodo debe pertenecer también al proveedor autenticado.
319      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
320          SELECT p.product_id, p.SKU AS sku
321          FROM variations v
322          INNER JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id
323          INNER JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
324          WHERE v.variation_id = :variation_id
325            " . ($email === null ? '' : 'AND LOWER(TRIM(s.email)) = LOWER(:email)') . "
326          LIMIT 1
327      ");
328      $params = [':variation_id' => $variationId];
329      if ($email !== null) $params[':email'] = $email;
330      $stmt->execute($params);
331      $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
332      return $row ?: null;
333  }

335  private function getSupplierVariationChildren(array $data, bool $review = false): void
336  {
337      // [Supplier 6.2.2.1] Este método responde una etapa del recorrido de variaciones.
338      header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
339
340      // [Supplier 6.2.2.1.1] Se repiten las validaciones porque cada fetch es una petición independiente.
341      $email = $review ? null : $this->getSupplierSessionEmail();
342      if (!$review && $email === null) {
343          $this->jsonError('Your supplier session has expired.', 401);
344          return;
345      }
346
347      $variationId = (int)($data['variation_id'] ?? 0);
348      if ($variationId <= 0) {
349          $this->jsonError('A valid variation is required.');
350          return;
351      }
352
353      $database = new Database();
354      $pdo = $database->getConnection();
355
356      if (!$this->getOwnedVariationProduct($pdo, $variationId, $email)) {
357          $this->jsonError('This variation does not belong to your account.', 403);
358          return;
359      }
360
361      $variation = new Variation($database);
362      $variation->setVariationId($variationId);
363
364      // [Supplier 6.2.2.3] El flujo entra en model/variations.php para cargar:
365      // hijos enriquecidos, datos del nodo actual y nombres de los tipos hijos.
366      $childVariations = $variation->getVariationChildrenById();
367      $currentVariationData = $variation->getDetailsCurrentVariationById();
368      $variationTypes = $variation->getTypeVariationsChildByVariationId();
369
370      if (isset($childVariations['success']) && $childVariations['success'] === false) {
371          $this->jsonError((string)($childVariations['error'] ?? 'Unable to load variations.'), 500);
372          return;
373      }
374
375      if (isset($currentVariationData['success']) && $currentVariationData['success'] === false) {
376          $this->jsonError((string)($currentVariationData['error'] ?? 'Unable to load the selected variation.'), 500);
377          return;
378      }
379
380      if (isset($variationTypes['success']) && $variationTypes['success'] === false) {
381          $this->jsonError((string)($variationTypes['error'] ?? 'Unable to load variation types.'), 500);
382          return;
383      }
384
385      if (($childVariations['success'] ?? null) === true && isset($childVariations['data'])) {
386          $childVariations = is_array($childVariations['data']) ? $childVariations['data'] : [];
387      }
388
389      // [Supplier 6.2.2.4] Se normalizan listas y se devuelve una estructura estable al navegador.
390      echo json_encode([
391          'success' => true,
392          'current' => $currentVariationData,
393          'children' => array_values(is_array($childVariations) ? $childVariations : []),
394          'types' => array_values(is_array($variationTypes) ? $variationTypes : []),
395      ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
396  }
397
398  private function getSupplierVariationPrices(array $data, bool $review = false): void
399  {
400      // [Supplier 8.3.2.1] Este método calcula extras para una cantidad concreta.
401      header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
402
403      $email = $review ? null : $this->getSupplierSessionEmail();
404      if (!$review && $email === null) {
405          $this->jsonError('Your supplier session has expired.', 401);
406          return;
407      }
408
409      // [Supplier 8.3.2.1.1] Se limpian el SKU, la cantidad y los IDs duplicados/no válidos.
410      $sku = trim((string)($data['sku'] ?? ''));
411      $quantity = (int)($data['quantity'] ?? 0);
412      $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(
413          array_map('intval', is_array($data['ids'] ?? null) ? $data['ids'] : []),
414          fn($id) => $id > 0
415      )));
416
417      if ($sku === '' || $quantity <= 0 || empty($ids)) {
418          $this->jsonError('Product, quantity and variation IDs are required.');
419          return;
420      }
421
422      $database = new Database();
423      $pdo = $database->getConnection();
424      $product = $this->getOwnedProduct($pdo, $sku, $email);
425
426      if (!$product) {
427          $this->jsonError('This product does not belong to your account.', 403);
428          return;
429      }
430
431      // [Supplier 8.3.2.1.2] Una sola consulta busca los extras cuyo rango contiene la cantidad.
432      $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($ids), '?'));
433      $params = array_merge([(int)$product['product_id'], $quantity, $quantity], $ids);
434
435      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
436          SELECT
437              v.variation_id,
438              pr.price,
439              v.price_display_mode
440          FROM variations v
441          INNER JOIN prices pr ON pr.variation_id = v.variation_id
442          WHERE v.product_id = ?
443            AND ? >= pr.min_quantity
444            AND (pr.max_quantity IS NULL OR pr.max_quantity <= 0 OR ? <= pr.max_quantity)
445            AND v.variation_id IN ($placeholders)
446            AND v.price_display_mode = 'variation'
447          ORDER BY v.variation_id, pr.min_quantity DESC
448      ");
449      $stmt->execute($params);
450
451      // [Supplier 8.3.2.1.3] Conservamos el primer rango aplicable por variation_id.
452      $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
453      $pricesByVariation = [];
454      foreach ($rows as $row) {
455          $id = (int)$row['variation_id'];
456          if (!isset($pricesByVariation[$id])) {
457              $pricesByVariation[$id] = [
458                  'variation_id' => $id,
459                  'price' => (float)$row['price'],
460                  'price_display_mode' => (string)$row['price_display_mode'],
461              ];
462          }
463      }
464
465      $configuredStmt = $pdo->prepare("
466          SELECT DISTINCT v.variation_id
467          FROM variations v
468          INNER JOIN prices pr ON pr.variation_id = v.variation_id
469          WHERE v.product_id = ?
470            AND v.variation_id IN ($placeholders)
471            AND v.price_display_mode = 'variation'
472            AND pr.price > 0
473      ");
474      $configuredStmt->execute(array_merge([(int)$product['product_id']], $ids));
475
476      // Use the same availability information as the customer preview.
477      echo json_encode([
478          'success' => true,
479          'prices' => array_values($pricesByVariation),
480          'priced_variation_ids' => array_map('intval', $configuredStmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN)),
481      ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
482  }

484  private function getCustomerProduct(PDO $pdo, string $sku): ?array
485  {
486      // [Customer servidor 4.2.3] Solo un producto aprobado puede aparecer en el preview público.
487      // La misma consulta resuelve proveedor, clasificación y variación raíz.
488      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
489          SELECT
490              p.product_id,
491              p.SKU AS sku,
492              p.name,
493              p.description,
494              p.descriptive_tagline,
495              p.group_id,
496              s.company_name,
497              s.contact_name,
498              g.name AS group_name,
499              c.category_id,
500              c.name AS category_name,
501              (
502                  SELECT v.variation_id
503                  FROM variations v
504                  WHERE v.product_id = p.product_id
505                    AND (
506                      LOWER(TRIM(v.name)) = 'default'
507                      OR v.parent_id IS NULL
508                    )
509                  ORDER BY
510                    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(v.name)) = 'default' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
511                    v.variation_id ASC
512                  LIMIT 1
513              ) AS root_variation_id
514          FROM products p
515          INNER JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
516          LEFT JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = p.group_id
517          LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = g.category_id
518          WHERE LOWER(TRIM(p.SKU)) = LOWER(:sku)
519            AND p.is_approved = 1 AND p.status IN ('1', '2', '3')
520          LIMIT 1
521      ");
522      $stmt->execute([':sku' => $sku]);
523
524      $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
525      return $row ?: null;
526  }

573  private function getCustomerVariationChildren(array $data): void
574  {
575      // [Customer 6.2.3.1] Este método responde una etapa del recorrido público de variaciones.
576      header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
577
578      $variationId = (int)($data['variation_id'] ?? 0);
579      if ($variationId <= 0) {
580          $this->jsonError('A valid variation is required.');
581          return;
582      }
583
584      // [Customer 6.2.3.1.1] Aunque el cliente no inicia sesión, el nodo debe pertenecer a un producto aprobado.
585      $database = new Database();
586      $pdo = $database->getConnection();
587      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
588          SELECT p.product_id
589          FROM variations v
590          INNER JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id
591          WHERE v.variation_id = :variation_id
592            AND p.is_approved = 1 AND p.status IN ('1', '2', '3')
593          LIMIT 1
594      ");
595      $stmt->execute([':variation_id' => $variationId]);
596
597      if (!$stmt->fetchColumn()) {
598          $this->jsonError('This variation is unavailable.', 404);
599          return;
600      }
601
602      $variation = new Variation($database);
603      $variation->setVariationId($variationId);
604
605      // [Customer 6.2.3.3] El flujo entra en model/variations.php para cargar
606      // hijos enriquecidos, nodo actual y nombres de los tipos hijos.
607      $children = $variation->getVariationChildrenById();
608      $current = $variation->getDetailsCurrentVariationById();
609      $types = $variation->getTypeVariationsChildByVariationId();
610
611      if (isset($children['success']) && $children['success'] === false) {
612          $this->jsonError((string)($children['error'] ?? 'Unable to load variations.'), 500);
613          return;
614      }
615
616      if (isset($current['success']) && $current['success'] === false) {
617          $this->jsonError((string)($current['error'] ?? 'Unable to load the selected variation.'), 500);
618          return;
619      }
620
621      if (isset($types['success']) && $types['success'] === false) {
622          $this->jsonError((string)($types['error'] ?? 'Unable to load variation types.'), 500);
623          return;
624      }
625
626      if (($children['success'] ?? null) === true && isset($children['data'])) {
627          $children = is_array($children['data']) ? $children['data'] : [];
628      }
629
630      // [Customer 6.2.3.4] Se normalizan listas y se devuelve una estructura estable al navegador.
631      echo json_encode([
632          'success' => true,
633          'current' => $current,
634          'children' => array_values(is_array($children) ? $children : []),
635          'types' => array_values(is_array($types) ? $types : []),
636      ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

639  private function getCustomerVariationPrices(array $data): void
640  {
641      // [Customer 8.3.2.1] Este método calcula extras y disponibilidad para una cantidad concreta.
642      header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
643
644      // [Customer 8.3.2.1.1] Se limpian el SKU, la cantidad y los IDs duplicados/no válidos.
645      $sku = trim((string)($data['sku'] ?? ''));
646      $quantity = (int)($data['quantity'] ?? 0);
647      $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(
648          array_map('intval', is_array($data['ids'] ?? null) ? $data['ids'] : []),
649          fn($id) => $id > 0
650      )));
651
652      if ($sku === '' || $quantity <= 0 || empty($ids)) {
653          $this->jsonError('Product, quantity and variation IDs are required.');
654          return;
655      }
656
657      $database = new Database();
658      $pdo = $database->getConnection();
659      $product = $this->getCustomerProduct($pdo, $sku);
660
661      if (!$product) {
662          $this->jsonError('This product is unavailable.', 404);
663          return;
664      }
665
666      // [Customer 8.3.2.1.2] La primera consulta devuelve precios cuyo rango sí contiene la cantidad.
667      $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($ids), '?'));
668      $params = array_merge([(int)$product['product_id'], $quantity, $quantity], $ids);
669
670      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
671          SELECT
672              v.variation_id,
673              pr.price,
674              v.price_display_mode
675          FROM variations v
676          INNER JOIN prices pr ON pr.variation_id = v.variation_id
677          WHERE v.product_id = ?
678            AND ? >= pr.min_quantity
679            AND (pr.max_quantity IS NULL OR pr.max_quantity <= 0 OR ? <= pr.max_quantity)
680            AND v.variation_id IN ($placeholders)
681            AND v.price_display_mode = 'variation'
682          ORDER BY v.variation_id, pr.min_quantity DESC
683      ");
684      $stmt->execute($params);
685
686      $pricesByVariation = [];
687      foreach ($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $row) {
688          $id = (int)$row['variation_id'];
689          if (!isset($pricesByVariation[$id])) {
690              $pricesByVariation[$id] = [
691                  'variation_id' => $id,
692                  'price' => (float)$row['price'],
693                  'price_display_mode' => (string)$row['price_display_mode'],
694              ];
695          }
696      }
697
698      // [Customer 8.3.2.1.3] La segunda distingue una opción gratis de una opción pagada sin rango aplicable.
699      $configuredStmt = $pdo->prepare("
700          SELECT DISTINCT v.variation_id
701          FROM variations v
702          INNER JOIN prices pr ON pr.variation_id = v.variation_id
703          WHERE v.product_id = ?
704            AND v.variation_id IN ($placeholders)
705            AND v.price_display_mode = 'variation'
706            AND pr.price > 0
707      ");
708      $configuredStmt->execute(array_merge([(int)$product['product_id']], $ids));
709      $pricedVariationIds = array_map('intval', $configuredStmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN));
710
711      // [Customer 8.3.2.2] El navegador recibe precios aplicables y IDs con precio configurado.
712      echo json_encode([
713          'success' => true,
714          'prices' => array_values($pricesByVariation),
715          'priced_variation_ids' => $pricedVariationIds,
716      ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
717  }
