136  public function getVariationChildrenById(): array
137  {
138    // [Supplier 6.2.2.3.1 / Customer 6.2.3.3.1]
139    // Este método sigue sus propios subpasos 1-28: carga todos los hijos y, en bloque,
140    // sus artworks, imágenes, items, precios y nombres de tipo para evitar una consulta por hijo.
141    // 1) Obtener el variation_id actual del objeto y convertirlo a entero.
142    //    Si no existe, se usa 0 por defecto.
143    $parentVariationId = (int)($this->variation_id ?? 0);
144
145    // 2) Validar que el variation_id sea válido.
146    //    Si es 0 o menor, significa que no llegó un id correcto.
147    if ($parentVariationId <= 0) {
148      return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'variation_id requerido'];
149    }
150
151    try {
152      // 3) Obtener la conexión PDO a la base de datos.
153      $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
154
155      // 4) Validar que la variación padre realmente exista en la tabla variations.
156      //    Esto evita hacer consultas sobre un parent_id inexistente.
157      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
158        SELECT variations.variation_id
159        FROM variations
160        WHERE variations.variation_id = :id
161        LIMIT 1
162      ");
163      $stmt->execute([':id' => $parentVariationId]);
164
165      // 5) fetchColumn() devuelve el valor de la primera columna encontrada.
166      //    Si no existe, devolverá false y al convertirlo a int será 0.
167      $exists = (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();
168
169      // 6) Si no existe la variación padre, devolver error.
170      if (!$exists) {
171        return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Variación padre no encontrada por variation_id'];
172      }
173
174      // 7) Consultar todas las variaciones hijas cuyo parent_id sea igual
175      //    al variation_id del padre.
176      //    OJO: aquí NO se traen pdf_artwork ni name_pdf_artwork todavía.
177      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
178        SELECT
179          variations.variation_id,
180          variations.name,
181          variations.SKU,
182          variations.image,
183          variations.price_display_mode,
184          variations.parent_id,
185          variations.product_id,
186          variations.type_id,
187          EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM variations child
188                 WHERE child.parent_id = variations.variation_id
189                   AND child.variation_id <> variations.variation_id
190                   AND child.product_id = variations.product_id) AS has_children
191
192        FROM variations
193        WHERE variations.parent_id = :parent_id
194        ORDER BY variations.variation_id ASC
195      ");
196      $stmt->execute([':parent_id' => $parentVariationId]);
197
198      // 8) Obtener todas las hijas como arreglo asociativo.
199      $children = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
200
201      // 9) Si no hay hijas, devolver un arreglo vacío.

205
206      // 10) Sacar todos los variation_id de las hijas.

209
210      // 11) Crear placeholders ?,?,?... según la cantidad de IDs.

212      $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($childIds), '?'));
213
214      // =========================================================
215      // 12) TRAER ARTWORK EN BLOQUE
216      // =========================================================
217      // Se consulta pdf_artwork y name_pdf_artwork para todas las hijas
218      // en una sola consulta.
219      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
220        SELECT

226      ");
227      $stmt->execute($childIds);

230      // 13) Organizar el artwork por variation_id para acceder rápido después.
231      $artworkByVariation = [];

234
235        $artworkByVariation[$vid] = [

238        ];

242      // 14) TRAER IMÁGENES EN BLOQUE

244      // Se consultan todas las imágenes relacionadas con las variaciones hijas.
245      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
246        SELECT
247          images.image_id,
248          images.link,
249          images.updated,
250          images.variation_id

252        WHERE images.variation_id IN ($placeholders)
253        ORDER BY images.image_id ASC
254      ");
255      $stmt->execute($childIds);
256      $imagesRows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
257
258      // 15) Agrupar imágenes por variation_id.
259      $imagesByVariation = [];

261        $vid = (int)$row['variation_id'];
262
263        if (!isset($imagesByVariation[$vid])) {

314      $stmt->execute($childIds);

317      // 19) Agrupar precios por variation_id.

346      // 23) Solo consultar si realmente hay type_id.
347      if (!empty($typeIds)) {
348        $typePlaceholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($typeIds), '?'));
349
350        $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
351          SELECT type_variations.type_id, type_variations.type_name
352          FROM type_variations
353          WHERE type_variations.type_id IN ($typePlaceholders)
354        ");
355        $stmt->execute($typeIds);
356
357        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
358
359        // 24) Guardar type_name por cada type_id.
360        foreach ($rows as $r) {
361          $typeNameById[(int)$r['type_id']] = $r['type_name'];
362        }
363      }
364
365      // =========================================================
366      // 25) ARMAR LA ESTRUCTURA FINAL
367      // =========================================================
368      $result = [];
369
370      foreach ($children as $child) {
371        $vid = (int)$child['variation_id'];
372
373        // 26) Obtener el type_id actual de la hija.
374        $tid = !empty($child['type_id']) ? (int)$child['type_id'] : 0;
375
376        // 27) Agregar type_name dentro de la información de la variación.
377        //     Si no existe, dejar null.
378        $child['type_name'] = $tid ? ($typeNameById[$tid] ?? null) : null;
379
380        // 28) Construir el bloque final para esta variación hija.
381        $result[] = [
382          'variation' => $child, // Datos principales de la variación hija
383          'images'  => $imagesByVariation[$vid] ?? [], // Imágenes relacionadas
384          'items'   => $itemsByVariation[$vid] ?? [],  // Items relacionados
385          'prices'  => $pricesByVariation[$vid] ?? [], // Precios relacionados
386          'artwork' => $artworkByVariation[$vid] ?? [  // Artwork relacionado
387            'pdf_artwork' => null,
388            'name_pdf_artwork' => null
389          ],
390        ];
391      }
392
393      // 29) Retornar el resultado final.
394      return $result;
395
396    } catch (PDOException $e) {
397      // 30) Si ocurre un error en base de datos, registrarlo en logs
398      //     y devolver un mensaje genérico.
399      error_log('getVariationChildrenById: ' . $e->getMessage());
400      return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'DB error'];
401    }
402  }

446  public function getDetailsCurrentVariationById(): array
447  {
448    // [Supplier 6.2.2.3.2 / Customer 6.2.3.3.2]
449    // Este método sigue los subpasos 1-11 para enriquecer el nodo actualmente seleccionado.
450
451    // 1) Obtener el variation_id actual guardado en el objeto.
452    $currentVariationId = (int)($this->variation_id ?? 0);
453
454    // 2) Comprobar que el variation_id sea válido.
455    if ($currentVariationId <= 0) {
456      return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'variation_id requerido'];
457    }
458
459    try {
460      // 3) Obtener la conexión PDO.
461      $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
462
463      // 4) Consultar la variación actual junto con el nombre de su tipo.
464      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
465        SELECT
466          variations.variation_id,
467          variations.name,
468          variations.SKU,
469          variations.image,
470          variations.parent_id,
471          variations.product_id,
472          variations.type_id,
473          variations.pdf_artwork,
474          variations.name_pdf_artwork,
475          variations.price_display_mode,
476          type_variations.type_name
477        FROM variations
478        LEFT JOIN type_variations
479          ON type_variations.type_id = variations.type_id
480        WHERE variations.variation_id = :variation_id
481        LIMIT 1
482      ");
483      $stmt->execute([':variation_id' => $currentVariationId]);
484
485      $currentVariation = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
486
487      // 5) Si la variación actual no existe, devolver un error.
488      if (!$currentVariation) {
489        return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Variación actual no encontrada por variation_id'];
490      }
491
492      // 6) Consultar todas las imágenes relacionadas con la variación actual.
493      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
494        SELECT
495          images.image_id,
496          images.link,
497          images.updated,
498          images.variation_id
499        FROM images
500        WHERE images.variation_id = :variation_id
501        ORDER BY images.image_id ASC
502      ");
503      $stmt->execute([':variation_id' => $currentVariationId]);
504      $images = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
505
506      // 7) Consultar todos los items relacionados con la variación actual.
507      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
508        SELECT
509          items.item_id,
510          items.name,
511          items.description,
512          items.variation_id
513        FROM items
514        WHERE items.variation_id = :variation_id
515        ORDER BY items.item_id ASC
516      ");
517      $stmt->execute([':variation_id' => $currentVariationId]);
518      $items = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
519
520      // 8) Consultar todos los precios relacionados con la variación actual.
521      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
522        SELECT
523          prices.price_id,
524          prices.min_quantity,
525          prices.max_quantity,
526          prices.price,
527          prices.variation_id
528        FROM prices
529        WHERE prices.variation_id = :variation_id
530        ORDER BY prices.price_id ASC
531      ");
532      $stmt->execute([':variation_id' => $currentVariationId]);
533      $prices = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
534
535      // 9) Construir el bloque artwork desde la fila de la variación actual.
536      $artwork = [
537        'pdf_artwork' => $currentVariation['pdf_artwork'] ?? null,
538        'name_pdf_artwork' => $currentVariation['name_pdf_artwork'] ?? null,
539      ];
540
541      // 10) Quitar los campos de artwork del bloque principal para no duplicarlos.
542      unset($currentVariation['pdf_artwork'], $currentVariation['name_pdf_artwork']);
543
544      // 11) Devolver la misma forma de datos usada para cada hijo.
545      return [
546        'variation' => $currentVariation,
547        'images'    => $images,
548        'items'     => $items,
549        'prices'    => $prices,
550        'artwork'   => $artwork,
551      ];
552
553    } catch (PDOException $e) {
554      error_log('getDetailsCurrentVariationById: ' . $e->getMessage());
555      return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'DB error'];
556    }
557  }

559  {

581                  LIMIT 1

583              $stmt->execute([

591

594

599              WHERE variation_id = :variation_id
600          ");
601

605          ]);
606
607          return [
608              'success'            => true,
609              'variation_id'       => $variationId,
610              'price_display_mode' => $priceDisplayMode
611          ];
612
613      } catch (PDOException $e) {
614          error_log('updatePriceDisplayMode error: ' . $e->getMessage());
615          return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'DB error'];

685  public function getVariationDetailsBySkus(): array
686  {
687      // 0) Validaciones mínimas
688      if (!$this->sku) {
689          return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Product SKU requerido'];
690      }
691      if (!$this->sku_variation) {
692          return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Variation SKU (sku_variation) requerido'];
693      }
694
695      try {
696          $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
697
698          // 1) Obtener product_id, name, SKU y group_id desde products por SKU de producto
699          $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
700              SELECT product_id, name AS product_name, SKU AS product_sku, group_id
701              FROM products
702              WHERE LOWER(SKU) = LOWER(:sku)
703              LIMIT 1
704          ");
705          $stmt->execute([':sku' => $this->sku]);
706          $prod = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
707
708          if (!$prod) {
709              return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Producto no encontrado por SKU'];
710          }
711
712          $productId   = (int)$prod['product_id'];
713          $productName = $prod['product_name'];
714          $productSku  = $prod['product_sku'];
715          $groupId     = !empty($prod['group_id']) ? (int)$prod['group_id'] : null;
716
717          // 2) Variación actual + datos del padre (name/sku) en una sola consulta
718          $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
719              SELECT
720                v.*,
721                v.variation_id,
722                v.name,
723                v.image,
724                v.SKU,
725                v.pdf_artwork,
726                v.name_pdf_artwork,
727                v.parent_id,
728                v.type_id,
729                vp.name AS parent_name,
730                vp.SKU  AS parent_sku
731              FROM variations v
732              LEFT JOIN variations vp
733                ON vp.variation_id = v.parent_id
734              WHERE v.product_id = :pid
735                AND LOWER(v.SKU) = LOWER(:vsku)
736              LIMIT 1
737          ");
738          $stmt->execute([
739              ':pid'  => $productId,
740              ':vsku' => $this->sku_variation
741          ]);
742          $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
743
744          if (!$row) {
745              return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Variation SKU no pertenece al producto dado o no existe'];
746          }
747
748          // 3) Versión jerárquica CORREGIDA: Padre → Hijos → Nietos
749          $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
750              WITH RECURSIVE vtree AS (
751                  -- Nivel 0: Raíz (parent_id IS NULL o = 0 o se referencia a sí misma)
752                  SELECT
753                      v.variation_id,
754                      v.name,
755                      v.SKU,
756                      v.parent_id,
757                      0 AS level,
758                      CAST(v.variation_id AS CHAR(1000)) AS sort_path
759                  FROM variations v
760                  WHERE v.product_id = :pid
761                      AND (v.parent_id IS NULL OR v.parent_id = 0 OR v.parent_id = v.variation_id)
762
763                  UNION ALL
764
765                  -- Niveles 1+: Hijos recursivos
766                  SELECT
767                      c.variation_id,
768                      c.name,
769                      c.SKU,
770                      c.parent_id,
771                      p.level + 1 AS level,
772                      CONCAT(p.sort_path, '-', c.variation_id) AS sort_path
773                  FROM variations c
774                  INNER JOIN vtree p ON c.parent_id = p.variation_id
775                  WHERE c.product_id = :pid
776                      AND c.parent_id != c.variation_id  -- Evitar bucles infinitos
777              )
778              SELECT variation_id, name, SKU, parent_id, level
779              FROM vtree
780              ORDER BY sort_path ASC
781          ");
782          $stmt->execute([':pid' => $productId]);
783          $variations = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
784          // 4) Con product_id (vía group->category) traer type_variations asociados a la categoría del producto
785          //    (si el producto no tiene group_id, devolverá lista vacía)
786          $typeVariations = [];
787          if ($groupId !== null) {
788              $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
789                  SELECT
790                    tv.type_id,
791                    tv.type_name,
792                    tv.description,
793                    tv.category_id
794                  FROM products p
795                  INNER JOIN `groups` g
796                    ON g.group_id = p.group_id
797                  INNER JOIN type_variations tv
798                    ON tv.category_id = g.category_id
799                  WHERE p.product_id = :pid
800                  ORDER BY tv.type_name ASC
801              ");
802              $stmt->execute([':pid' => $productId]);
803              $typeVariations = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
804          }
805
806          // 5) Respuesta final (sin json_encode)
807          return [
808              'success' => true,
809              'product' => [
810                  'product_id'   => $productId,
811                  'product_name' => $productName,
812                  'product_sku'  => $productSku,
813                  'group_id'     => $groupId,
814              ],
815              'variations' => $variations,
816              'current' => [
817                  'variation_id'     => (int)$row['variation_id'],
818                  'name'             => $row['name'],
819                  'image'            => $row['image'] ?? null,
820                  'sku'              => $row['SKU'],
821                  'pdf_artwork'      => $row['pdf_artwork'] ?? null,
822                  'name_pdf_artwork' => $row['name_pdf_artwork'] ?? null,
823                  'delivery_time_days' => $row['delivery_time_days'] ?? null,
824                  'delivery_price' => $row['delivery_price'] ?? null,
825                  'delivery_price_type' => $row['delivery_price_type'] ?? null,
826                  'parent_id'        => !empty($row['parent_id']) ? (int)$row['parent_id'] : null,
827
828                  // ✅ NUEVO: type_id agregado al return
829                  'type_id'          => !empty($row['type_id']) ? (int)$row['type_id'] : null,
830              ],
831              'parent' => [
832                  'name' => $row['parent_name'] ?? null,
833                  'sku'  => $row['parent_sku']  ?? null,
834              ],
835              'type_variations' => $typeVariations,
836          ];
837
838      } catch (PDOException $e) {
839          error_log('getVariationDetailsBySkus: ' . $e->getMessage());
840          return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'DB error'];
841      }
842  }

845  public function createDefaultVariation(): array
846  {
847    if (empty($this->product_id) || $this->product_id <= 0) {
848      return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'product_id required'];
849    }
850
851    try {
852      $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
853
854      $name = $this->name ?? 'Default';
855      $sku  = $this->sku ?? null;
856      $img  = $this->image ?? null;
857      $pdf  = $this->pdf_artwork ?? null;
858
859      // 1) Insertar la variación
860      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
861        INSERT INTO variations (name, SKU, image, pdf_artwork, product_id)
862        VALUES (:name, :sku, :image, :pdf, :pid)
863      ");
864      $stmt->execute([
865        ':name'  => $name,
866        ':sku'   => $sku,
867        ':image' => $img,
868        ':pdf'   => $pdf,
869        ':pid'   => $this->product_id,
870      ]);
871
872      // 2) Obtener el ID de la variación recién creada
873      $variationId = (int)$pdo->lastInsertId();
874
875      // 3) Consultar la variación recién insertada
876      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
877        SELECT
878          variation_id,
879          name,
880          SKU,
881          image,
882          pdf_artwork,
883          name_pdf_artwork,
884          parent_id,
885          product_id,
886          type_id
887        FROM variations
888        WHERE variation_id = :variation_id
889        LIMIT 1
890      ");
891      $stmt->execute([
892        ':variation_id' => $variationId
893      ]);
894
895      $variation = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
896
897      // 4) Validar que sí se haya encontrado
898      if (!$variation) {
899        return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Variation created but not found'];
900      }
901
902      // 5) Retornar todos los datos de la variación creada
903      return [
904        'success' => true,
905        'variation' => $variation
906      ];
907
908    } catch (PDOException $e) {
909      error_log('createDefaultVariation error (product_id '.$this->product_id.'): '.$e->getMessage());
910      return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'DB error'];
911    }
912  }

915  public function getTypeVariationsChildByVariationIdForDelete(): array
916  {
917    $parentVariationId = (int)($this->variation_id ?? 0);
918
919    if ($parentVariationId <= 0) {
920      return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'variation_id required'];
921    }
922
923    try {
924      $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
925
926      /* ============================================================================
927        1) Capturar type_id del variation_id inicial
928        - NO permitimos NULL en salida.
929      ============================================================================ */
930      $stmtType = $pdo->prepare("
931        SELECT type_id
932        FROM variations
933        WHERE variation_id = :variation_id
934        LIMIT 1
935      ");
936      $stmtType->execute([':variation_id' => $parentVariationId]);
937      $typeId = $stmtType->fetchColumn(); // puede ser NULL
938
939      // Si no hay type_id, no hay wrappers por type_id que borrar (y NO devolvemos NULL).
940      if ($typeId === null || $typeId === '') {
941        return [];
942      }
943
944      $typeId = (int)$typeId;            // normalizamos numérico
945      $typeIdKey = (string)$typeId;      // key estable para el array
946
947      /* ============================================================================
948        2) Variations raíz de ese type_id (SIN NULL)
949      ============================================================================ */
950      $stmtVars = $pdo->prepare("
951        SELECT variation_id
952        FROM variations
953        WHERE type_id = :type_id
954      ");
955      $stmtVars->execute([':type_id' => $typeId]);
956      $variationIds = $stmtVars->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
957
958      if (!is_array($variationIds) || count($variationIds) === 0) {
959        $variationIds = [$parentVariationId];
960      }
961
962      /* ============================================================================
963        3) CTE descendientes (SIN NULL en type_id)
964        - Aquí armamos la lista de type_id a borrar (incluye el type_id inicial).
965      ============================================================================ */
966      $unique = []; // key(type_id string) => ['type_id'=>..., 'type_name'=>...]
967      $cteSql = "
968        WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS (
969          SELECT v.variation_id, v.parent_id, v.type_id
970          FROM variations v
971          WHERE v.variation_id = :parent_id
972
973          UNION ALL
974
975          SELECT child.variation_id, child.parent_id, child.type_id
976          FROM variations child
977          INNER JOIN descendants d
978            ON child.parent_id = d.variation_id
979        )
980        SELECT DISTINCT
981          d.type_id,
982          tv.type_name
983        FROM descendants d
984        LEFT JOIN type_variations tv
985          ON tv.type_id = d.type_id
986        WHERE d.type_id IS NOT NULL
987        ORDER BY d.type_id ASC
988      ";
989
990      $stmtCTE = $pdo->prepare($cteSql);
991
992      foreach ($variationIds as $vid) {
993        $vid = (int)$vid;
994        if ($vid <= 0) continue;
995
996        $stmtCTE->execute([':parent_id' => $vid]);
997        $rows = $stmtCTE->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
998
999        foreach ($rows as $r) {
1000          $tid = $r['type_id'] ?? null;
1001          if ($tid === null || $tid === '') continue;
1002
1003          $tidKey = (string)$tid;
1004          $tname  = isset($r['type_name']) ? (string)$r['type_name'] : '';
1005
1006          if (!isset($unique[$tidKey])) {
1007            $unique[$tidKey] = [
1008              'type_id'   => $tidKey,
1009              'type_name' => $tname,
1010            ];
1011          }
1012        }
1013      }
1014
1015      /* ============================================================================
1016        4) ORDEN FINAL con REGLA NUEVA:
1017        ✅ El type_id de la variación inicial SIEMPRE primero en el array.
1018        - Luego, el resto se ordena ascendente como antes.
1019      ============================================================================ */
1020
1021      $out = [];
1022
1023      // 4.1) Poner primero el type_id inicial (si existe en unique)
1024      if (isset($unique[$typeIdKey])) {
1025        $out[] = $unique[$typeIdKey];
1026        unset($unique[$typeIdKey]); // lo quitamos para no duplicarlo en el resto
1027      } else {
1028        // Si por alguna razón no quedó en $unique, lo agregamos manualmente
1029        // (type_name quedará vacío si no tenemos join)
1030        $out[] = [
1031          'type_id' => $typeIdKey,
1032          'type_name' => '',
1033        ];
1034      }
1035
1036      // 4.2) Ordenar el resto (asc numérico)
1037      $rest = array_values($unique);
1038      usort($rest, function ($a, $b) {
1039        return (int)$a['type_id'] <=> (int)$b['type_id'];
1040      });
1041
1042      // 4.3) Unir: primero inicial + resto
1043      array_push($out, ...$rest);
1044
1045      return $out;
1046
1047    } catch (PDOException $e) {
1048      error_log('getTypeVariationsChildByVariationIdForDelete error: ' . $e->getMessage());
1049      return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'DB error'];
1050    }
1051  }
1052  // En tu modelo Variation
1053
1054  public function updateVariationDetails(): bool
1055  {
1056      $targetSku = trim((string)($this->sku_variation ?? ''));
1057      if ($targetSku === '') {
1058          return false;
1059      }
1060
1061      try {
1062          $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
1063          $pdo->beginTransaction();
1064
1065          // 1) Resolve parent_id from parent SKU (if provided)
1066          $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1067              SELECT variation_id
1068              FROM variations
1069              WHERE SKU = :parentSku
1070              LIMIT 1
1071          ");
1072          $stmt->execute([':parentSku' => (string)($this->sku_parent_variation ?? '')]);
1073          $parentId = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
1074
1075          // 2) Fallback: find "default" parent within the same product
1076          if ($parentId === false) {
1077              $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1078                  SELECT product_id
1079                  FROM variations
1080                  WHERE SKU = :sku
1081                  LIMIT 1
1082              ");
1083              $stmt->execute([':sku' => $targetSku]);
1084              $pid = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
1085
1086              if ($pid === false) {
1087                  $pdo->rollBack();
1088                  return false;
1089              }
1090
1091              $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1092                  SELECT variation_id
1093                  FROM variations
1094                  WHERE product_id = :pid
1095                    AND LOWER(name) LIKE :like
1096                  ORDER BY variation_id ASC
1097                  LIMIT 1
1098              ");
1099              $stmt->execute([
1100                  ':pid'  => (int)$pid,
1101                  ':like' => '%default%',
1102              ]);
1103              $parentId = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
1104
1105              if ($parentId === false) {
1106                  $pdo->rollBack();
1107                  return false;
1108              }
1109
1110              $parentId = (int)$parentId;
1111          } else {
1112              $parentId = (int)$parentId;
1113          }
1114
1115          $currentStatement = $pdo->prepare('SELECT * FROM variations WHERE SKU=? LIMIT 1');
1116          $currentStatement->execute([$targetSku]);
1117          $currentDelivery = $currentStatement->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
1118          $optionsJson = DeliveryOptions::updateFirst($currentDelivery['delivery_options'] ?? null, $this->delivery_time_days, $this->delivery_price, $this->delivery_price_type);
1119          if ($optionsJson !== null) {
1120              $first = json_decode($optionsJson, true)[0] ?? [];
1121              $this->delivery_time_days = $first['days'] ?? null;
1122              $this->delivery_price = $first['value'] ?? null;
1123              $this->delivery_price_type = $first['type'] ?? null;
1124          }
1125          // 3) Build UPDATE dynamically based on attach flags
1126          $set = [
1127              'name = :name',
1128              'type_id = :type_id',
1129              'name_pdf_artwork = :name_pdf_artwork',
1130              'parent_id = :parent_id',
1131              'delivery_time_days = :delivery_time_days',
1132              'delivery_price = :delivery_price',
1133              'delivery_price_type = :delivery_price_type',
1134          ];
1135
1136          if ((int)$this->isAttachAnImage === 1) {
1137              $set[] = 'image = :image';
1138          }
1139          if ((int)$this->isAttachAPDF === 1) {
1140              $set[] = 'pdf_artwork = :pdf_artwork';
1141          }
1142
1143          if ($optionsJson !== null) $set[] = 'delivery_options = :delivery_options';
1144          $sql = "
1145              UPDATE variations
1146                 SET " . implode(",\n                   ", $set) . "
1147               WHERE SKU = :sku
1148               LIMIT 1
1149          ";
1150
1151          $stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
1152
1153          if ($optionsJson !== null) $stmt->bindValue(':delivery_options', $optionsJson, PDO::PARAM_STR);
1154          $stmt->bindValue(':delivery_time_days', $this->delivery_time_days, $this->delivery_time_days === null ? PDO::PARAM_NULL : PDO::PARAM_INT);
1155          $stmt->bindValue(':delivery_price', $this->delivery_price, $this->delivery_price === null ? PDO::PARAM_NULL : PDO::PARAM_STR);
1156          $stmt->bindValue(':delivery_price_type', $this->delivery_price_type, $this->delivery_price_type === null ? PDO::PARAM_NULL : PDO::PARAM_STR);
1157          // Bind common fields
1158          $stmt->bindValue(':name', (string)($this->name ?? ''), \PDO::PARAM_STR);
1159
1160          // type_id can be NULL
1161          if ($this->type_id === null) {
1162              $stmt->bindValue(':type_id', null, \PDO::PARAM_NULL);
1163          } else {
1164              $stmt->bindValue(':type_id', (int)$this->type_id, \PDO::PARAM_INT);
1165          }
1166
1167          $stmt->bindValue(':name_pdf_artwork', (string)($this->name_pdf_artwork ?? ''), \PDO::PARAM_STR);
1168          $stmt->bindValue(':parent_id', $parentId, \PDO::PARAM_INT);
1169          $stmt->bindValue(':sku', $targetSku, \PDO::PARAM_STR);
1170
1171          // Bind optional file paths only if included in SET
1172          if ((int)$this->isAttachAnImage === 1) {
1173              $stmt->bindValue(':image', (string)($this->image ?? ''), \PDO::PARAM_STR);
1174          }
1175          if ((int)$this->isAttachAPDF === 1) {
1176              $stmt->bindValue(':pdf_artwork', (string)($this->pdf_artwork ?? ''), \PDO::PARAM_STR);
1177          }
1178
1179          $ok = $stmt->execute();
1180          $pdo->commit();
1181
1182          return $ok;
1183      } catch (\Throwable $e) {
1184          if (isset($pdo) && $pdo->inTransaction()) $pdo->rollBack();
1185          return false;
1186      }
1187  }

1232  public function createEmptyVariationByProductSku(): array
1233  {
1234      // Requiere: $this->sku  (SKU del producto)  y  $this->sku_variation (SKU de la variación)
1235      $productSku   = isset($this->sku) ? trim((string)$this->sku) : '';
1236      $variationSku = isset($this->sku_variation) ? trim((string)$this->sku_variation) : '';
1237
1238      if ($productSku === '') {
1239          return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Product SKU requerido'];
1240      }
1241      if ($variationSku === '') {
1242          return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Variation SKU requerido'];
1243      }
1244
1245      try {
1246          $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
1247
1248          // 1) Obtener product_id por SKU de producto
1249          $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1250              SELECT product_id
1251              FROM products
1252              WHERE SKU = :sku
1253              LIMIT 1
1254          ");
1255          $stmt->execute([':sku' => $productSku]);
1256          $prod = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
1257
1258          if (!$prod) {
1259              return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Producto no encontrado por SKU'];
1260          }
1261
1262          $productId = (int)$prod['product_id'];
1263
1264          // 2) Verificar si ya existe una variación con ese SKU (opcional pero recomendado)
1265          $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1266              SELECT variation_id
1267              FROM variations
1268              WHERE SKU = :vsku
1269              LIMIT 1
1270          ");
1271          $stmt->execute([':vsku' => $variationSku]);
1272          if ($stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
1273              return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Variation SKU ya existe'];
1274          }
1275
1276          // 3) Insertar nueva variación con campos vacíos y SKU de variación provisto
1277          $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1278              INSERT INTO variations (name, SKU, image, pdf_artwork, parent_id, product_id)
1279              VALUES (:name, :sku_variation, :image, :pdf, :parent_id, :pid)
1280          ");
1281          $stmt->execute([
1282              ':name'          => null,              // vacío
1283              ':sku_variation' => $variationSku,     // SKU de la variación (provisto)
1284              ':image'         => null,              // vacío
1285              ':pdf'           => null,              // vacío
1286              ':parent_id'     => null,              // sin padre por defecto
1287              ':pid'           => $productId,
1288          ]);
1289
1290          $variationId = (int)$pdo->lastInsertId();
1291
1292          return [
1293              'success'        => true,
1294              'product_id'     => $productId,
1295              'variation_id'   => $variationId,
1296              'sku_variation'  => $variationSku,
1297              'name'           => null,
1298              'image'          => null,
1299              'pdf_artwork'    => null,
1300              'parent_id'      => null,
1301          ];
1302
1303      } catch (PDOException $e) {
1304          error_log('createEmptyVariationByProductSku: '.$e->getMessage());
1305          return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'DB error'];
1306      }
1307  }

1315
1316    try {
1317      $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
1318

1320      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("

1334      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("

1356    }

1359  public function getSKUDefaultVariation(): array
1360  {
1361    $productSku = trim((string)($this->sku ?? ''));
1362    if ($productSku === '') {
1363      return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Product SKU requerido'];
1364    }
1365
1366    try {
1367      $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
1368
1369      // 1) Obtener product_id por SKU del producto
1370      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1371        SELECT product_id
1372        FROM products
1373        WHERE SKU IS NOT NULL
1374          AND LOWER(SKU) = LOWER(:sku)
1375        LIMIT 1
1376      ");
1377      $stmt->execute([':sku' => $productSku]);
1378      $pid = (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();
1379
1380      if ($pid <= 0) {
1381        return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Producto no encontrado por SKU'];
1382      }
1383
1384      // 2) Buscar la variación 'Default' y devolver su SKU
1385      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1386        SELECT v.SKU
1387        FROM variations v
1388        WHERE v.product_id = :pid
1389          AND v.name IS NOT NULL
1390          AND LOWER(v.name) = 'default'
1391        ORDER BY v.variation_id ASC
1392        LIMIT 1
1393      ");
1394      $stmt->execute([':pid' => $pid]);
1395      $defaultSku = $stmt->fetchColumn();
1396
1397      $defaultSku = trim((string)($defaultSku ?? ''));
1398      if ($defaultSku === '') {
1399        return ['success' => false, 'error' => "No se encontró la variación 'Default' para este producto"];
1400      }
1401
1402      return [
1403        'success' => true,
1404        'sku_default_variation' => $defaultSku,
1405        'product_id' => $pid
1406      ];
1407
1408    } catch (\PDOException $e) {
1409      error_log('getSKUDefaultVariation: ' . $e->getMessage());
1410      return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'DB error'];
1411    }
1412  }
1413  /* =========================================================
1414     Delete variation
1415  ========================================================= */
1416
1417  public function deleteVariation(): array
1418  {
1419      $validation = $this->validateVariationSkuForDeletion();
1420
1421      if (!$validation['success']) {
1422          return $validation;
1423      }
1424
1425      $targetSku = $validation['sku'];
1426      $pdo = null;
1427
1428      try {
1429          $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
1430
1431          $pdo->beginTransaction();
1432
1433          /*
1434           * 1. Find the main variation ID using its SKU.
1435           */
1436          $variationId = $this->getVariationIdBySku(
1437              $pdo,
1438              $targetSku
1439          );
1440
1441          if ($variationId <= 0) {
1442              $pdo->rollBack();
1443
1444              return [
1445                  'success' => false,
1446                  'error' => 'Variation not found'
1447              ];
1448          }
1449
1450          /*
1451           * 2. Prevent the main Default variation
1452           * from being deleted.
1453           */
1454          $defaultProtection = $this->protectDefaultVariation(
1455              $pdo,
1456              $variationId
1457          );
1458
1459          if (!$defaultProtection['success']) {
1460              $pdo->rollBack();
1461
1462              return $defaultProtection;
1463          }
1464
1465          /*
1466           * Get the product SKU and the Default variation SKU
1467           * before deleting any information.
1468           */
1469          $skuInformation = $this->getProductAndDefaultVariationSkus(
1470              $pdo,
1471              $variationId
1472          );
1473
1474          if (!$skuInformation['success']) {
1475              $pdo->rollBack();
1476
1477              return $skuInformation;
1478          }
1479
1480          $skuProduct = $skuInformation['sku_product'];
1481
1482          $skuDefaultVariation =
1483              $skuInformation['sku_default_variation'];
1484
1485          /*
1486           * 3. Find all child variations and descendants.
1487           *
1488           * They are returned from the deepest variation
1489           * to the closest child.
1490           */
1491          $childVariationIds = $this->getChildVariationIds(
1492              $pdo,
1493              $variationId
1494          );
1495
1496          /*
1497           * 4. Prevent any child variation named Default
1498           * from being deleted.
1499           */
1500          foreach ($childVariationIds as $childVariationId) {
1501              $childDefaultProtection = $this->protectDefaultVariation(
1502                  $pdo,
1503                  $childVariationId
1504              );
1505
1506              if (!$childDefaultProtection['success']) {
1507                  $pdo->rollBack();
1508
1509                  return $childDefaultProtection;
1510              }
1511          }
1512
1513
1514
1515          /*
1516           * 5. Create one array containing the main variation
1517           * and every child variation.
1518           */
1519          $allVariationIds = array_merge(
1520              [$variationId],
1521              $childVariationIds
1522          );
1523
1524          /*
1525           * 6. Check whether any variation is being used
1526           * in job_details.
1527           *
1528           * job_details uses ON DELETE RESTRICT.
1529           */
1530          $jobDetailsValidation = $this->validateJobDetailsBeforeDeletion(
1531              $pdo,
1532              $allVariationIds
1533          );
1534
1535          if (!$jobDetailsValidation['success']) {
1536              $pdo->rollBack();
1537
1538              return $jobDetailsValidation;
1539          }
1540
1541          /*
1542           * 7. Delete the related information belonging
1543           * to each child variation.
1544           */
1545          foreach ($childVariationIds as $childVariationId) {
1546              $this->deleteItemsByVariationId(
1547                  $pdo,
1548                  $childVariationId
1549              );
1550
1551              $this->deletePromotionsByVariationId(
1552                  $pdo,
1553                  $childVariationId
1554              );
1555
1556              $this->deleteImagesByVariationId(
1557                  $pdo,
1558                  $childVariationId
1559              );
1560
1561              $this->deletePricesByVariationId(
1562                  $pdo,
1563                  $childVariationId
1564              );
1565          }
1566
1567          /*
1568           * 8. Delete all child variations.
1569           */
1570          $deletedChildVariations = $this->deleteChildVariations(
1571              $pdo,
1572              $childVariationIds
1573          );
1574
1575          /*
1576           * 9. Delete the related information belonging
1577           * to the main variation.
1578           */
1579          $deletedMainItems = $this->deleteItemsByVariationId(
1580              $pdo,
1581              $variationId
1582          );
1583
1584          $deletedMainPromotions = $this->deletePromotionsByVariationId(
1585              $pdo,
1586              $variationId
1587          );
1588
1589          $deletedMainImages = $this->deleteImagesByVariationId(
1590              $pdo,
1591              $variationId
1592          );
1593
1594          $deletedMainPrices = $this->deletePricesByVariationId(
1595              $pdo,
1596              $variationId
1597          );
1598
1599          /*
1600           * 10. Finally, delete the main variation.
1601           */
1602          $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1603              DELETE FROM variations
1604              WHERE variation_id = :variation_id
1605              LIMIT 1
1606          ");
1607
1608          $stmt->execute([
1609              ':variation_id' => $variationId
1610          ]);
1611
1612          $deletedMainVariation = $stmt->rowCount();
1613
1614          if ($deletedMainVariation !== 1) {
1615              $pdo->rollBack();
1616
1617              return [
1618                  'success' => false,
1619                  'error' => 'The main variation could not be deleted'
1620              ];
1621          }
1622
1623          $pdo->commit();
1624
1625          return [
1626              'success' => true,
1627              'message' => 'The variation was deleted successfully',
1628              'variation_id' => $variationId,
1629              'sku_variation_deleted' => $targetSku,
1630              'sku_product' => $skuProduct,
1631              'sku_default_variation' => $skuDefaultVariation,
1632              'deleted' => [
1633                  'child_variations' => $deletedChildVariations,
1634                  'main_variation' => $deletedMainVariation,
1635                  'main_items' => $deletedMainItems,
1636                  'main_promotions' => $deletedMainPromotions,
1637                  'main_images' => $deletedMainImages,
1638                  'main_prices' => $deletedMainPrices
1639              ]
1640          ];
1641      } catch (Throwable $error) {
1642          if (
1643              $pdo instanceof PDO &&
1644              $pdo->inTransaction()
1645          ) {
1646              $pdo->rollBack();
1647          }
1648
1649          error_log(
1650              'deleteVariation error for SKU ' .
1651              $targetSku .
1652              ': ' .
1653              $error->getMessage()
1654          );
1655
1656          return [
1657              'success' => false,
1658              'error' => 'Database error while deleting the variation'
1659          ];
1660      }
1661  }

1663
1664  /* =========================================================
1665     Get product SKU and Default variation SKU
1666  ========================================================= */
1667
1668  private function getProductAndDefaultVariationSkus(
1669      PDO $pdo,
1670      int $variationId
1671  ): array {
1672      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1673          SELECT
1674              products.SKU AS sku_product,
1675              default_variation.SKU AS sku_default_variation
1676          FROM variations AS selected_variation
1677
1678          INNER JOIN products
1679              ON products.product_id = selected_variation.product_id
1680
1681          LEFT JOIN variations AS default_variation
1682              ON default_variation.product_id = selected_variation.product_id
1683              AND LOWER(TRIM(default_variation.name)) = 'default'
1684
1685          WHERE selected_variation.variation_id = :variation_id
1686
1687          LIMIT 1
1688      ");

1690      $stmt->execute([

1692      ]);

1694      $result = $stmt->fetch(

1697
1698      if (!$result) {

1821  /* =========================================================
1822     Find child and descendant variation IDs
1823  ========================================================= */
1824
1825  private function getChildVariationIds(
1826      PDO $pdo,
1827      int $parentVariationId
1828  ): array {
1829      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1830          WITH RECURSIVE variation_tree AS (
1831              SELECT
1832                  variation_id,
1833                  parent_id,
1834                  1 AS variation_level
1835              FROM variations
1836              WHERE parent_id = :parent_variation_id
1837
1838              UNION ALL
1839
1840              SELECT
1841                  child.variation_id,
1842                  child.parent_id,
1843                  parent.variation_level + 1
1844              FROM variations AS child
1845
1846              INNER JOIN variation_tree AS parent
1847                  ON child.parent_id = parent.variation_id
1848          )
1849
1850          SELECT variation_id
1851          FROM variation_tree
1852          ORDER BY variation_level DESC
1853      ");
1854
1855      $stmt->execute([
1856          ':parent_variation_id' => $parentVariationId
1857      ]);
1858
1859      $variationIds = $stmt->fetchAll(
1860          PDO::FETCH_COLUMN
1861      );
1862
1863      if (!$variationIds) {
1864          return [];
1865      }
1866
1867      return array_map(
1868          'intval',
1869          $variationIds
1870      );
1871  }

1873  /* =========================================================
1874     Validate job details
1875  ========================================================= */
1876
1877  private function validateJobDetailsBeforeDeletion(
1878      PDO $pdo,
1879      array $variationIds
1880  ): array {
1881      if (empty($variationIds)) {
1882          return [
1883              'success' => true
1884          ];
1885      }
1886
1887      $placeholders = implode(
1888          ',',
1889          array_fill(0, count($variationIds), '?')
1890      );
1891
1892      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1893          SELECT
1894              variation_id,
1895              COUNT(*) AS total_jobs
1896          FROM job_details
1897          WHERE variation_id IN ($placeholders)
1898          GROUP BY variation_id
1899      ");
1900
1901      $stmt->execute(
1902          array_map('intval', $variationIds)
1903      );
1904
1905      $jobDetails = $stmt->fetchAll(
1906          PDO::FETCH_ASSOC
1907      );
1908
1909      if (!empty($jobDetails)) {
1910          $usedVariationIds = array_map(
1911              'intval',
1912              array_column($jobDetails, 'variation_id')
1913          );
1914
1915          return [
1916              'success' => false,
1917              'error' => 'The variation cannot be deleted because it is being used in one or more jobs',
1918              'variation_ids_in_use' => $usedVariationIds
1919          ];
1920      }
1921
1922      return [
1923          'success' => true
1924      ];
1925  }
1926
1927  /* =========================================================
1928     Delete items by variation ID
1929  ========================================================= */
1930
1931  private function deleteItemsByVariationId(

1934  ): int {

1937          WHERE variation_id = :variation_id
1938      ");

1940      $stmt->execute([
1941          ':variation_id' => $variationId
1942      ]);
1943
1944      return $stmt->rowCount();
1945  }

1950
1951  private function deletePromotionsByVariationId(

1967  /* =========================================================
1968     Delete images by variation ID
1969  ========================================================= */
1970
1971  private function deleteImagesByVariationId(

1974  ): int {

1980      $stmt->execute([

1982      ]);
1983
1984      return $stmt->rowCount();
1985  }
1986
1987  /* =========================================================
1988     Delete prices by variation ID
1989  ========================================================= */
1990
1991  private function deletePricesByVariationId(
1992      PDO $pdo,
1993      int $variationId
1994  ): int {
1995      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
1996          DELETE FROM prices
1997          WHERE variation_id = :variation_id
1998      ");
1999
2000      $stmt->execute([
2001          ':variation_id' => $variationId
2002      ]);
2003
2004      return $stmt->rowCount();
2005  }
2006
2007  /* =========================================================
2008     Delete child variations
2009  ========================================================= */
2010
2011  private function deleteChildVariations(
2012      PDO $pdo,
2013      array $variationIds
2014  ): int {
2015      if (empty($variationIds)) {
2016          return 0;
2017      }
2018
2019      $deletedVariations = 0;
2020
2021      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
2022          DELETE FROM variations
2023          WHERE variation_id = :variation_id
2024          LIMIT 1
2025      ");
2026
2027      /*
2028       * The IDs arrive ordered from the deepest descendant
2029       * to the closest child.
2030       */
2031      foreach ($variationIds as $variationId) {
2032          $stmt->execute([
2033              ':variation_id' => (int)$variationId
2034          ]);
2035
2036          $deletedVariations += $stmt->rowCount();
2037      }
2038
2039      return $deletedVariations;
2040  }
2041
2042}

4/**
5 * =====================================================
6 * Class: Prices
7 * Database model for managing variation prices (rows)
8 *
9 * Tables:
10 *   prices(price_id, min_quantity, max_quantity, price, variation_id)
11 *   variations(variation_id, name, SKU, product_id, ...)
12 *   products(product_id, SKU, ...)
13 * =====================================================
14 */
15class Prices {
16  // ---- Properties (solo las necesarias) ----
17  private $delivery_options = null;
18  public function setDeliveryOptions($json): void { $this->delivery_options = $json; }
19  private $delivery_time_days = null;
20  public function setDeliveryTimeDays($value): void {
21      $this->delivery_time_days = DeliveryPrice::normalizeDays($value);
22  }
23  private $delivery_price = null;
24  private $delivery_price_type = null;
25  public function setDeliveryPrice($value, $type): void {
26      [$this->delivery_price, $this->delivery_price_type] = DeliveryPrice::normalize($value, $type);
27  }
28  private $connection;        // PDO wrapper
29  private $sku;               // Product SKU (para el dropdown)
30  private $sku_variation;     // Variation SKU (para resolver variation_id)
31
32  private $price_id;          // prices.price_id
33  private $min_quantity;      // prices.min_quantity
34  private $max_quantity;      // prices.max_quantity
35  private $price;             // prices.price
36  private $variation_id;      // prices.variation_id (opcional si ya resolvemos por SKU)
37
38  public function __construct($connection) { $this->connection = $connection; }
39
40  // ---- Setters ----
41  public function setSKU(?string $v)               { $v = trim((string)$v); $this->sku = ($v === '') ? null : $v; }
42  public function setSKUVariation(?string $v)      { $v = trim((string)$v); $this->sku_variation = ($v === '') ? null : $v; }
43
44  public function setPriceId($v)                   { $v = is_numeric($v)? (int)$v : null; $this->price_id = $v; }
45  public function setMinQuantity($v)               { $v = ($v === '' || $v === null) ? null : (int)$v; $this->min_quantity = $v; }
46  public function setMaxQuantity($v)               { $v = ($v === '' || $v === null) ? null : (int)$v; $this->max_quantity = $v; }
47  public function setPrice($v)                     { $v = ($v === '' || $v === null) ? null : (float)$v; $this->price = $v; }
48  public function setVariationId($v)               { $v = is_numeric($v)? (int)$v : null; $this->variation_id = $v; }
49
50
51  public function getPricesByIdVariation()
52  {
53      if (!$this->variation_id || $this->max_quantity === null) {
54          return null;
55      }
56
57      try {
58          $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
59
60          $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
61              SELECT
62                  p.price,
63                  v.price_display_mode
64              FROM prices p
65              INNER JOIN variations v ON v.variation_id = p.variation_id
66              WHERE p.variation_id = :variation_id
67                AND :quantity BETWEEN p.min_quantity AND p.max_quantity
68                AND v.price_display_mode = :price_display_mode
69              LIMIT 1
70          ");
71
72          $stmt->execute([
73              ':variation_id' => $this->variation_id,
74              ':quantity' => $this->max_quantity,
75              ':price_display_mode' => 'variation'
76          ]);
77
78          $result = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
79
80          return $result ? [
81              'price' => (float)$result['price'],
82              'price_display_mode' => $result['price_display_mode']
83          ] : null;
84
85      } catch (\PDOException $e) {
86          error_log('getPricesByIdVariation: ' . $e->getMessage());
87          return null;
88      }
89  }
90  // -----------------------------------------------------
91  // Variations by product SKU (for the dropdown)  ← DEJAR IGUAL
92  // -----------------------------------------------------
93  public function getVariationsBySKUProduct(): array
94  {
95      if (!$this->sku) return [];
96
97      try {
98          $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
99
100          // 1) Obtener product_id por SKU (case-insensitive)
101          $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
102              SELECT product_id
103              FROM products
104              WHERE LOWER(SKU) = LOWER(:sku)
105              LIMIT 1
106          ");
107          $stmt->execute([':sku' => $this->sku]);
108          $product = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
109
110          if (!$product) return [];
111
112          $productId = (int)$product['product_id'];
113
114          // 2) Variaciones jerárquicas (abuelo -> padre -> hijo) + level
115          try {
116              // ✅ MySQL 8+ (CTE recursivo)
117              $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
118                  WITH RECURSIVE vtree AS (
119                    -- Abuelos (raíz)
120                    SELECT
121                      v.variation_id,
122                      v.name,
123                      v.SKU,
124                      v.parent_id,
125                      0 AS level,
126                      CONCAT(LOWER(v.name), '-', LPAD(v.variation_id, 10, '0')) AS sort_path
127                    FROM variations v
128                    WHERE v.product_id = :pid
129                      AND (v.parent_id IS NULL OR v.parent_id = 0)
130
131                    UNION ALL
132
133                    -- Hijos
134                    SELECT
135                      c.variation_id,
136                      c.name,
137                      c.SKU,
138                      c.parent_id,
139                      p.level + 1 AS level,
140                      CONCAT(p.sort_path, '>', LOWER(c.name), '-', LPAD(c.variation_id, 10, '0')) AS sort_path
141                    FROM variations c
142                    INNER JOIN vtree p
143                      ON c.parent_id = p.variation_id
144                    WHERE c.product_id = :pid
145                  )
146
147                  SELECT variation_id, name, SKU, parent_id, level
148                  FROM vtree
149                  ORDER BY sort_path ASC
150              ");
151              $stmt->execute([':pid' => $productId]);
152              return $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
153
154          } catch (\PDOException $e) {
155              // 🔁 Fallback si tu BD no soporta WITH RECURSIVE
156              $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
157                  SELECT variation_id, name, SKU, parent_id, 0 AS level
158                  FROM variations
159                  WHERE product_id = :pid
160                  ORDER BY name ASC, variation_id ASC
161              ");
162              $stmt->execute([':pid' => $productId]);
163              return $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
164          }
165
166      } catch (\PDOException $e) {
167          error_log('getVariationsBySKUProduct: ' . $e->getMessage());
168          return [];
169      }
170  }
171  // -----------------------------------------------------
172  // Get prices by variation SKU
173  // -----------------------------------------------------
174  public function getPricesBySKUVariation(): array {
175    if (!$this->sku_variation) return [];
176    try {
177      $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
178      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("SELECT variation_id FROM variations WHERE SKU = :vsku LIMIT 1");
179      $stmt->execute([':vsku' => $this->sku_variation]);
180      $variation = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
181      if (!$variation) return [];
182
183      $variationId = (int)$variation['variation_id'];
184      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
185        SELECT *
186        FROM prices
187        WHERE variation_id = :vid
188        ORDER BY price_id ASC
189      ");
190      $stmt->execute([':vid' => $variationId]);
191      return $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
192
193    } catch (\PDOException $e) {
194      error_log('getPricesBySKUVariation: ' . $e->getMessage());
195      return [];
196    }
197  }
198
199  // -----------------------------------------------------
200  // Delete all prices for a given variation SKU
201  // (antes: deleteItemsBySkuVariation)
202  // -----------------------------------------------------
203  public function deletePricesBySkuVariation(): bool {
204    $vsku = $this->sku_variation ?? null;
205    if (!$vsku) return false;
206
207    try {
208      $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
209      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("SELECT variation_id FROM variations WHERE SKU = :sku LIMIT 1");
210      $stmt->execute([':sku' => $vsku]);
211      $variation = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
212      if (!$variation) return false;
213
214      $variationId = (int)$variation['variation_id'];
215      $stmtDel = $pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM prices WHERE variation_id = :vid");
216      return $stmtDel->execute([':vid' => $variationId]);
217
218    } catch (\PDOException $e) {
219      error_log('deletePricesBySkuVariation: ' . $e->getMessage());
220      return false;
221    }
222  }
223
224  // -----------------------------------------------------
225  // Delete a single price by price_id (and optionally by variation SKU)
226  // (antes: deleteItemByIdItem → ahora deletePricesByIdItem)
227  // -----------------------------------------------------
228  public function deletePricesByIdItem(): bool {
229    $priceId = $this->price_id ?? null;
230    if (!$priceId) return false;
231
232    try {
233      $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
234
235      if (!empty($this->sku_variation)) {
236        // valida pertenencia a la variación
237        $stmt = $pdo->prepare("SELECT variation_id FROM variations WHERE SKU = :vsku LIMIT 1");
238        $stmt->execute([':vsku' => $this->sku_variation]);
239        $vid = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
240        if ($vid === false) return false;
241        $vid = (int)$vid;
242
243        $stmtDel = $pdo->prepare("
244          DELETE FROM prices
245          WHERE price_id = :id AND variation_id = :vid
246          LIMIT 1
247        ");
248        $stmtDel->execute([':id' => $priceId, ':vid' => $vid]);
249
250      } else {
251        // borrar solo por price_id
252        $stmtDel = $pdo->prepare("
253          DELETE FROM prices
254          WHERE price_id = :id
255          LIMIT 1
256        ");
257        $stmtDel->execute([':id' => $priceId]);
258      }
259
260      return $stmtDel->rowCount() > 0;
261
262    } catch (\PDOException $e) {
263      error_log('deletePricesByIdItem: ' . $e->getMessage());
264      return false;
265    }
266  }
267
268  // -----------------------------------------------------
269  // Insert a single price for the current variation
270  // (antes: saveItem → ahora savePrice)
271  // -----------------------------------------------------
272  public function savePrice(): bool {
273    $vsku = $this->sku_variation ?? null;
274
275    // Validaciones mínimas: requiere SKU de variación y price
276    if (!$vsku) return false;
277    if ($this->price === null) return false;
278    if ($this->delivery_options !== null) {
279      $this->delivery_options = DeliveryOptions::updateFirst($this->delivery_options, $this->delivery_time_days, $this->delivery_price, $this->delivery_price_type);
280      $first = json_decode($this->delivery_options, true)[0] ?? [];
281      $this->delivery_time_days = $first['days'] ?? null;
282      $this->delivery_price = $first['value'] ?? null;
283      $this->delivery_price_type = $first['type'] ?? null;
284    }
285
286
287    try {
288      $pdo = $this->connection->getConnection();
289
290      // Resolver variation_id desde SKU de la variación
291      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("SELECT variation_id FROM variations WHERE SKU = :vsku LIMIT 1");
292      $stmt->execute([':vsku' => $vsku]);
293      $vid = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
294      if ($vid === false) return false;
295      $vid = (int)$vid;
296
297      // Insert
298      $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
299        INSERT INTO prices (min_quantity, max_quantity, price, variation_id, delivery_price, delivery_price_type, delivery_time_days)
300        VALUES (:minq, :maxq, :price, :vid, :delivery_price, :delivery_price_type, :delivery_time_days)
301      ");
302      $stmt->execute([
303        ':minq'  => $this->min_quantity,
304        ':maxq'  => $this->max_quantity,
305        ':price' => $this->price,
306        ':delivery_time_days' => $this->delivery_time_days,
307        ':delivery_price' => $this->delivery_price,
308        ':delivery_price_type' => $this->delivery_price_type,
309        ':vid'   => $vid
310      ]);
311
312      if ($this->delivery_options !== null) {
313        $pdo->prepare('UPDATE prices SET delivery_options=? WHERE price_id=?')->execute([$this->delivery_options, $pdo->lastInsertId()]);
314      }
315      return true;
316
317    } catch (\PDOException $e) {
318      error_log('savePrice: ' . $e->getMessage());
319      return false;
320    }
321  }
322}

1/*
2 * MAPA DEL PREVIEW DEL CLIENTE
3 * 3. Este archivo coordina todos los módulos.
4 * 4. Se pide el producto al servidor.
5 * 5. Se guarda y se pinta la información general.
6 * 6. Se recorre el árbol de variaciones.
7 * 7. Se pintan los recursos de la ruta seleccionada.
8 * 8. Se calcula el precio.
9 * 9. La pantalla queda lista para interacciones.
10 * 10. El cliente agrega al carrito; si hace falta, se autentica y se reintenta.
11 */
12
13// [Customer 3.1] preview.php añadió una versión a esta URL. La reutilizamos en cada import
14// para que todos los archivos pertenezcan a la misma versión y no se mezclen módulos de caché.
15const moduleVersion = new URL(import.meta.url).searchParams.get("v") || "1";
16const versionedModule = path => {
17  const url = new URL(path, import.meta.url);
18  url.searchParams.set("v", moduleVersion);
19  return url.href;
20};
21
22// [Customer 3.2] Los ocho módulos son independientes al descargarse, por eso se cargan en paralelo.
23// Promise.all espera a que estén todos listos antes de crear la aplicación.
24const [{
25  PreviewApi
26}, {
27  PreviewStore
28}, {
29  PreviewGallery
30}, {
31  ImagesRenderer
32}, {
33  ItemsRenderer
34}, {
35  ArtworkRenderer,
36  ArtworkUpload
37}, {
38  PricesController
39}, {
40  VariationsController,
41  readVariationInput
42}, {
43  CustomerAuthModal
44}] = await Promise.all([import(versionedModule("./preview_api.js")), import(versionedModule("./preview_store.js")), import(versionedModule("./preview.js")), import(versionedModule("../images/images.js")), import(versionedModule("../items/items.js")), import(versionedModule("../artwork/artwork.js")), import(versionedModule("../prices/prices.js")), import(versionedModule("../variations/variations.js")), import(versionedModule("./auth.js"))]);
45
46// [Customer 10.4] Este módulo controla el modal que aparece únicamente cuando el carrito
47// responde con 401/AUTH_REQUIRED. Conserva la selección mientras el cliente se identifica.
48
49// [Customer 3.3] Esta clase es el coordinador: conecta API, estado, renderizadores,
50// precios, variaciones, carrito y autenticación en un único flujo.
51class CustomerPreviewApp {
52  constructor() {
53    // [Customer 3.3.1] El SKU de la URL identifica el producto público que se debe consultar.
54    this.params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
55    this.sku = String(this.params.get("sku") || "").trim();
56    this.variationInput = readVariationInput(this.params);
57    this.api = new PreviewApi();
58    this.store = new PreviewStore();
59    this.loadController = null;
60
61    // [Customer 3.3.2] Cada módulo recibe solo las dependencias y callbacks que necesita.
62    this.gallery = new PreviewGallery();
63    this.images = new ImagesRenderer();
64    this.items = new ItemsRenderer();
65    this.artwork = new ArtworkRenderer();
66    this.artworkUpload = new ArtworkUpload();
67    this.prices = new PricesController({
68      api: this.api,
69      store: this.store,
70      getSku: () => this.sku,
71      onSummaryChange: summary => this.updatePurchaseActions(summary)
72    });
73    this.variations = new VariationsController({
74      api: this.api,
75      store: this.store,
76      prices: this.prices,
77      preferredOptions: this.variationInput.options,
78      renderPath: () => this.renderSelectedPath(),
79      onError: message => this.showMessage(message, "error")
80    });
81
82    // [Customer 3.3.3] Guardamos una sola referencia a cada elemento importante del DOM.
83    this.elements = {
84      loading: document.getElementById("preview_loading"),
85      content: document.getElementById("preview_content"),
86      fatal: document.getElementById("preview_fatal"),
87      fatalMessage: document.getElementById("preview_fatal_message"),
88      notice: document.getElementById("preview_notice"),
89      back: document.getElementById("btn_back_products"),
90      addToCart: document.getElementById("bb_add_to_cart"),
91      buyNow: document.getElementById("bb_buy_now"),
92      itemsSection: document.getElementById("items_section")
93    };
94    this.purchaseReady = false;
95    this.purchasePending = false;
96    this.purchaseConfirming = false;
97    this.pendingPurchase = null;
98    this.auth = new CustomerAuthModal({
99      api: this.api,
100      onAuthenticated: () => this.resumePendingPurchase(),
101      onDismissed: () => this.cancelPendingPurchase()
102    });
103    {
104      // [Customer 3.4] Los eventos se conectan una sola vez al construir la aplicación.
105      this.elements.back?.addEventListener("click", () => this.goBack());
106      this.elements.addToCart?.addEventListener("click", () => this.submitPurchase(false));
107      this.elements.buyNow?.addEventListener("click", () => this.submitPurchase(true));
108    }
109    this.getProduct();
110  }
111
112  async getProduct() {
113    // [Customer 3.5] Sin SKU no existe una consulta que hacer, así que mostramos un error y terminamos.
114    if (!this.sku) {
115      this.showFatal("The product SKU is missing from this link.");
116      return;
117    }
118    this.setLoading(true);
119    this.loadController?.abort();
120    this.loadController = new AbortController();
121    try {
122      // [Customer 4] El método consulta el producto con su makeRequest local.
123      const payload = await this.makeRequest(this.api.previewUrl, {
124        action: "get_customer_preview",
125        sku: this.sku
126      }, {
127        requireSuccess: true,
128        signal: this.loadController.signal
129      });
130
131      // [Customer 5] Con una respuesta válida guardamos el producto y pintamos sus datos generales.
132      this.store.setProduct(payload);
133      this.renderProduct(payload);
134
135      // [Customer 6] Después recorremos las variaciones desde la raíz. Este proceso también elige
136      // opciones predeterminadas y dispara los pasos 7 y 8 en cada cambio de ruta.
137      await this.variations.loadRoot(payload.root_variation_id);
138
139      // [Customer 9] Solo mostramos la pantalla cuando producto, opciones y precio inicial están coordinados.
140      this.setLoading(false);
141    } catch (error) {
142      // [Customer 4.1] AbortError significa que una solicitud anterior fue reemplazada; no es un fallo visible.
143      if (error.name === "AbortError") return;
144      this.showFatal(error.message || "The product could not be loaded.");
145    }
146  }
147
148  renderProduct(payload) {
149    // [Customer 5.1] Normalizamos valores opcionales para que la interfaz nunca muestre undefined.
150    const product = payload.product || {};
151    const category = product.category?.name || "Uncategorised";
152    const group = product.group?.name || "No group";
153    this.setText("sp_category", category);
154    this.setText("sp-title", product.name || "Untitled product");
155    this.setText("sp-brand", product.supplier_name || "Supplier");
156    this.setText("sp_subtitle", product.tagline || "No product tagline has been added yet.");
157    this.setText("sp_desc", product.description || "No product description has been added yet.");
158    this.setText("product_sku", product.sku || this.sku);
159
160    // [Customer 5.2] Las migas se construyen con textContent, así los datos se muestran como texto seguro.
161    const breadcrumbs = document.getElementById("sp_breadcrumbs");
162    if (breadcrumbs) {
163      breadcrumbs.innerHTML = "";
164      [category, group, product.name || "Preview"].forEach((label, index, values) => {
165        const item = document.createElement("li");
166        const text = document.createElement("span");
167        text.textContent = label;
168        if (index === values.length - 1) text.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
169        item.appendChild(text);
170        breadcrumbs.appendChild(item);
