173  }
174
175  renderSelectedPath() {
176    // [Customer 7] VariationsController llama este método cada vez que cambia una selección.
177    // Primero se elimina la representación anterior para reconstruir una vista coherente.
178    this.images.clear();
179    this.items.clear();
180    this.artwork.clear();
181    this.gallery.clear();
182    const imageKeys = new Set();
183    const itemKeys = new Set();
184    let renderedItems = 0;
185
186    // [Customer 7.1] Store devuelve la raíz y todas las variaciones elegidas en orden.
187    const selectedRows = this.store.getSelectedRows();
188    for (const row of selectedRows) {
189      const variation = row?.variation || {};
190      const variationName = String(variation.name || "").trim();
191
192      // [Customer 7.2] Los Set impiden pintar dos veces recursos que llegan desde varios niveles.
193      const uniqueImages = (Array.isArray(row?.images) ? row.images : []).filter(image => {
194        const key = String(image?.image_id ?? image?.link ?? "");
195        if (!key || imageKeys.has(key)) return false;
196        imageKeys.add(key);
197        return true;
198      });
199
200      // [Customer 7.3.1] ImagesRenderer crea las imágenes de este nivel.
201      this.images.render(uniqueImages, {
202        productName: this.store.product?.name,
203        variationName
204      });
205      const uniqueItems = (Array.isArray(row?.items) ? row.items : []).filter(item => {
206        const key = String(item?.item_id ?? `${item?.name}:${item?.description}`);
207        if (!key || itemKeys.has(key)) return false;
208        itemKeys.add(key);
209        return true;
210      });
211      // [Customer 7.3.2] ItemsRenderer agrega datos complementarios del producto.
212      renderedItems += this.items.render(uniqueItems);
213      if (row?.artwork) {
214        // [Customer 7.3.3] ArtworkRenderer agrega el PDF asociado, si existe.
215        this.artwork.render(row.artwork, {
216          variationName
217        });
218      }
219    }
220
221    // [Customer 7.4] Se pinta el estado vacío si corresponde y la galería vuelve a empezar.
222    this.images.renderEmpty();
223    this.gallery.refresh({
224      keepIndex: false
225    });
226    if (this.elements.itemsSection) this.elements.itemsSection.hidden = renderedItems === 0;
227
228    // [Customer 7.5] El precio base viene del nivel más específico con modo "prices";
229    // las opciones con modo "variation" se calculan como extras.
230    const priceSource = [...selectedRows].reverse().find(row => {
231      return String(row?.variation?.price_display_mode ?? "prices") === "prices" && Array.isArray(row?.prices) && row.prices.length > 0;
232    });
233    if (priceSource) {
234      // [Customer 8] PricesController pinta los rangos, selecciona uno y calcula el resumen.
235      const rows = priceSource.prices.map(price => ({
236        ...price,
237        price_display_mode: priceSource.variation?.price_display_mode || "prices"
238      }));
239      this.prices.render(rows);
240    } else {
241      this.prices.clear();
242    }
243  }
244
245  goBack() {
246    // [Customer 9.1] Este botón regresa al listado público de productos.
247    window.location.assign(new URL("../../view/product/index.php", window.location.href));
248  }
249
250  updatePurchaseActions(summary = {}) {
251    // [Customer 8.5] PricesController informa si existe una combinación completa y comprable.
252    this.purchaseReady = Boolean(summary.ready);
253    const disabled = !this.purchaseReady || this.purchasePending;
254    if (this.elements.addToCart) this.elements.addToCart.disabled = disabled;
255    if (this.elements.buyNow) this.elements.buyNow.disabled = disabled;
256  }
257
258  async submitPurchase(buyNow, savedPayload = null) {
259    // [Customer 10.1] No enviamos compras incompletas ni permitimos dos solicitudes simultáneas.
260    if (!this.purchaseReady || this.purchasePending || this.purchaseConfirming) return;
261    if (!savedPayload && !this.artworkUpload.validateSelection()) {
262      this.artworkUpload.input?.focus();
263      return;
264    }
265    if (!savedPayload && !this.artworkUpload.getFile()) {
266      this.purchaseConfirming = true;
267      try {
268        if (!await this.artworkUpload.confirmWithoutArtwork()) return;
269      } finally {
270        this.purchaseConfirming = false;
271      }
272      if (!this.purchaseReady || this.purchasePending) return;
273    }
274
275    // [Customer 10.1.1] Si venimos de autenticación usamos la copia guardada; de lo contrario,
276    // tomamos la cantidad, price_id y variaciones seleccionadas actualmente.
277    const quantity = Number(savedPayload?.quantity ?? this.store.selectedQuantity);
278    const priceId = Number(savedPayload?.price_id ?? this.store.selectedPriceId);
279    const variationIds = savedPayload?.variation_ids ? [...savedPayload.variation_ids] : [...new Set(this.store.getSelectedVariationIds())];
280    if (!Number.isInteger(quantity) || quantity <= 0 || !Number.isInteger(priceId) || priceId <= 0) {
281      this.showMessage("Please choose a valid product quantity before continuing.", "error");
282      return;
283    }
284    const purchasePayload = savedPayload || {
285      sku: this.sku,
286      quantity,
287      price_id: priceId,
288      variation_ids: variationIds,
289      intent: buyNow ? "buy_now" : "add_to_cart",
290      artwork_pdf: this.artworkUpload.getFile()
291    };
292    this.setPurchasePending(true, buyNow ? this.elements.buyNow : this.elements.addToCart);
293    this.hideMessage();
294    try {
295      // [Customer 10.2] PreviewApi envía la selección a controller/order/cart.php.
296      const request = new FormData();
297      request.append("action", "add_to_cart");
298      for (const key of ["sku", "quantity", "price_id", "intent"]) request.append(key, purchasePayload[key]);
299      purchasePayload.variation_ids.forEach(id => request.append("variation_ids[]", id));
300      if (purchasePayload.artwork_pdf) {
301        request.append("artwork_pdf", purchasePayload.artwork_pdf);
302        this.artworkUpload.setStatus("Uploading your artwork…");
303      }
304      const result = await this.makeRequest(this.api.cartUrl, request, {
305        requireSuccess: true
306      });
307
308      // [Customer 10.3] En éxito limpiamos el intento pendiente y avisamos al contador global del carrito.
309      this.pendingPurchase = null;
310      this.artworkUpload.markSaved(purchasePayload.artwork_pdf);
311      this.showMessage(result.message || "The product was added to your cart.", "success");
312      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("promoflow:cart-updated", {
313        detail: {
314          count: Number(result.cart_count) || 1
315        }
316      }));
317      if (buyNow) {
318        // [Customer 10.7] "Buy now" usa el mismo carrito y luego lleva al cliente a revisarlo.
319        window.location.assign(new URL("../../view/shopping_cart/index.php", window.location.href));
320      }
321    } catch (error) {
322      if (purchasePayload.artwork_pdf) {
323        this.artworkUpload.setStatus(error.status === 401
324          ? "Your PDF is selected. Sign in to upload it with this product."
325          : "Your artwork has not been saved. Please try adding the product again.");
326      }
327      // [Customer 10.4] Un 401/AUTH_REQUIRED no descarta la configuración: la guardamos y abrimos el modal.
328      if (error.status === 401 && (!error.code || error.code === "AUTH_REQUIRED")) {
329        this.pendingPurchase = {
330          buyNow,
331          payload: purchasePayload
332        };
333        this.showMessage(error.message, "info");
334        this.auth.open("login", error.message);
335        return;
336      }
337      this.pendingPurchase = null;
338      this.showMessage(error.message || "The product could not be added to your cart.", "error");
339    } finally {
340      this.setPurchasePending(false);
341    }
342  }
343
344  async resumePendingPurchase() {
345    // [Customer 10.6] Después de login/registro se repite exactamente el payload que había fallado.
346    const pending = this.pendingPurchase;
347    if (!pending) return;
348    this.showMessage("You are signed in. Adding your selected product…", "info");
349    await this.submitPurchase(pending.buyNow, pending.payload);
350  }
351
352  cancelPendingPurchase() {
353    // [Customer 10.4.11] Cerrar el modal cancela solo el intento; las opciones visibles siguen seleccionadas.
354    this.pendingPurchase = null;
355    this.showMessage("Sign in or create an account when you are ready to continue.", "info");
356  }
357
358  setPurchasePending(pending, activeButton = null) {
359    // [Customer 10.1.2] Mientras el servidor responde, ambos botones quedan bloqueados.
360    this.purchasePending = pending;
361    this.artworkUpload.setPending(pending);
362    [this.elements.addToCart, this.elements.buyNow].forEach(button => {
363      if (!button) return;
364      button.disabled = pending || !this.purchaseReady;
365      button.classList.toggle("is-loading", pending && button === activeButton);
366      button.setAttribute("aria-busy", String(pending && button === activeButton));
367    });
368  }
369
370  // [Customer 11] Estos métodos pequeños concentran cambios repetidos de interfaz.
371
372  setLoading(loading) {
373    if (this.elements.loading) this.elements.loading.hidden = !loading;
374    if (this.elements.content) this.elements.content.hidden = loading;
375  }
376
377  showFatal(message) {
378    this.setLoading(false);
379    if (this.elements.content) this.elements.content.hidden = true;
380    if (this.elements.fatal) this.elements.fatal.hidden = false;
381    if (this.elements.fatalMessage) this.elements.fatalMessage.textContent = message;
382  }
383
384  showMessage(message, tone = "info") {
385    if (!this.elements.notice) return;
386    this.elements.notice.textContent = message;
387    this.elements.notice.dataset.tone = tone;
388    this.elements.notice.setAttribute("role", tone === "error" ? "alert" : "status");
389    this.elements.notice.hidden = false;
390  }
391
392  hideMessage() {
393    if (this.elements.notice) this.elements.notice.hidden = true;
394  }
395
396  setText(id, value) {
397    const element = document.getElementById(id);
398    if (element) element.textContent = String(value ?? "");
399  }
400
401  async makeRequest(url, data, options = {}) {
402    const {
403      requireSuccess = false,
404      responseType = "json",
405      ...requestOptions
406    } = options;
407    const isFormData = data instanceof FormData;
408    const headers = new Headers(requestOptions.headers || {});
409    if (!isFormData && !headers.has("Content-Type")) headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
410    const response = await fetch(url, {
411      method: "POST",
412      credentials: "same-origin",
413      ...requestOptions,
414      headers,
415      body: isFormData ? data : JSON.stringify(data)
416    });
417    const text = await response.text();
418    let result;
419    try {
420      result = responseType === "text" ? text : JSON.parse(text);
421    } catch {
422      const error = new Error("The server returned an invalid response.");
423      error.status = response.status;
424      throw error;
425    }
426    if (!response.ok || requireSuccess && !result?.success) {
427      const error = new Error(result?.error || result?.message || "The request could not be completed.");
428      error.status = response.status;
429      error.code = result?.code || null;
430      error.details = result;
431      throw error;
432    }
433    return result;
434  }
435}

1/*
2 * [Customer 5.1 / 6.3 / 8.2]
3 * Store es la memoria temporal del preview. No dibuja HTML ni llama al servidor;
4 * conserva el producto, el precio y todas las ramas de variaciones elegidas.
5 */
6export class PreviewStore {
7  constructor() {
8    // [Customer 5.1.1] Toda instancia empieza con un estado conocido.
9    this.reset();
10  }
11
12  reset() {
13    // [Customer 5.1.2] Un reset evita que otro producto herede precio o selecciones anteriores.
14    this.product = null;
15    this.deliveryCatalog = null;
16    this.readiness = null;
17    this.permissions = {};
18    this.selectedPrice = null;
19    this.selectedPriceId = null;
20    this.selectedQuantity = null;
21    this.selectedDelivery = "normal";
22    this.loading = false;
23    this.error = null;
24    this.clearVariationSelections();
25  }
26
27  setProduct(payload) {
28    // [Customer 5.1.3] Conservamos únicamente las partes de la respuesta usadas por la interfaz.
29    this.product = payload.product || null;
30    this.deliveryCatalog = payload.delivery_catalog || null;
31    this.readiness = payload.readiness || null;
32    this.permissions = payload.permissions || {};
33  }
34
35  clearVariationSelections() {
36    // [Customer 6.3.1] La raíz se guarda aparte. Los Map permiten varias ramas en un mismo nivel.
37    this.rootVariation = null;
38    this.selectedByLevel = new Map();
39    this.groupLevels = new Map();
40  }
41
42  setRootVariation(row) {
43    // [Customer 6.3.2] La raíz aporta recursos generales y es el inicio de todo el árbol.
44    this.rootVariation = row && typeof row === "object" ? row : null;
45  }
46
47  setGroupSelection(level, groupKey, row, metadata = {}) {
48    // [Customer 6.3.3] groupKey identifica una rama por padre y tipo; así dos grupos hermanos
49    // pueden conservar su selección sin sobrescribirse.
50    const safeLevel = Math.max(1, Number(level) || 1);
51    const safeKey = String(groupKey || "").trim();
52    if (!safeKey || !row || typeof row !== "object") return false;
53
54    const previousLevel = this.groupLevels.get(safeKey);
55    if (previousLevel !== undefined && previousLevel !== safeLevel) {
56      const previousMap = this.selectedByLevel.get(previousLevel);
57      previousMap?.delete(safeKey);
58      if (previousMap?.size === 0) this.selectedByLevel.delete(previousLevel);
59    }
60
61    if (!this.selectedByLevel.has(safeLevel)) {
62      this.selectedByLevel.set(safeLevel, new Map());
63    }
64
65    this.selectedByLevel.get(safeLevel).set(safeKey, {
66      row,
67      level: safeLevel,
68      groupKey: safeKey,
69      parentVariationId: Number(metadata.parentVariationId) || 0,
70      typeId: String(metadata.typeId || "")
71    });
72    this.groupLevels.set(safeKey, safeLevel);
73    return true;
74  }
75
76  getGroupSelection(groupKey) {
77    // [Customer 6.3.4] Localizamos una selección sin recorrer todos los niveles.
78    const safeKey = String(groupKey || "").trim();
79    const level = this.groupLevels.get(safeKey);
80    if (level === undefined) return null;
81    return this.selectedByLevel.get(level)?.get(safeKey) || null;
82  }
83
84  removeGroupSelection(groupKey) {
85    // [Customer 6.3.5] Al cambiar un padre se elimina el estado de las ramas que dejan de existir.
86    const safeKey = String(groupKey || "").trim();
87    const level = this.groupLevels.get(safeKey);
88    if (level === undefined) return false;
89
90    const levelSelections = this.selectedByLevel.get(level);
91    levelSelections?.delete(safeKey);
92    if (levelSelections?.size === 0) this.selectedByLevel.delete(level);
93    this.groupLevels.delete(safeKey);
94    return true;
95  }
96
97  getSelectedEntries() {
98    // [Customer 7.1.1] Aplanamos los Map respetando el orden de niveles para renderizar la ruta.
99    const entries = [];
100    const levels = [...this.selectedByLevel.keys()].sort((a, b) => a - b);
101
102    for (const level of levels) {
103      for (const entry of this.selectedByLevel.get(level).values()) {
104        entries.push(entry);
105      }
106    }
107
108    return entries;
109  }
110
111  getSelectedRows() {
112    // [Customer 7.1.2] La lista final empieza con la raíz y continúa con todas las selecciones.
113    const rows = [];
114    if (this.rootVariation) rows.push(this.rootVariation);
115    rows.push(...this.getSelectedEntries().map((entry) => entry.row));
116    return rows;
117  }
118
119  getSelectedVariationIds() {
120    // [Customer 10.1.3] El carrito recibe únicamente IDs numéricos positivos.
121    return this.getSelectedRows()
122      .map((row) => Number(row?.variation?.variation_id))
123      .filter((id) => Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0);
124  }
125}

1/*
2 * [Customer 6]
3 * Este controlador recorre un árbol que puede tener varios grupos hermanos. Cada selección
4 * puede crear otra rama, por eso las solicitudes y el estado se identifican por groupKey.
5 */
6const reservedVariationParameters = new Set(["sku", "combination_id", "variation_ids", "intent"]);
7export function readVariationInput(params) {
8  // Los enlaces de combinaciones guardan Tipo=Variación. Esos pares legibles son
9  // la fuente de verdad; combination_id y variation_ids son solo metadatos del listado.
10  const options = {};
11  if (!params || typeof params.forEach !== "function") return {
12    options
13  };
14  params.forEach((value, key) => {
15    const typeName = String(key || "").trim();
16    // Una coma final suele llegar al copiar el enlace dentro de una frase.
17    const optionName = String(value || "").trim().replace(/,+$/u, "").trim();
18    if (!typeName || !optionName || reservedVariationParameters.has(typeName.toLowerCase())) return;
19    options[typeName] = optionName;
20  });
21  return {
22    options
23  };
24}
25export class VariationsController {
26  constructor(options = {}) {

29    this.store = options.store;
30    this.prices = options.prices;
31    this.variationChildrenAction = options.variationChildrenAction || "get_customer_variation_children";
32    this.preferredOptions = new Map(Object.entries(options.preferredOptions || {}).map(([typeName, optionName]) => [this.normalizeOptionText(typeName), String(optionName || "").trim()]));
33    this.hasVariationInput = this.preferredOptions.size > 0;
34    this.renderPath = options.renderPath || (() => {});
35    this.onError = options.onError || (() => {});
36    this.root = document.getElementById("wrap-variations-group");
37    this.empty = document.getElementById("variations_empty");
38    this.rowCache = new Map();
39    this.nodeCache = new Map();
40    this.generation = 0;
41    this.requestVersions = new Map();
42    this.requestControllers = new Map();
43    {
44      // [Customer 9.2] Un solo listener atiende opciones y headers, incluso los creados después.
45      this.root?.addEventListener("click", event => this.handleRootClick(event));
46    }
47  }
48
49  reset() {
50    // [Customer 6.1.1] Abortamos cada rama pendiente y borramos todo el árbol anterior.
51    for (const controller of this.requestControllers.values()) controller.abort();
52    this.requestControllers.clear();
53    this.requestVersions.clear();
54    this.rowCache.clear();
55    this.nodeCache.clear();
56    this.generation++;
57    this.store.clearVariationSelections();
58    if (this.root) this.root.innerHTML = "";

60  }
61
62  async loadRoot(rootVariationId) {
63    // [Customer 6.1.2] La raíz llega con la primera respuesta del producto y abre el recorrido.
64    this.reset();

66    if (!Number.isFinite(rootId) || rootId <= 0) {
67      this.setEmptyState(true, "No root variation is configured for this product.");

69      return false;
70    }
71    return this.loadNode(rootId, 0, {
72      requestKey: "__root__",
73      generation: this.generation,
74      ancestry: [],
75      isRoot: true,
76      parentVariationId: 0,

78    });
79  }
80
81  async loadNode(variationId, pathIndex, context = {}) {

83    const id = Number(variationId);
84    const generation = Number(context.generation ?? this.generation);
85    const ancestry = Array.isArray(context.ancestry) ? context.ancestry.map(Number) : [];

92    }

94    // [Customer 6.2.2] Cada grupo cancela únicamente su solicitud anterior, no las ramas hermanas.

101        result = {success: true, current: cachedRow, children: [], types: []};
102      }
103      if (!result) {

125            typeId: context.typeId

128      }
129
130      // [Customer 6.4] Se eliminan descendientes viejos del nodo y se redibujan recursos/precios.
131      this.removeDescendantsOfVariation(id);
132      this.renderPath();
133      const children = Array.isArray(result.children) ? result.children : [];
134      const types = Array.isArray(result.types) ? result.types : [];
135      if (children.length === 0) {
136        // [Customer 6.5] Una hoja termina solo esta rama; las ramas hermanas siguen intactas.
137        if (context.isRoot) {
138          this.setEmptyState(true, "No customer-selectable variations are configured yet.");
139        }
140        await this.prices.refreshVariationExtras();
141        return true;
142      }
143      this.setEmptyState(false);
144      // [Customer 6.6] Los hijos se agrupan por tipo y cada grupo recibe un groupKey único.
145      const childAncestry = [...ancestry, id];
146      const groups = this.renderChildGroups(children, types, pathIndex + 1, id, childAncestry);
147      for (const group of groups) {
148        if (!this.isRequestCurrent(requestKey, request.version, id, generation, context.isRoot)) {
149          return false;
150        }
151
152        // [Customer 6.7] Se completa cada grupo automáticamente, prefiriendo una opción gratis.
153        const defaultButton = this.getAutomaticOption(group);
154        if (defaultButton) await this.selectVariation(defaultButton, true);
155      }
156      return true;
157    } catch (error) {
158      if (error.name === "AbortError") return false;
159      if (generation === this.generation) {
160        this.onError(error.message || "Unable to load product variations.");
161      }
162      return false;
163    } finally {
164      if (this.requestControllers.get(requestKey) === request.controller) {
165        this.requestControllers.delete(requestKey);
166      }
167    }
168  }
169
170  async selectVariation(button) {
171    // [Customer 9.2.1] Una interacción identifica grupo, padre y ancestros antes de cambiar el estado.
172    if (!button) return false;
173    const group = button.closest(".wrap-variations[data-group-key]");
174    if (!group) return false;
175    const variationId = Number(button.dataset.variationId);
176    const pathIndex = Number(group.dataset.pathIndex);
177    const groupKey = String(group.dataset.groupKey || "");
178    const typeId = String(group.dataset.typeId || "");
179    const parentVariationId = Number(group.dataset.parentVariationId);
180    const ancestry = this.parseAncestry(group.dataset.ancestorIds);
181    if (!Number.isFinite(variationId) || variationId <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(pathIndex) || !groupKey) {
182      return false;
183    }
184    const row = this.rowCache.get(String(variationId));
185    if (!row) return false;
186    const previous = this.store.getGroupSelection(groupKey);
187    const previousVariationId = Number(previous?.row?.variation?.variation_id);
188    if (Number.isFinite(previousVariationId) && previousVariationId !== variationId) {
189      // [Customer 9.2.2] Si cambió la opción, sus descendientes ya no pertenecen a la configuración.
190      this.removeDescendantsOfVariation(previousVariationId);
191    }
192
193    // [Customer 9.2.3] La interfaz y Store se actualizan antes de pedir hijos de la nueva opción.
194    this.markSelected(button);
195    this.store.setGroupSelection(pathIndex, groupKey, row, {
196      parentVariationId,
197      typeId
198    });
199    this.renderPath();
200    return this.loadNode(variationId, pathIndex, {
201      requestKey: groupKey,
202      generation: this.generation,
203      ancestry,
204      isRoot: false,
205      parentVariationId,
206      typeId
207    });
208  }
209
210  renderChildGroups(children, types, pathIndex, parentVariationId, ancestry) {
211    // [Customer 6.6.1] Los nombres de tipo se indexan una vez y los hijos se separan con Map.
212    if (!this.root) return [];
213    const typeNames = new Map(types.map(type => [String(type?.type_id ?? ""), String(type?.type_name ?? "").trim()]));
214    const grouped = new Map();
215    for (const row of children) {
216      const variation = row?.variation;
217      const variationId = Number(variation?.variation_id);
218      const typeId = String(variation?.type_id ?? "").trim();
219      const typeName = String(variation?.type_name ?? typeNames.get(typeId) ?? "").trim();
220      const label = String(variation?.name ?? "").trim();
221      if (!Number.isFinite(variationId) || variationId <= 0 || !typeId || !typeName || !label) continue;
222      this.rowCache.set(String(variationId), row);
223      if (!grouped.has(typeId)) grouped.set(typeId, {
224        typeId,
225        typeName,
226        rows: []
227      });
228      grouped.get(typeId).rows.push(row);
229    }
230    const created = [];
231    for (const groupData of grouped.values()) {
232      // [Customer 6.6.2] Padre + tipo forman una identidad estable para esta rama.
233      const groupKey = this.buildGroupKey(parentVariationId, groupData.typeId);
234      const existing = this.root.querySelector(`.wrap-variations[data-group-key="${CSS.escape(groupKey)}"]`);
235      if (existing) this.removeGroupBranch(existing);
236      const group = this.createGroup(groupData, pathIndex, parentVariationId, ancestry, groupKey);
237      if (group) {
238        this.root.appendChild(group);
239        created.push(group);
240      }
241    }
242    return created;
243  }
244
245  createGroup(groupData, pathIndex, parentVariationId, ancestry, groupKey) {
246    // [Customer 6.6.3] El elemento conserva metadatos de árbol sin guardar objetos complejos en el DOM.
247    const group = document.createElement("section");
248    group.className = "wrap-variations is-collapsible";
249    group.dataset.groupKey = groupKey;
250    group.dataset.typeId = groupData.typeId;
251    group.dataset.typeName = groupData.typeName;
252    group.dataset.pathIndex = String(pathIndex);
253    group.dataset.parentVariationId = String(parentVariationId);
254    group.dataset.ancestorIds = ancestry.join(",");
255    const bodyId = `variation-options-${pathIndex}-${parentVariationId}-${groupData.typeId}`;
256    const header = document.createElement("button");
257    header.type = "button";
258    header.className = "var-collapse-header";
259    header.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
260    header.setAttribute("aria-controls", bodyId);
261    const heading = document.createElement("span");
262    heading.className = "var-collapse-heading";
263    const eyebrow = document.createElement("span");
264    eyebrow.className = "var-name";
265    eyebrow.textContent = groupData.typeName;
266    const selected = document.createElement("strong");
267    selected.className = "js-selected-variation-label";
268    selected.textContent = "Choose an option";
269    heading.append(eyebrow, selected);
270    const summary = document.createElement("span");
271    summary.className = "variation-summary-pill";
272    summary.textContent = `${groupData.rows.length} option${groupData.rows.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
273    const icon = document.createElement("span");
274    icon.className = "var-collapse-icon";
275    icon.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
276    icon.textContent = "+";
277    header.append(heading, summary, icon);
278    const body = document.createElement("div");
279    body.id = bodyId;
280    body.className = "var-collapse-body";
281    const options = document.createElement("div");
282    options.className = "var-options";
283    for (const row of groupData.rows) {
284      options.appendChild(this.createOption(row));
285    }
286    body.appendChild(options);
287    group.append(header, body);
288    return group;
289  }
290
291  createOption(row) {
292    // [Customer 6.6.4] El botón conserva el ID/modo de precio; la fila completa vive en rowCache.
293    const variation = row.variation;
294    const id = String(variation.variation_id);
295    const label = String(variation.name || "Option");
296    const button = document.createElement("button");
297    button.type = "button";
298    button.className = "var-option";
299    button.dataset.variationId = id;
300    button.dataset.variationLabel = label;
301    button.dataset.priceDisplayMode = String(variation.price_display_mode || "prices").toLowerCase();
302    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
303    const image = document.createElement("img");
304    image.className = "var-thumb";
305    image.src = this.resolveAssetPath(variation.image, "../../view/preview_product_customers/img/icon_product.png");
306    image.alt = "";
307    image.loading = "lazy";
308    const copy = document.createElement("span");
309    copy.className = "opt-copy";
310    const name = document.createElement("span");
311    name.className = "opt-main";
312    name.textContent = label;
313    copy.appendChild(name);
314    button.append(image, copy);
315    return button;
316  }
317
318  getAutomaticOption(group) {
319    // [Customer 6.7.1] Sin selección en la URL se conserva el comportamiento anterior:
320    // una opción gratis y, si no existe, la primera disponible.
321    if (!group) return null;
322    const buttons = Array.from(group.querySelectorAll(".var-option[data-variation-id]"));
323    const freeButton = buttons.find(button => {
324      const row = this.rowCache.get(String(button.dataset.variationId));
325      return this.isFreeExtra(row);
326    });
327    if (!this.hasVariationInput) return freeButton || buttons[0] || null;
328
329    // Cuando el enlace sí describe una combinación, buscamos el valor indicado
330    // para este tipo. Si este tipo no vino en la URL, aplicamos el fallback nuevo.
331    const preferredLabel = this.preferredOptions.get(this.normalizeOptionText(group.dataset.typeName));
332    const preferredLabelButton = preferredLabel ? buttons.find(button => this.normalizeOptionText(button.dataset.variationLabel) === this.normalizeOptionText(preferredLabel)) : null;
333    // Para un tipo que no vino en el enlace se usa la primera opción. La excepción
334    // son los extras: si price_display_mode="variation", evitamos agregar un coste
335    // implícito eligiendo primero una opción sin precio o con precio cero.
336    const freeExtraButton = buttons.find(button => {
337      if (button.dataset.priceDisplayMode !== "variation") return false;
338      const row = this.rowCache.get(String(button.dataset.variationId));
339      return this.isFreeExtra(row);
340    });
341    return preferredLabelButton || freeExtraButton || buttons[0] || null;
342  }
343
344  normalizeOptionText(value) {
345    return String(value || "").trim().toLocaleLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
346  }
347
348  isFreeExtra(row) {
349    // [Customer 6.7.2] Comprobamos el precio que cubre la cantidad actual.
350    const prices = Array.isArray(row?.prices) ? row.prices : [];
351    const quantity = Number(this.store.selectedQuantity);
352    if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0) {
353      return prices.length === 0 || prices.every(price => Number(price?.price) <= 0);
354    }
355    const applicablePrice = prices.find(price => {
356      const min = Number(price?.min_quantity);
357      const rawMax = price?.max_quantity;
358      const max = rawMax === null || rawMax === "" ? null : Number(rawMax);
359      const hasOpenMaximum = max === null || !Number.isFinite(max) || max <= 0;
360      return Number.isFinite(min) && quantity >= min && (hasOpenMaximum || quantity <= max);
361    });
362    if (applicablePrice) return Number(applicablePrice.price) <= 0;
363
364    // [Customer 6.7.3] Un hueco entre rangos configurados no significa que la opción sea gratis.
365    // Solo se considera gratis cuando todos sus precios configurados son cero.
366    return prices.every(price => Number(price?.price) <= 0);
367  }
368
369  markSelected(button) {
370    // [Customer 9.2.4] Solo una opción del grupo queda presionada y el header resume su nombre.
371    const group = button.closest(".wrap-variations");
372    if (!group) return;
373    group.querySelectorAll(".var-option").forEach(item => {
374      const selected = item === button;
375      item.classList.toggle("is-selected", selected);
376      item.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(selected));
377    });
378    const label = button.dataset.variationLabel || "Selected option";
379    const selectedLabel = group.querySelector(".js-selected-variation-label");
380    const summary = group.querySelector(".variation-summary-pill");
381    if (selectedLabel) selectedLabel.textContent = label;
382    if (summary) summary.textContent = `Selected: ${label}`;
383    this.openGroup(group);
384  }
385
386  openGroup(group) {
387    if (!group) return;
388    group.classList.add("is-open");
389    const header = group.querySelector(".var-collapse-header");
390    const icon = group.querySelector(".var-collapse-icon");
391    header?.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
392    if (icon) icon.textContent = "−";
393  }
394
395  removeDescendantsOfVariation(variationId) {
396    // [Customer 6.4.1] Buscamos únicamente grupos cuyo padre sea la variación invalidada.
397    if (!this.root) return;
398    const id = Number(variationId);
399    if (!Number.isFinite(id) || id <= 0) return;
400    const groups = Array.from(this.root.querySelectorAll(`.wrap-variations[data-parent-variation-id="${id}"]`));
401    groups.forEach(group => this.removeGroupBranch(group));
402  }
403
404  removeGroupBranch(group) {
405    // [Customer 6.4.2] La eliminación es recursiva: primero descendientes, luego request, Store y DOM.
406    if (!group) return;
407    const groupKey = String(group.dataset.groupKey || "");
408    const selected = this.store.getGroupSelection(groupKey);
409    const selectedVariationId = Number(selected?.row?.variation?.variation_id);
410    if (Number.isFinite(selectedVariationId) && selectedVariationId > 0) {
411      this.removeDescendantsOfVariation(selectedVariationId);
412    }
413    this.invalidateRequest(groupKey);
414    this.store.removeGroupSelection(groupKey);
415    group.remove();
416  }
417
418  startRequest(requestKey) {
419    // [Customer 6.2.4] Una versión por groupKey hace que una respuesta vieja no pueda sobrescribir la nueva.
420    this.requestControllers.get(requestKey)?.abort();
421    const version = (this.requestVersions.get(requestKey) || 0) + 1;
422    const controller = new AbortController();
423    this.requestVersions.set(requestKey, version);
424    this.requestControllers.set(requestKey, controller);
425    return {
426      version,
427      controller
428    };
429  }
430
431  invalidateRequest(requestKey) {
432    // [Customer 6.4.3] Al borrar una rama se invalida incluso una respuesta que esté por llegar.
433    if (!requestKey) return;
434    this.requestControllers.get(requestKey)?.abort();
435    this.requestControllers.delete(requestKey);
436    this.requestVersions.set(requestKey, (this.requestVersions.get(requestKey) || 0) + 1);
437  }
438
439  isRequestCurrent(requestKey, version, variationId, generation, isRoot = false) {
440    // [Customer 6.2.5] La respuesta solo vale si pertenece al árbol actual y a la opción aún seleccionada.
441    if (generation !== this.generation) return false;
442    if (this.requestVersions.get(requestKey) !== version) return false;
443    if (isRoot) return true;
444    const selected = this.store.getGroupSelection(requestKey);
445    return Number(selected?.row?.variation?.variation_id) === Number(variationId);
446  }
447
448  buildGroupKey(parentVariationId, typeId) {
449    // [Customer 6.6.5] Dos grupos solo son iguales si comparten padre y tipo.
450    return `${Number(parentVariationId) || 0}:${String(typeId || "")}`;
451  }
452
453  parseAncestry(value) {
454    return String(value || "").split(",").map(id => Number(id)).filter(id => Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0);
455  }
456
457  setEmptyState(show, message = "No variations configured.") {
458    if (!this.empty) return;
459    this.empty.hidden = !show;
460    const text = this.empty.querySelector("span:last-child");
461    if (text) text.textContent = message;
462  }
463
464  resolveAssetPath(rawPath = "", fallback = "") {
465    // [Customer 6.6.6] Una opción sin imagen usa el icono local del producto.
466    const path = String(rawPath ?? "").trim().replace(/^\/+/, "");
467    if (!path) return fallback ? new URL(fallback.replace(/^\.\.\/\.\.\//, ""), new URL("../../../", import.meta.url)).href : "";
468    if (/^(https?:|data:|blob:)/i.test(path)) return path;
469    const root = new URL("../../../", import.meta.url);
470    return new URL(path.startsWith("controller/") ? path : `controller/${path}`, root).href;
471  }
472
473  handleRootClick(event) {
474    const option = event.target.closest(".var-option[data-variation-id]");
475    if (option && this.root.contains(option)) {
476      this.selectVariation(option, false);
477      return;
478    }
479    const header = event.target.closest(".var-collapse-header");
480    if (!header || !this.root.contains(header)) return;
481    const group = header.closest(".wrap-variations");
482    if (!group) return;
483    const open = !group.classList.contains("is-open");
484    group.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
485    header.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
486    const icon = header.querySelector(".var-collapse-icon");
487    if (icon) icon.textContent = open ? "−" : "+";
488  }
489
490  async makeRequest(url, data, options = {}) {
491    const {
492      requireSuccess = false,
493      responseType = "json",
494      ...requestOptions
495    } = options;
496    const isFormData = data instanceof FormData;
497    const headers = new Headers(requestOptions.headers || {});
498    if (!isFormData && !headers.has("Content-Type")) headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
499    const response = await fetch(url, {
500      method: "POST",
501      credentials: "same-origin",
502      ...requestOptions,
503      headers,
504      body: isFormData ? data : JSON.stringify(data)
505    });
506    const text = await response.text();
507    let result;
508    try {
509      result = responseType === "text" ? text : JSON.parse(text);
510    } catch {
511      const error = new Error("The server returned an invalid response.");
512      error.status = response.status;
513      throw error;
514    }
515    if (!response.ok || requireSuccess && !result?.success) {
516      const error = new Error(result?.error || result?.message || "The request could not be completed.");
517      error.status = response.status;
518      error.code = result?.code || null;
519      error.details = result;
520      throw error;
521    }
522    return result;
523  }
524}

4/*
5 * [Customer 8]
6 * Este controlador une rangos de cantidad, extras de variaciones, disponibilidad
7 * y el resumen matemático que habilita o bloquea la compra.
8 */
9export class PricesController {
10  constructor(options = {}) {
11    // [Customer 8.1] onSummaryChange informa al coordinador cuándo la selección ya se puede comprar.
12    this.api = options.api;
13    this.store = options.store;
14    this.getSku = options.getSku || (() => "");
15    this.variationPricesAction = options.variationPricesAction || "get_customer_variation_prices";
16    this.onSummaryChange = options.onSummaryChange || (() => {});
17    this.root = document.getElementById("wrap-prices-group");
18    this.empty = document.getElementById("prices_empty");
19    this.abortController = null;
20    this.extraVersion = 0;
21    this.deliveryOptions = document.getElementById("delivery_options");
22    this.elements = {
23      unit: document.getElementById("bb_unit"),
24      quantity: document.getElementById("bb_unit_quantity"),
25      unitTotal: document.getElementById("bb_unit_total"),
26      extraUnit: document.getElementById("bb_extra_unit"),
27      extraQuantity: document.getElementById("bb_extra_quantity"),
28      extraTotal: document.getElementById("bb_extra_total"),
29      deliveryPercentage: document.getElementById("bb_delivery_percentage"),
30      deliverySurcharge: document.getElementById("bb_delivery_surcharge"),
31      total: document.getElementById("bb_total"),
32      mainPrice: document.getElementById("sp_price"),
33      quantityLabel: document.getElementById("var_label_quantity"),
34      unitHint: document.getElementById("sp_unit_hint")
35    };
36    this.quantitySelector = new QuantitySelector(this);
37    this.root?.addEventListener("click", event => this.handlePriceClick(event));
38    this.deliveryOptions?.addEventListener("change", event => {
39      if (!event.target.matches('input[name="delivery_option"]')) return;
40      this.store.selectedDelivery = event.target.value;
41      this.updateSummary();
42    });
43  }
44
45  clear() {
46    // [Customer 8.1.1] Cancelamos cálculos viejos y devolvemos precio/cantidad al estado inicial.
47    this.abortController?.abort();
48    this.abortController = null;
49    this.extraVersion++;
50    if (this.root) this.root.innerHTML = "";
51    this.store.selectedPrice = null;
52    this.store.selectedPriceId = null;
53    this.store.selectedQuantity = null;
54    this.quantitySelector.sync(null);
55    this.setEmptyState(true);
56    this.updateSummary();
57  }
58
59  render(rows = []) {
60    // [Customer 8.1.2] Recordamos la cantidad para conservarla si otra variación ofrece el mismo rango.
61    const preferredQuantity = Number(this.store.selectedQuantity);
62    this.clear();
63    if (!this.root || !Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length === 0) return false;
64
65    // [Customer 8.1.3] Solo los registros de precio base se muestran como rangos y se ordenan.
66    const sorted = [...rows].filter(row => String(row?.price_display_mode ?? "prices") === "prices").sort((a, b) => Number(a?.min_quantity) - Number(b?.min_quantity));
67    if (sorted.length === 0) return false;
68    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
69    for (const row of sorted) {
70      // [Customer 8.1.4] Cada precio válido se transforma en botón y conserva price_id para el carrito.
71      const min = Number(row?.min_quantity);
72      const max = Number(row?.max_quantity);
73      const price = Number(row?.price);
74      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(min) || min <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(price)
75        || (max > 0 && (!Number.isSafeInteger(max) || max < min))) continue;
76      const button = document.createElement("button");
77      button.type = "button";
78      button.className = "price-tier";
79      button.dataset.priceId = String(row?.price_id ?? "");
80      button.dataset.quantity = String(min);
81      button.dataset.minQuantity = String(min);
82      button.dataset.maxQuantity = Number.isFinite(max) ? String(max) : "";
83      button.dataset.price = String(price);
84      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
85      const quantity = document.createElement("strong");
86      quantity.textContent = min.toLocaleString("en-GB");
87      const range = document.createElement("span");
88      range.textContent = Number.isFinite(max) && max >= min ? `${min.toLocaleString("en-GB")}–${max.toLocaleString("en-GB")} units` : `${min.toLocaleString("en-GB")}+ units`;
89      const amount = document.createElement("span");
90      amount.className = "price-tier-amount";
91      amount.textContent = `£${this.formatMoney(price)} each`;
92      button.append(quantity, range, amount);
93      fragment.appendChild(button);
94    }
95    this.root.appendChild(fragment);
96    const first = this.root.querySelector(".price-tier");
97    if (!first) return false;
98
99    // [Customer 8.2] Se elige la cantidad anterior si todavía existe; de lo contrario, el primer rango.
100    const preferred = this.quantitySelector.find(preferredQuantity);
101    this.setEmptyState(false);
102    this.select(preferred || first, preferred ? preferredQuantity : Number(first.dataset.quantity));
103    return true;
104  }
105
106  select(button, quantity = Number(button?.dataset.quantity)) {
107    // [Customer 8.2.1] La selección visual, cantidad, precio y price_id se actualizan juntos.
108    if (!this.root) return false;
109    this.root.querySelectorAll(".price-tier").forEach(item => {
110      const selected = item === button;
111      item.classList.toggle("is-selected", selected);
112      item.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(selected));
113    });
114    const price = Number(button?.dataset.price);
115    const priceId = Number(button?.dataset.priceId);
116    this.store.selectedQuantity = Number.isFinite(quantity) ? quantity : null;
117    this.quantitySelector.sync(this.store.selectedQuantity);
118    this.store.selectedPrice = Number.isFinite(price) ? price : null;
119    this.store.selectedPriceId = Number.isInteger(priceId) && priceId > 0 ? priceId : null;
120
121    // [Customer 8.2.2] Cambiar cantidad puede cambiar precio o disponibilidad de todos los extras.
122    this.refreshVariationExtras();
123    this.updateSummary();
124    return true;
125  }
126
127  async refreshVariationExtras() {
128    // [Customer 8.3] La versión permite ignorar respuestas antiguas si la cantidad cambia rápido.
129    const requestVersion = ++this.extraVersion;
130    this.resetVariationPriceOptions();
131    const quantity = Number(this.store.selectedQuantity);
132    if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0) {
133      this.updateSummary();
134      return;
135    }
136
137    // [Customer 8.3.1] Todos los IDs visibles viajan en una sola solicitud.
138    const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#wrap-variations-group .var-option[data-variation-id]"));
139    const ids = buttons.map(button => Number(button.dataset.variationId)).filter(id => Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0);
140    if (ids.length === 0) {
141      this.updateSummary();
142      return;
143    }
144    this.abortController?.abort();
145    this.abortController = new AbortController();
146    try {
147      // [Customer 8.3.2] PreviewApi continúa el flujo en controller/order/product.php.
148      const result = variationExtras(this.store.deliveryCatalog, ids, quantity) || await this.makeRequest(this.api.previewUrl, {
149        action: this.variationPricesAction,
150        sku: this.getSku(),
151        ids: ids,
152        quantity: quantity
153      }, {
154        requireSuccess: true,
155        signal: this.abortController.signal
156      });
157      if (requestVersion !== this.extraVersion) return;
158
159      // [Customer 8.3.3] Limpiamos otra vez porque el DOM pudo cambiar durante la espera.
160      this.resetVariationPriceOptions();
161
162      // [Customer 8.3.4] Un Map resuelve extras y un Set distingue precio cero de rango inexistente.
163      const priceById = new Map((result.prices || []).map(row => [String(row.variation_id), Number(row.price)]));
164      const pricedVariationIds = new Set((result.priced_variation_ids || []).map(id => String(id)));
165      for (const button of buttons) {
166        const variationId = String(button.dataset.variationId);
167        const hasApplicablePrice = priceById.has(variationId);
168        const extra = priceById.get(variationId);
169        if (hasApplicablePrice && Number.isFinite(extra)) {
170          button.dataset.extraPrice = String(Math.max(0, extra));
171          if (extra > 0) {
172            const label = document.createElement("span");
173            label.className = "opt-price-extra";
174            label.textContent = `+£${this.formatMoney(extra)} each`;
175            button.appendChild(label);
176          }
177        } else if (button.dataset.priceDisplayMode === "variation" && pricedVariationIds.has(variationId)) {
178          // [Customer 8.3.5] Esta opción sí tiene precios configurados, pero ninguno cubre la cantidad elegida.
179          button.classList.add("is-price-unavailable");
180          button.disabled = true;
181          button.title = "This option has no price for the selected quantity";
182          const label = document.createElement("span");
183          label.className = "opt-price-extra is-unavailable";
184          label.textContent = "Unavailable";
185          button.appendChild(label);
186        } else if (button.dataset.priceDisplayMode === "variation") {
187          button.dataset.extraPrice = "0";
188        }
189      }
190      this.updateSummary();
191    } catch (error) {
192      // [Customer 8.3.6] Una cancelación es esperada; otros errores se registran para diagnóstico.
193      if (error.name !== "AbortError") {
194        console.error("Unable to load variation prices:", error);
195      }
196    }
197  }
198
199  updateSummary() {
200    // [Customer 8.4] Se suman precio base y extras por unidad, luego se multiplican por cantidad.
201    const quantity = Number(this.store.selectedQuantity);
202    const basePrice = Number(this.store.selectedPrice);
203    const hasPrice = Number.isFinite(quantity) && quantity > 0 && this.store.selectedPrice !== null && Number.isFinite(basePrice);
204    let extrasPerUnit = 0;
205    const selectedOptions = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#wrap-variations-group .var-option.is-selected"));
206    const hasUnavailableSelection = selectedOptions.some(button => button.classList.contains("is-price-unavailable"));
207    selectedOptions.forEach(button => {
208      const value = Number(button.dataset.extraPrice);
209      if (Number.isFinite(value)) extrasPerUnit += value;
210    });
211    const safeQuantity = hasPrice ? quantity : 0;
212    const safeBase = hasPrice ? basePrice : 0;
213    const baseTotal = safeBase * safeQuantity;
214    const extrasTotal = extrasPerUnit * safeQuantity;
215    const subtotalPence = Math.round((baseTotal + extrasTotal) * 100);
216    const deliveryResult = commonDelivery(this.store.deliveryCatalog, (this.store.getSelectedVariationIds?.() || []), this.store.selectedPriceId, safeQuantity, subtotalPence);
217    const chosen = renderDelivery(this.deliveryOptions?.querySelector('.delivery-options-list'), deliveryResult, this.store.selectedDelivery);
218    this.store.selectedDelivery = chosen ? String(chosen.days) : null;
219    const deliveryUnavailable = deliveryResult.configured && !chosen;
220    const deliveryPercentage = chosen?.breakdown.filter(item => item.type === 'percentage').reduce((sum,item)=>sum+item.value,0) || 0;
221    const deliveryPence = chosen?.pence || 0;
222    const deliverySurcharge = deliveryPence / 100;
223    const total = (subtotalPence + deliveryPence) / 100;
224
225    // [Customer 8.4.1] Si la opción seleccionada no tiene precio, no mostramos un total engañoso.
226    this.setText(this.elements.unit, hasPrice ? `£${this.formatMoney(safeBase)}` : "—");
227    this.setText(this.elements.quantity, hasPrice ? safeQuantity.toLocaleString("en-GB") : "—");
228    this.setText(this.elements.unitTotal, hasPrice ? `£${this.formatMoney(baseTotal)}` : "—");
229    this.setText(this.elements.extraUnit, hasPrice && !hasUnavailableSelection ? `£${this.formatMoney(extrasPerUnit)}` : "—");
230    this.setText(this.elements.extraQuantity, hasPrice && !hasUnavailableSelection && extrasPerUnit > 0 ? safeQuantity.toLocaleString("en-GB") : "—");
231    this.setText(this.elements.extraTotal, hasPrice && !hasUnavailableSelection ? `£${this.formatMoney(extrasTotal)}` : "—");
232    this.setText(this.elements.deliveryPercentage, chosen ? `(${chosen.days} days)` : "");
233    this.setText(this.elements.deliverySurcharge, hasPrice && !hasUnavailableSelection ? `£${this.formatMoney(deliverySurcharge)}` : "—");
234    this.setText(this.elements.total, hasPrice && !hasUnavailableSelection && !deliveryUnavailable ? `£${this.formatMoney(total)}` : "—");
235    this.setText(this.elements.mainPrice, hasPrice ? this.formatMoney(safeBase) : "—");
236    this.setText(this.elements.quantityLabel, hasPrice ? `${safeQuantity.toLocaleString("en-GB")} units` : "Select a price tier");
237    this.setText(this.elements.unitHint, hasPrice ? hasUnavailableSelection ? "Choose an available option for this quantity" : `per unit at ${safeQuantity.toLocaleString("en-GB")} units` : "Pricing not configured");
238
239    // [Customer 8.5] Solo una combinación con precio base, price_id y extras disponibles queda lista.
240    this.onSummaryChange({
241      ready: hasPrice && !hasUnavailableSelection && !deliveryUnavailable && Number(this.store.selectedPriceId) > 0,
242      quantity: safeQuantity,
243      basePrice: safeBase,
244      extrasPerUnit,
245      deliveryOption: chosen ? String(chosen.days) : null,
246      deliveryPercentage,
247      deliverySurcharge,
248      total
249    });
250  }
251
252  resetVariationPriceOptions() {
253    // [Customer 8.3.7] Este helper concentra la limpieza usada antes y después de la solicitud.
254    document.querySelectorAll("#wrap-variations-group .opt-price-extra").forEach(node => node.remove());
255    document.querySelectorAll("#wrap-variations-group .var-option").forEach(button => {
256      delete button.dataset.extraPrice;
257      button.classList.remove("is-price-unavailable");
258      button.disabled = false;
259      button.removeAttribute("title");
260    });
261  }
262
263  setEmptyState(show) {
264    if (this.empty) this.empty.hidden = !show;
265  }
266
267  setText(element, value) {
268    if (element) element.textContent = value;
269  }
270
271  formatMoney(value) {
272    // [Customer 8.4.2] La interfaz siempre presenta dos decimales y nunca muestra NaN.
273    const number = Number(value);
274    return Number.isFinite(number) ? number.toFixed(2) : "0.00";
275  }
276
277  handlePriceClick(event) {
278    const button = event.target.closest(".price-tier");
279    if (!button || !this.root.contains(button)) return;
280    this.select(button);
281  }
282
283  async makeRequest(url, data, options = {}) {
284    const {
285      requireSuccess = false,
286      responseType = "json",
287      ...requestOptions
288    } = options;
289    const isFormData = data instanceof FormData;
290    const headers = new Headers(requestOptions.headers || {});
291    if (!isFormData && !headers.has("Content-Type")) headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
292    const response = await fetch(url, {
293      method: "POST",
294      credentials: "same-origin",
295      ...requestOptions,
296      headers,
297      body: isFormData ? data : JSON.stringify(data)
298    });
299    const text = await response.text();
300    let result;
301    try {
302      result = responseType === "text" ? text : JSON.parse(text);
303    } catch {
304      const error = new Error("The server returned an invalid response.");
305      error.status = response.status;
306      throw error;
307    }
308    if (!response.ok || requireSuccess && !result?.success) {
309      const error = new Error(result?.error || result?.message || "The request could not be completed.");
310      error.status = response.status;
311      error.code = result?.code || null;
312      error.details = result;
313      throw error;
314    }
315    return result;
316  }
317}

1export class QuantitySelector {
2  constructor(controller) {
3    this.controller = controller;
4    this.root = document.getElementById('quantity_selector');
5    this.slider = document.getElementById('quantity_slider');
6    this.input = document.getElementById('quantity_input');
7    this.slider?.addEventListener('input', () => this.choose(this.slider.value));
8    this.input?.addEventListener('input', () => {
9      const quantity = this.input.valueAsNumber;
10      if (Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) && quantity > 0) this.choose(quantity);
11    });
12    this.input?.addEventListener('change', () => this.choose(this.input.valueAsNumber));
13    this.input?.addEventListener('blur', () => this.choose(this.input.valueAsNumber));
14    this.input?.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
15      if (event.key === 'Enter') {
16        event.preventDefault();
17        this.choose(this.input.valueAsNumber);
18      }
19    });
20  }
21
22  tiers() {
23    return Array.from(this.controller.root?.querySelectorAll('.price-tier') || []);
24  }
25
26  maximum(button) {
27    const max = Number(button.dataset.maxQuantity);
28    return max > 0 ? max : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
29  }
30
31  find(quantity) {
32    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) || quantity <= 0) return null;
33    return this.tiers().reverse().find(button => quantity >= Number(button.dataset.minQuantity)
34      && quantity <= this.maximum(button));
35  }
36
37  choose(value) {
38    const tiers = this.tiers();
39    if (!tiers.length) return;
40    let quantity = Number(value);
41    if (!Number.isFinite(quantity)) quantity = this.controller.store.selectedQuantity;
42    quantity = Math.max(1, Math.round(quantity));
43    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(quantity)) return;
44    const tier = this.find(quantity);
45    this.controller.select(tier, quantity);
46  }
47
48  sync(quantity) {
49    const tiers = this.tiers();
50    if (!this.root || !this.slider || !this.input) return;
51    this.root.hidden = !tiers.length;
52    if (!tiers.length) return;
53    const min = 1;
54    const max = 20000;
55    this.slider.min = String(min);
56    this.slider.max = String(max);
57    this.slider.value = String(Math.min(max, Math.max(min, quantity)));
58    this.slider.disabled = false;
59    this.input.min = String(min);
60    this.input.removeAttribute('max');
61    this.input.value = String(quantity);
62    this.input.disabled = false;
63    this.slider.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', `${Number(this.slider.value).toLocaleString('en-GB')} units`);
64    document.getElementById('quantity_min').textContent = min.toLocaleString('en-GB');
65    document.getElementById('quantity_max').textContent = max.toLocaleString('en-GB');
66  }
67}

1// Shared by Supplier, Customer and Promoflow previews. All money is in pence.
2export function commonDelivery(catalog, selectedIds, priceId, quantity, subtotalPence) {
3  const ids = new Set(selectedIds.map(Number));
4  const variations = (catalog?.variations || []).filter(v => ids.has(Number(v.id)));
5  const sources = variations.map(v => ({name:v.name, options:v.options || []}));
6  const priceIds = new Set([Number(priceId)]);
7  for (const variation of variations.filter(v => v.mode === 'variation')) {
8    const tier = (catalog?.prices || []).find(p => Number(p.variationId) === Number(variation.id) && quantity >= p.min && (!p.max || quantity <= p.max));
9    if (tier) priceIds.add(Number(tier.id));
10  }
11  for (const price of catalog?.prices || []) {
12    if (!priceIds.has(Number(price.id)) || !ids.has(Number(price.variationId)) || quantity < price.min || (price.max && quantity > price.max)) continue;
13    sources.push({name:`Quantity tier ${price.min}–${price.max || 'No limit'}`, options:price.options || []});
14  }
15  const configured = sources.filter(source => source.options.length);
16  if (!configured.length) return {configured:false, options:[]};
17  const days = configured[0].options.map(option => Number(option.days)).filter(day => configured.every(source => source.options.some(option => Number(option.days) === day)));
18  const options = [...new Set(days)].sort((a,b)=>a-b).map(day => {
19    const breakdown = configured.map(source => {
20      const option = source.options.find(item => Number(item.days) === day);
21      const pence = option.type === 'percentage' ? Math.round(subtotalPence * Number(option.value) / 100) : Math.round(Number(option.value) * 100);
22      return {name:source.name, type:option.type, value:Number(option.value), pence};
23    });
24    return {days:day, pence:breakdown.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+item.pence,0), breakdown};
25  });
26  return {configured:true, options};
27}
28
29export function renderDelivery(container, result, selected) {
30  if (!container) return null;
31  const section = container.closest('.delivery-options');
32  if (section) section.hidden = !result.configured;
33  if (!result.configured) {
34    container.replaceChildren();
35    return null;
36  }
37  const chosen = result.options.find(option => String(option.days) === String(selected)) || result.options[result.options.length-1] || null;
38  const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
39  if (!result.options.length) {
40    const message = document.createElement('p');
41    message.textContent = 'No common delivery option';
42    fragment.appendChild(message);
43  }
44  for (const option of result.options) {
45    const block = document.createElement('div');
46    const label = document.createElement('label'); label.className='delivery-option';
47    const radio = document.createElement('input');radio.type='radio';radio.name='delivery_option';radio.value=String(option.days);radio.checked=option===chosen;
48    const text = document.createElement('strong');text.textContent=`${option.days} days · +£${(option.pence/100).toFixed(2)}`;
49    label.append(radio,text);block.appendChild(label);
50    const details=document.createElement('details');const summary=document.createElement('summary');summary.textContent='View breakdown';details.appendChild(summary);
51    for(const item of option.breakdown){const line=document.createElement('p');line.textContent=`${item.name}: ${item.type==='percentage'?item.value+'%':'£'+item.value.toFixed(2)} → £${(item.pence/100).toFixed(2)}`;details.appendChild(line);}
52    block.appendChild(details);fragment.appendChild(block);
53  }
54  container.replaceChildren(fragment);
55  return chosen;
56}
57
58// Reuse the authorized product snapshot instead of requesting extras after every selection.
59export function variationExtras(catalog, ids, quantity) {
60  if (!catalog || !Array.isArray(catalog.prices) || !Array.isArray(catalog.variations)
61      || catalog.prices.some(price => !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(price, 'price'))) return null;
62  const wanted = new Set(ids.map(Number));
63  const extras = new Set(catalog.variations.filter(v => wanted.has(Number(v.id)) && v.mode === 'variation').map(v => Number(v.id)));
64  const tiers = [...catalog.prices].sort((a,b) => Number(b.min)-Number(a.min) || Number(b.id)-Number(a.id));
65  const prices = new Map(); const configured = new Set();
66  for (const tier of tiers) {
67    const id = Number(tier.variationId);
68    if (!extras.has(id)) continue;
69    if (Number(tier.price) > 0) configured.add(id);
70    if (!prices.has(id) && quantity >= Number(tier.min) && (!(Number(tier.max) > 0) || quantity <= Number(tier.max))) {
71      prices.set(id, {variation_id:id, price:Number(tier.price), price_display_mode:'variation'});
72    }
73  }
74  return {success:true, prices:[...prices.values()], priced_variation_ids:[...configured]};
75}

8      autoLoad: false,
9      previewUrl: "../../controller/dot63/requests_63_api.php",
10      productUrl: "../../controller/dot63/requests_63_api.php",
11      previewAction: "get_review_preview",
12      variationChildrenAction: "get_review_variation_children",
13      variationPricesAction: "get_review_variation_prices"
14    });
15    this.statusRequest = null;
16    this.approving = false;
17    document.getElementById("btn_msn_supplier")?.addEventListener("click", () => this.MsnSupplier());
18    this.getProduct();
19  }
20
21  renderProduct(payload) {
22    super.renderProduct(payload);
23    this.renderApprovalRequest(payload.product, payload.permissions);
24  }
25
26  renderApprovalRequest(product = {}, permissions = {}) {
27    const pending = product.pending_status != null;
28    const available = permissions.approval_available !== false;
29    this.statusRequest = pending && available && permissions.can_approve === true ? { ...product } : null;
30    const summary = document.getElementById("approval_status_summary");
31    if (summary) {
32      summary.textContent = `Current status: ${product.status_label || "Draft"}. ` + (
33        !available ? "Status approval is temporarily unavailable." :
34        pending ? `Requested status: ${product.pending_status_label}. The current status remains in effect until approval.` :
35        "No status change is awaiting approval."
36      );
37    }
38    const button = document.getElementById("btn_publish");
39    if (button) {
40      button.hidden = false;
41      button.disabled = !this.statusRequest || this.approving;
42      button.querySelector(".btn-label").textContent = pending ? `Approve: ${product.pending_status_label}` : "No pending change";
43      button.title = !available ? "Status approval is temporarily unavailable" :
44        pending && !this.statusRequest ? "Complete the product checklist before approving this status" : "";
45    }
46  }
47
48  async submitForApproval() {
49    if (!this.statusRequest || this.approving) return;
50    this.approving = true;
51    const request = this.statusRequest;
52    const button = this.elements.publish;
53    button.disabled = true;
54    button.classList.add("is-loading");
55    try {
56      const result = await this.makeRequest(this.api.productUrl, {
57        action: "approve_product",
58        sku: this.sku,
59        requested_status: request.pending_status,
60        status_request_version: request.status_request_version
61      }, { requireSuccess: true });
62      this.statusRequest = null;
63      await this.getProduct();
64      this.showMessage(result.message || "The status change has been approved.", "success");
65    } catch (error) {
66      // Refresh a stale request, but leave approving the new request to a separate click.
67      if (error.status === 409) await this.getProduct();
68      this.showMessage(error.message || "Unable to approve the status change.", "error");
69    } finally {
70      this.approving = false;
71      button.classList.remove("is-loading");
72      button.disabled = !this.statusRequest;
73    }
74  }
75
76  goBack() {
77    window.location.assign("../../view/overview/index.php");
78  }
79
80  MsnSupplier() {
81    if (this.sku) window.location.assign(`../../view/messages/index.php?sku=${encodeURIComponent(this.sku)}`);
82  }
83}
84
85const previewLogic = new PreviewLogic();
86window.previewLogic = previewLogic;

10    public function __construct()
11    {
12        $configured = trim((string)getenv('DOT63_WEBHOOK_URL'));
13        if ($configured !== '') {
14            $this->dot63WebhookUrl = $configured;
15        } elseif (in_array($_SERVER['SERVER_NAME'] ?? '', ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1'], true)) {
16            $port = (int)($_SERVER['SERVER_PORT'] ?? 80);
17            $this->dot63WebhookUrl = 'http://127.0.0.1' . ($port === 80 ? '' : ':' . $port)
18                . '/Dot63_v1/controller/promoflow/promoflow_webhook.php';
19        }
20    }
21
22    public function handleResques63API()
23    {
24        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
25
26        $input = file_get_contents('php://input');
27        $data  = json_decode($input, true);
28
29        if (!is_array($data)) {
30            echo json_encode([
31                'success' => false,
32                'error' => 'Invalid JSON payload.'
33            ]);
34            exit;
35        }
36
37        // This is an internal API: every forwarded action requires a Promoflow session.
38        if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST'
39            || stripos($_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '', 'application/json') !== 0) {
40            http_response_code(415);
41            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'A JSON POST request is required.']);
42            exit;
43        }
44        if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_ORIGIN'])) {
45            $origin = parse_url($_SERVER['HTTP_ORIGIN']);
46            $scheme = !empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off' ? 'https' : 'http';
47            $expected = $scheme . '://' . ($_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? '');
48            if (rtrim($_SERVER['HTTP_ORIGIN'], '/') !== $expected) {
49                http_response_code(403);
50                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Cross-origin requests are not allowed.']);
51                exit;
52            }
53        }
54        if (session_status() !== PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) session_start();
55        if (($_SESSION['is_logged'] ?? false) !== true || empty($_SESSION['user_email'])) {
56            session_write_close();
57            http_response_code(401);
58            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Sign in to Promoflow to use this API.']);
59            exit;
60        }
61        if (empty($_SESSION['dot63_csrf_token'])) $_SESSION['dot63_csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
62        $this->approvalCsrfToken = $_SESSION['dot63_csrf_token'];
63        $this->approvalSessionCookie = session_name() . '=' . rawurlencode(session_id());
64        session_write_close();
65
66        switch ($data["action"] ?? null) {
67            case 'get_review_preview':
68            case 'get_review_variation_children':
69            case 'get_review_variation_prices':
70                $this->sendToDot63(array_intersect_key($data, array_flip(['action', 'sku', 'variation_id', 'ids', 'quantity'])));
71                break;
72
73            case 'get_API_overview_data':
74                $this->getAPIOverviewData();
75                break;
76
77            case 'get_preview_product_details':
78                $this->getPreviewProductDetails($data);
79                break;
80
81            case 'approve_product':
82                $this->approveProduct($data);
83                break;
84
85            case 'publish_product':
86                $this->publishProduct($data);
87                break;
88
89            case 'get_variation_children_by_id':
90                $this->getVariationChildrenById($data);
91                break;
92
93            case 'get_variation_prices':
94                $this->getVariationPrices($data);
95                break;
96
97            default:
98                echo json_encode([
99                    'success' => false,
100                    'error' => 'Unsupported action.'
101                ]);
102                break;
103        }
104
105        exit;
106    }

108    public function sendToDot63($payload)
109    {
110        $ch = curl_init($this->dot63WebhookUrl);
111
112        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
113            CURLOPT_POST => true,
114            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
115            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => [
116                'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8',
117                'X-Dot63-CSRF-Token: ' . $this->approvalCsrfToken,
118            ],
119            CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => json_encode($payload),
120            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 20,
121        ]);
122
123        if ($this->approvalSessionCookie !== '') curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_COOKIE, $this->approvalSessionCookie);
124        $response = curl_exec($ch);
125        $curlError = curl_error($ch);
126        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
127
128        curl_close($ch);
129
130        if ($response === false || !empty($curlError)) {
131            http_response_code(502);
132            echo json_encode([
133                'success' => false,
134                'error' => 'Could not connect to DOT63 API.',
135                'curl_error' => $curlError
136            ]);
137            exit;
138        }
139
140        if ($httpCode < 200 || $httpCode >= 300) {
141            http_response_code($httpCode >= 400 && $httpCode <= 599 ? $httpCode : 502);
142            $error = json_decode((string)$response, true);
143            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $error['message'] ?? $error['error'] ?? 'DOT63 API could not process the request.']);
144            exit;
145        }
146
147        echo $response;
148        exit;
149    }
150

110          || filter_var($data['status_request_version'], FILTER_VALIDATE_INT) === false
111          || !in_array($data['requested_status'], [0, 1, 2, 3, '0', '1', '2', '3'], true)) {
112        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Reload the product and review the pending status before approving.', 422);
113      }

115        (string)$data['sku'], (int)$data['status_request_version'], (int)$data['requested_status']

120      http_response_code(in_array($code, [404, 409, 422], true) ? $code : 500);
121      if (!in_array($code, [404, 409, 422], true)) error_log('Approval failed: ' . $error->getMessage());
122      echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => in_array($code, [404, 409, 422], true) ? $error->getMessage() : 'Unable to approve this change.']);
123    }

245      ];

251    ]);

3/**
4 * =====================================================
5 * Class: Price
6 * Handles AJAX requests for the "Prices" module
7 * (similar structure to Items/Image controller)
8 * =====================================================
9 */
10class Price {
11
12  public function handleAjax(): void
13  {
14      // 1) Detect request content type (igual)
15      $contentType = $_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? $_SERVER['HTTP_CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '';
16
17      // 2) Normalise $data (JSON o POST/multipart) (igual)
18      $data = [];
19      if (stripos($contentType, 'application/json') !== false) {
20          $raw  = file_get_contents('php://input');
21          $json = json_decode($raw, true);
22          if (is_array($json)) {
23              $data = $json;
24          }
25      } else {
26          $data = $_POST;
27      }
28
29      // 3) Determine requested action
30      $action = $data['action'] ?? null;
31
32      // 4) Route
33    CatalogAccess::enforce('price', is_array($data) ? $data : []);
34
35      switch ($action) {
36          case 'get_prices_details':
37              $this->getPricesDetails($data);
38              break;
39
40          case 'create_prices':
41              $this->savePrices($data);
42              break;
43
44          case 'delete_price':
45              $this->deletePrice($data);
46              break;
47
48          default:
49              header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
50              echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Unsupported action']);
51              break;
52      }
53  }
54
55  /**
56   * -----------------------------------------------------
57   * Delete a single price row by id_price (optionally validates SKU variation)
58   * -----------------------------------------------------
59   */
60  private function deletePrice($data): void
61  {
62      $connection = new Database();
63      $price = new Prices($connection); // usa el modelo Prices
64
65      $idPrice = $data['id_price'] ?? null;
66      if (!$idPrice) {
67          header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
68          echo json_encode(["success" => false, "error" => "Missing id_price"]);
69          return;
70      }
71
72      // Si te llega sku_variation, validará pertenencia antes de borrar
73      if (!empty($data['sku_variation'])) {
74          $price->setSKUVariation($data['sku_variation']);
75      }
76
77      $price->setPriceId($idPrice);
78      $ok = $price->deletePricesByIdItem();
79
80      header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
81      echo json_encode([ "success" => $ok ]);
82  }

84  /**

89   private function getPricesDetails($data): void
