92
93       $connection = new Database();
94       $price = new Prices($connection);
95       $variation = new Variation($connection);
96
97       $skuVariation = $data['sku_variation'] ?? null;
98       if (!$skuVariation) {
99           echo json_encode([
100               "success" => false,
101               "error"   => "Missing sku_variation"
102           ]);
103           return;
104       }
105
106       $price->setSKUVariation($skuVariation);
107       $prices = $price->getPricesBySKUVariation();
108
109       $variation->setSKUVariation($skuVariation);
110       $modeResult = $variation->getPriceDisplayModeBySkuVariation();
111
112       $priceDisplayMode = "prices";
113       if (!empty($modeResult['success'])) {
114           $priceDisplayMode = $modeResult['price_display_mode'] ?? 'prices';
115       }
116
117       echo json_encode([
118           "success"            => true,
119           "prices"             => $prices,
120           "price_display_mode" => $priceDisplayMode
121       ]);
122   }
123  /**
124   * -----------------------------------------------------
125   * Create/replace prices for a given variation
126   * - Permite 0 filas: borra todas si arrays vacíos
127   * - Inserta filas válidas (price no-null); min/max pueden ser null
128   * -----------------------------------------------------
129   */
130   private function savePrices($data): void
131   {
132       header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
133
134       // 1) Connection and models
135       $connection = new Database();
136       $price = new Prices($connection);
137       $variation = new Variation($connection);
138
139       // 2) Read incoming data
140       $skuVariation = $data["sku_variation"] ?? null;
141       if (!$skuVariation) {
142           echo json_encode([
143               "success" => false,
144               "error"   => "Falta el SKU de la variación (sku_variation)"
145           ]);
146           return;
147       }
148
149       $ids     = isset($data["ids"])      && is_array($data["ids"])      ? $data["ids"]      : [];
150       $mins    = isset($data["min_qty"])  && is_array($data["min_qty"])  ? $data["min_qty"]  : [];
151       $maxs    = isset($data["max_qty"])  && is_array($data["max_qty"])  ? $data["max_qty"]  : [];
152       $pricesA = isset($data["prices"])   && is_array($data["prices"])   ? $data["prices"]   : [];
153
154       $price_display_mode = isset($data["price_display_mode"])
155           ? trim((string)$data["price_display_mode"])
156           : "prices";
157
158       $pdo = $connection->getConnection();
159       try {
160           DeliveryPrice::requireColumns($pdo, 'prices');
161           $price->setSKUVariation($skuVariation);
162           $previousOptions = [];
163           foreach ($price->getPricesBySKUVariation() as $previous) $previousOptions[(string)$previous['price_id']] = $previous['delivery_options'] ?? null;
164           $days = $data['delivery_time_days'] ?? [];
165           $values = $data['delivery_price'] ?? [];
166           $types = $data['delivery_price_type'] ?? [];
167           if (!is_array($days) || count($days) !== count($pricesA) || !is_array($values) || !is_array($types) || count($mins) !== count($pricesA) || count($maxs) !== count($pricesA)
168               || count($values) !== count($pricesA) || count($types) !== count($pricesA)) {
169               throw new InvalidArgumentException('Incomplete price rows. Reload the page and try again.');
170           }
171           $delivery = [];
172           foreach ($pricesA as $i => $value) {
173               $days[$i] = DeliveryPrice::normalizeDays($days[$i] ?? null);
174               $delivery[$i] = DeliveryPrice::normalize($values[$i] ?? null, $types[$i] ?? null);
175               if (!is_scalar($value) || !is_numeric($value) || !is_finite((float)$value) || (float)$value < 0) {
176                   throw new InvalidArgumentException('Price must be a non-negative number.');
177               }
178               foreach ([$mins[$i], $maxs[$i]] as $qty) {
179                   if ($qty !== '' && $qty !== null && (!is_scalar($qty) || !ctype_digit((string)$qty))) {
180                       throw new InvalidArgumentException('Quantity must be a non-negative integer.');
181                   }
182               }
183               if ($mins[$i] !== '' && $maxs[$i] !== '' && $mins[$i] !== null && $maxs[$i] !== null && (int)$maxs[$i] < (int)$mins[$i]) {
184                   throw new InvalidArgumentException('Max quantity cannot be less than min quantity.');
185               }
186           }
187           $pdo->beginTransaction();
188           $variation->setSKUVariation($skuVariation);
189           $variation->setPriceDisplayMode($price_display_mode);
190           $modeResult = $variation->updatePriceDisplayMode();
191           if (empty($modeResult['success'])) throw new RuntimeException('Could not save price display mode.');
192           $price->setSKUVariation($skuVariation);
193           if (!$price->deletePricesBySkuVariation()) throw new RuntimeException('Could not replace prices.');
194           foreach ($pricesA as $i => $value) {
195               $price->setMinQuantity($mins[$i]);
196               $price->setMaxQuantity($maxs[$i]);
197               $price->setPrice($value);
198               $price->setDeliveryOptions($previousOptions[(string)($ids[$i] ?? '')] ?? null);
199               $price->setDeliveryTimeDays($days[$i]);
200               $price->setDeliveryPrice(...$delivery[$i]);
201               if (!$price->savePrice()) throw new RuntimeException('Could not save price row. No changes were saved.');
202           }
203           $pdo->commit();
204           echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'prices' => $price->getPricesBySKUVariation(), 'price_display_mode' => $price_display_mode]);
205       } catch (Throwable $error) {
206           if ($pdo->inTransaction()) $pdo->rollBack();
207           http_response_code(422);
208           echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => $error->getMessage()]);
209       }
210   }
211}

4class Variations {
5  public function handleAjax(): void
6  {
7      // 1) Detectar tipo de contenido
8      $contentType = $_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? $_SERVER['HTTP_CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '';
9
10      // 2) Normalizar $data desde JSON o POST (multipart)
11      $data = [];
12      if (stripos($contentType, 'application/json') !== false) {
13          $raw  = file_get_contents('php://input');
14          $json = json_decode($raw, true);
15          if (is_array($json)) {
16              $data = $json;
17          }
18      } else {
19          // multipart/form-data o x-www-form-urlencoded
20          $data = $_POST;
21      }
22
23      // 4) Acción
24      $action = $data['action'] ?? null;
25
26      // 5) Enrutar
27    CatalogAccess::enforce('variations', is_array($data) ? $data : []);
28
29      switch ($action) {
30          case 'get_variation_details':
31              // Si necesitas archivos opcionales en esta acción:
32              $data['_files'] = $_FILES ?? [];
33              $this->getVariationDetails($data);
34          break;
35
36          case 'create_new_variation':
37              $data['_files'] = $_FILES ?? [];
38              $this->createNewVariation($data);
39          break;
40
41          case 'save_variation_details':
42              // Aquí sí esperas archivos image/pdf desde FormData
43              $data['_files'] = $_FILES ?? [];
44              $this->saveVariationDetails($data);
45          break;
46
47          case 'update_group_name':
48              // Aquí sí esperas archivos image/pdf desde FormData
49              $this->updateGroupName($data);
50          break;
51          case 'get_sku_default_variation':
52              // Aquí sí esperas archivos image/pdf desde FormData
53              $this->getSKUDefaultVariation($data);
54          break;
55          case 'delete_variation':
56              // Aquí sí esperas archivos image/pdf desde FormData
57              $this->deleteVariation($data);
58          break;
59
60          default:
61              header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
62              echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Unsupported action']);
63          break;
64      }
65  }

78  private function saveVariationDetails(array $data): void
79  {
80      header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');

82      try {

84          $delivery = DeliveryPrice::normalize($data['delivery_price'] ?? null, $data['delivery_price_type'] ?? null);

86      } catch (Throwable $error) {
87          http_response_code(422);
88          echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $error->getMessage()]);
89          return;

93      $sku_variation       = $data['sku_variation']       ?? null;

95
96      // IMPORTANT: cast flags to int so "0" is not treated as truthy
97      $isAttachAnImage = (int)($data['isAttachAnImage'] ?? 0);

173  private function storeUpload(?array $file, string $kind, ?string $product, ?string $variation): ?string
174  {
175      if (!$file || ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) return null;
176      try {

178      } catch (InvalidArgumentException $error) {
179          Dot63Security::fail(422, $error->getMessage());
180      } catch (Throwable $error) {

239  private function generate_sku(string $prefix = 'VRT'): string {
240    $dt    = new DateTimeImmutable('now', new DateTimeZone('UTC'));
241    $stamp = $dt->format('Ymd-His-u'); // 20250925-175903-123456
242    $rand  = strtoupper(bin2hex(random_bytes(5)));   // 10 hex
243    return sprintf(
244      '%s-%s-%s',
245      strtoupper(preg_replace('/[^A-Z0-9]/', '', $prefix)),
246      $stamp,
247      $rand
248    );
249  }

244      this.renderTopMenu(response.variations, skuVariation);
245      this.renderCurrentNameAndDefaultRules(response.current);
246      this.renderParentSelect(response.variations, response.current, response.parent, response.product);
247      this.renderTypeVariationsSelect(response.type_variations, response.current?.type_id);
248      this.renderServerPreviews(response.current);
249      this.attachImage = false;
250      this.attachPDF = false;
251    } catch (error) {
252      console.error("Error loading variation details:", error);
253    }
254  }

365  renderParentSelect(variationsRaw, current, parent, product) {
366    if (!this.parentSelect) {
367      return;
368    }
369    const variations = Array.isArray(variationsRaw) ? variationsRaw : [];
370    const currentSku = String(current?.sku ?? current?.SKU ?? "").trim();
371    this.parentSelect.innerHTML = `
372      <option value="" disabled selected>
373        Select a parent
374      </option>
375    `;
376    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
377    for (let index = 0; index < variations.length; index += 1) {
378      const variation = variations[index] || {};
379      const sku = String(variation?.SKU ?? variation?.sku ?? "").trim();
380      if (!sku || sku === currentSku) {
381        continue;
382      }
383      const name = String(variation?.name ?? "(unnamed variation)");
384      const option = document.createElement("option");

386      option.dataset.sku = sku;

391    const targetParent = String(parent?.sku ?? parent?.SKU ?? "") || String(product?.product_sku ?? "");
392    const wanted = targetParent.trim().toUpperCase();

394      return;

397      const value = String(option.value || "").trim().toUpperCase();

399      if (value === wanted || dataSku === wanted) {
400        option.selected = true;

436  renderServerPreviews(current) {
437    const toAssetUrl = path => {
438      const raw = String(path ?? "").trim();
439      if (!raw) {
440        return "";
441      }
442      if (raw.startsWith("http") || raw.startsWith("data:") || raw.startsWith("blob:")) {
443        return raw;
444      }
445      const relativePath = raw.replace(/^\/+/, "");
446      if (relativePath.startsWith("controller/")) {
447        return "../../" + relativePath;
448      }
449      return "../../controller/" + relativePath;
450    };
451
452    // Image.
453    if (this.imgPreview) {
454      const serverImage = String(current?.image ?? "").trim();
455      const imageSource = serverImage ? toAssetUrl(serverImage) || "../../view/variations/images/add_image.png" : "../../view/variations/images/add_image.png";
456      this.imgPreview.innerHTML = "";
457      const image = document.createElement("img");
458      image.alt = "Selected variation image preview";
459      image.loading = "lazy";
460      image.decoding = "async";
461      image.src = imageSource;
462      this.imgPreview.appendChild(image);
463    }
464
465    // PDF name.
466    if (this.namePdfInput) {
467      this.namePdfInput.value = String(current?.name_pdf_artwork ?? "");
468    }
469    if (!this.pdfPreview) {
470      return;
471    }
472    const serverPdf = String(current?.pdf_artwork ?? "").trim();
473    if (!serverPdf) {
474      this.pdfPreview.innerHTML = "";
475      return;
476    }
477    const pdfName = String(current?.name_pdf_artwork ?? "").trim();
478    const displayName = pdfName || serverPdf.split("/").pop() || "artwork.pdf";
479    const downloadName = displayName.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf") ? displayName : `${displayName}.pdf`;
480    const href = toAssetUrl(serverPdf);
481    const pill = document.createElement("div");
482    pill.className = "cp-file-pill";
483    const openLink = document.createElement("a");
484    openLink.href = href;
485    openLink.target = "_blank";
486    openLink.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
487    openLink.className = "cp-file-pill-main";
488    openLink.textContent = displayName;
489    openLink.style.color = "var(--brand)";
490    openLink.style.textDecoration = "none";
491    const downloadLink = document.createElement("a");
492    downloadLink.href = href;
493    downloadLink.download = downloadName;
494    downloadLink.textContent = "↓ Download";
495    downloadLink.style.marginLeft = "8px";
496    downloadLink.style.fontSize = "0.85em";
497    downloadLink.style.color = "var(--muted)";
498    pill.appendChild(openLink);
499    pill.appendChild(downloadLink);
500    this.pdfPreview.innerHTML = "";
501    this.pdfPreview.appendChild(pill);
502  }

508  async saveVariationDetails(goNext = true) {
509    const {
510      skuProduct,
511      skuVariation
512    } = this.readSkuParamsFromUrl();
513    let skuParentVariation = "";
514    const selectedParent = this.parentSelect?.selectedOptions?.[0];
515    if (selectedParent) {
516      skuParentVariation = String(selectedParent.dataset?.sku || selectedParent.value || "").trim();
517    }
518    const typeId = String(this.typeSelect?.value || "").trim();
519    const imageFile = this.imgInput?.files?.[0] || null;
520    const pdfFile = this.pdfInput?.files?.[0] || null;
521    if (imageFile && !imageFile.type.startsWith("image/")) {
522      alert("The selected image file is not valid.");
523      return false;
524    }
525    if (pdfFile && !this.isValidPdf(pdfFile)) {
526      alert("Please select a valid PDF file.");
527      return false;
528    }
529    if (this.deliveryPriceInput && !this.deliveryPriceInput.reportValidity()) return false;
530    if (this.deliveryTimeInput && !this.deliveryTimeInput.reportValidity()) return false;
531    const formData = new FormData();
532    formData.append("delivery_time_days", this.deliveryTimeInput?.value ?? "");
533    formData.append("delivery_price", this.deliveryPriceInput?.value ?? '');
534    formData.append("delivery_price_type", this.deliveryPriceType?.value ?? 'percentage');
535    formData.append("action", "save_variation_details");
536    formData.append("sku_product", skuProduct);
537    formData.append("sku_variation", skuVariation);
538    formData.append("isAttachAnImage", imageFile ? "1" : "0");
539    formData.append("isAttachAPDF", pdfFile ? "1" : "0");
540    formData.append("name", String(this.nameInput?.value || "").trim());
541    formData.append("name_pdf_artwork", String(this.namePdfInput?.value || "").trim());
542    formData.append("type_id", typeId);
543    if (skuParentVariation) {
544      formData.append("sku_parent_variation", skuParentVariation);
545    }
546    if (imageFile) {
547      formData.append("imageFile", imageFile);
548    }
549    if (pdfFile) {
550      formData.append("pdfFile", pdfFile);
551    }
552    try {
553      const response = await this.makeRequest("../../controller/products/variations.php", formData, {
554        headers: {
555          "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest"
556        }
557      });
558      if (!response?.success) {
559        console.error("Save failed:", response);
560        alert(response?.message || "Could not save the variation.");
561        return false;
562      }
563      window.headerAddProduct?.refreshSelection?.();
564      if (goNext) {
565        const destination = "../../view/images/index.php";
566        if (window.headerAddProduct?.goNext) {
567          window.headerAddProduct.goNext(destination);
568        } else {
569          window.location.href = destination;
570        }
571      }
572      return true;
573    } catch (error) {
574      console.error("Save error:", error);
575      alert(error.message || "Network/server error while saving.");
576      return false;
577    }
578  }

783  async makeRequest(url, data, options = {}) {
784    const {
785      requireSuccess = false,
786      responseType = "json",
787      ...requestOptions
788    } = options;
789    const isFormData = data instanceof FormData;
790    const headers = new Headers(requestOptions.headers || {});
791    if (!isFormData && !headers.has("Content-Type")) headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
792    const response = await fetch(url, {
793      method: "POST",
794      credentials: "same-origin",
795      ...requestOptions,
796      headers,
797      body: isFormData ? data : JSON.stringify(data)
798    });
799    const text = await response.text();
800    let result;
801    try {
802      result = responseType === "text" ? text : JSON.parse(text);
803    } catch {
804      const error = new Error("The server returned an invalid response.");
805      error.status = response.status;
806      throw error;
807    }
808    if (!response.ok || requireSuccess && !result?.success) {
809      const error = new Error(result?.error || result?.message || "The request could not be completed.");
810      error.status = response.status;
811      error.code = result?.code || null;
812      error.details = result;
813      throw error;
814    }
815    return result;
816  }

35      {

44
45        // State: each row => { id, min_qty, max_qty, price, order }

217  renderMenuTop(items) {
218    const ul = document.getElementById('menu_list');
219    if (!ul) return;
220    const list = Array.isArray(items) ? items : items && Array.isArray(items.variations) ? items.variations : [];
221    ul.innerHTML = '';
222    ul.setAttribute('role', 'menu');
223    if (!list || list.length === 0) {
224      const li = document.createElement('li');
225      li.textContent = 'No items to show';
226      li.setAttribute('role', 'menuitem');
227      li.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
228      ul.appendChild(li);
229      return;
230    }
231    const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, m => ({
232      '&': '&amp;',
233      '<': '&lt;',
234      '>': '&gt;',
235      '"': '&quot;',
236      "'": '&#39;'
237    })[m]);
238    const levelColors = ['#0f2140', '#0b6b6b', '#7a4d0f', '#5a2d82', '#1d6b2a'];
239    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

247      const indent = 28 + level * 18;
248      const li = document.createElement('li');
249      li.setAttribute('role', 'menuitem');
250      li.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
251      li.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
252      li.dataset.name = name;
253      li.dataset.sku = sku;
254      li.dataset.level = String(level);
255      li.style.position = 'relative';
256      li.style.padding = '8px 10px';
257      li.style.paddingLeft = `${indent}px`;
258      li.style.borderRadius = '10px';
259      li.style.cursor = 'default';
260      li.style.marginBottom = '6px';
261      li.style.borderLeft = `4px solid ${color}`;
262      li.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
263      li.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', `<span class="lvl-dot" aria-hidden="true" style="
264          position:absolute;
265          left:${Math.max(8, indent - 14)}px;
266          top:50%;
267          transform:translateY(-50%);
268          width:8px;
269          height:8px;
270          border-radius:999px;
271          background:${color};
272          opacity:.85;
273        "></span>`);
274      const skuHidden = sku ? `<span class="sku-hidden" style="position:absolute; left:-9999px; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden;">${esc(sku)}</span>` : '';
275      li.innerHTML += `<strong>${esc(name)}</strong>${skuHidden}`;
276      const candidate = String(sku || '').trim().toUpperCase();
277      if (candidate && wanted && candidate === wanted) {
278        li.classList.add('is-selected');
279        li.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
280        this._applySelectedInline(li);

282      frag.appendChild(li);

287  selectMenuCurrentItemBySku() {
288    const skuv = new URL(window.location.href).searchParams.get('sku_variation');
289    if (!skuv) return false;
290    const ul = this.menuList || document.getElementById('menu_list');
291    const btn = this.menuBtn || document.getElementById('menu_btn');
292    if (!ul) return false;
293    const norm = s => String(s || '').trim().toUpperCase();
294    const wanted = norm(skuv);
295    ul.querySelectorAll('.is-selected').forEach(el => {
296      el.classList.remove('is-selected');
297      el.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
298      this._clearSelectedInline(el);
299    });
300    for (const li of ul.querySelectorAll('li')) {
301      const candidate = norm(li.dataset?.sku);
302      if (candidate && candidate === wanted) {
303        li.classList.add('is-selected');
304        li.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
305        this._applySelectedInline(li);
306        ul.hidden = true;
307        if (btn) btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
308        return true;
309      }
310    }
311    return false;

422  // ========= Save =========
423
424  async save(e, goNext = false) {
425    if (e && typeof e.preventDefault === 'function') e.preventDefault();
426    if (this.form && !this.form.reportValidity()) return false;
427    const all = sel => Array.from(this.list.querySelectorAll(sel));
428    const ids = all('.remove').map(b => b.dataset.id || '');
429    const mins = all('.min-input').map(el => el.value);
430    const maxs = all('.max-input').map(el => el.value);
431    const prices = all('.price-input').map(el => el.value);
432    if (ids.length > 0) {
433      for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
434        const hasMin = mins[i] !== '';
435        const hasMax = maxs[i] !== '';
436        const prc = Number(prices[i]);
437        if (!Number.isFinite(prc) || prc < 0) {
438          alert('Price must be a non-negative number.');
439          return;
440        }
441        if (hasMin) {
442          const minQ = parseInt(mins[i], 10);
443          if (!Number.isInteger(minQ) || minQ < 0) {
444            alert('Min qty must be an integer ≥ 0.');
445            return;
446          }
447        }
448        if (hasMax) {
449          const maxQ = parseInt(maxs[i], 10);
450          if (!Number.isInteger(maxQ) || maxQ < 0) {
451            alert('Max qty must be an integer ≥ 0.');
452            return;
453          }
454        }
455        if (hasMin && hasMax) {
456          const minQ = parseInt(mins[i], 10);
457          const maxQ = parseInt(maxs[i], 10);
458          if (maxQ < minQ) {
459            alert('Max qty cannot be less than min qty.');
460            return;
461          }
462        }
463      }
464    }
465    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
466    const sku_variation = params.get('sku_variation');
467    const price_display_mode = this.getSelectedDisplayIn();
468    const url = '../../controller/products/price.php';
469    const payload = {
470      action: 'create_prices',
471      sku_variation,
472      price_display_mode,
473      ids,
474      min_qty: mins,
475      max_qty: maxs,
476      prices,
477      delivery_time_days: all('.delivery-days').map(el => el.value),
478      delivery_price: all('.delivery-input').map(el => el.value),
479      delivery_price_type: all('.delivery-type').map(el => el.value)
480    };
481    try {
482      const response = await this.makeRequest(url, payload);
483      const data = response;
484      if (data.success) {
485        alert('The prices have been saved successfully.');
486        if (goNext && window.headerAddProduct) {
487          headerAddProduct.goNext('../../view/delivery_times/index.php');
488          return true;
489        }
490        location.reload();
491        return true;
492      }
493      alert(data.error || 'There was a problem saving price rows.');
494      return false;
495    } catch (err) {
496      console.error('Error:', err);
497      alert(err.message || 'Could not save prices.');
498      return false;
499    }
500  }

543  handleListInput(e) {
544    const maps = [['min-input', 'min_qty'], ['max-input', 'max_qty'], ['price-input', 'price'], ['delivery-days', 'delivery_time_days'], ['delivery-input', 'delivery_price'], ['delivery-type', 'delivery_price_type']];
545    for (const [cls, key] of maps) {
546      const el = e.target.closest(`.${cls}`);
547      if (el) {
548        const id = el.dataset.id;
549        const row = this.rows.find(x => x.id === id);
550        if (row) row[key] = el.value;
551        if (key === 'delivery_price_type') el.closest('.price-row').querySelector('.delivery-unit').textContent = el.value === 'amount' ? '£ (GBP)' : '%';
552        break;
553      }
554    }

588  async makeRequest(url, data, options = {}) {
589    const {
590      requireSuccess = false,
591      responseType = "json",
592      ...requestOptions
593    } = options;
594    const isFormData = data instanceof FormData;
595    const headers = new Headers(requestOptions.headers || {});
596    if (!isFormData && !headers.has("Content-Type")) headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
597    const response = await fetch(url, {
598      method: "POST",
599      credentials: "same-origin",
600      ...requestOptions,
601      headers,
602      body: isFormData ? data : JSON.stringify(data)
603    });
604    const text = await response.text();
605    let result;
606    try {
607      result = responseType === "text" ? text : JSON.parse(text);
608    } catch {
609      const error = new Error("The server returned an invalid response.");
610      error.status = response.status;
611      throw error;
612    }
613    if (!response.ok || requireSuccess && !result?.success) {
614      const error = new Error(result?.error || result?.message || "The request could not be completed.");
615      error.status = response.status;
616      error.code = result?.code || null;
617      error.details = result;
618      throw error;
619    }
620    return result;
621  }
622}

10// SQLite is isolated in memory. No MySQL migrations or data are changed.
11// SQLite lacks MySQL's UPDATE ... LIMIT syntax; retain all bindings and predicates.
12class DeliveryTestPDO extends PDO {
13    public function prepare($query, $options = []) {
14        if (preg_match('/^\s*UPDATE /i', $query)) $query = preg_replace('/\s+LIMIT 1\s*$/i', '', $query);
15        return parent::prepare($query, $options);
16    }
